- Identify potential fraud indicators and escalate appropriately
- Maintain accurate and thorough claims records for audit and compliance
- Contribute to continuous improvement by flagging process inefficiencies
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
- Based in the UK or Ireland with work authorisation
- 6+ months of claims experience (gadget, warranty, consumer electronics, or similar consumer-facing lines) and must be APA or CIP qualified
- Strong organisation and ability to prioritise independently
- Comfortable using data to make decisions
- Team-oriented, hardworking, and ambitious
- Experience leading, mentoring, or coaching others is a plus
- Startup or high-growth experience is a plus
WHY JOIN US
This is a chance to grow faster than you would at a traditional insurer or claims business.
You’ll get real responsibility, real training, and the opportunity to build your career in a high-performance environment that rewards talent and hard work.
If you’re ready to step up, work hard, and build a career in claims, we’d love to hear from you.
OUR VALUES
- Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimise for momentum.
- Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.
- Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.
- Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for ‘good enough.’
- Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.

- Quarterly performance bonus: up to 15% of quarterly salary
- Equity participation: stock options as an early-stage team member
- Health insurance
- Pension contributions

- Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
We are looking for a confident, analytical and detail-focused QA & Authorisation Handler to join our Technical Claims Support Team.
You will provide a key technical control across our claims operation, completing Quality Assurance reviews and reviewing claim settlements at the authorisation stage.
As the final line of defence before a claim settlement is approved, you will be responsible for independently reviewing the claim, evidence, policy coverage and settlement calculation before making the decision to authorise, pass back or escalate.
This requires confidence and strong technical judgement. You must be comfortable making decisions, challenging claim assessments where something does not look right and clearly explaining the reasoning behind your decision.
The role goes beyond identifying individual errors. You will use findings from QA and authorisations to identify potential financial leakage, recurring handling issues, process and control gaps and emerging trends across the claims operation.
You will be comfortable using data to understand where issues are occurring, identify root causes and turn findings into practical improvements to processes, controls, guidance and training.
As ClaimSorted works across a range of insurance products and partners, you will need to be adaptable and confident moving between different products, policy wordings, processes and priorities while maintaining consistently high standards.
As part of the wider Technical Claims Support Team, you will also support other technical claims activities where required.
RESPONSIBILITIES
- Review claim settlements at authorisation stage across all ClaimSorted products, acting as the final line of defence before payment is approved.
- Independently review policy coverage, supporting evidence and settlement calculations, making confident decisions to authorise, pass back or escalate.
- Complete Quality Assurance reviews across all products, ensuring claims are handled accurately, fairly and in line with policy, partner and internal requirements.
- Identify and prevent financial leakage, incorrect settlements and other customer or financial risks.
- Provide clear, constructive and evidence-based feedback to Claims Handlers, confidently challenging decisions where required.
- Use QA, authorisation and leakage data across products to identify trends, recurring errors, training needs and process or control gaps.
- Support improvements to claims processes, guidance and controls based on findings and root-cause analysis.
- Maintain accurate records of decisions and findings while effectively managing and prioritising QA and authorisation workloads.
- Build and maintain the technical knowledge required to work confidently across all ClaimSorted product lines, partners and processes.
- Work collaboratively across Claims Operations and the wider Technical Claims Support Team.
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED
- +2 years experience completing claim authorisations within an insurance claims team is essential, with responsibility for reviewing and making decisions on claim settlements.
- +3 years experience working across two or more of the following product lines within a claims role: Pet, Travel, Property, Auto, Gadget or similar insurance products.
- Strong technical claims knowledge, with the confidence to independently review, challenge and make evidence-based decisions.
- Excellent attention to detail, particularly when reviewing policy coverage, supporting evidence and settlement calculations.
- Strong analytical skills, with experience identifying financial leakage, trends, recurring errors and process or control gaps.
- Able to confidently provide clear, constructive feedback and explain the rationale behind decisions.
- Highly organised and able to prioritise a varied workload based on risk, value and urgency.
- Adaptable and comfortable learning new products, policy wordings and processes in a fast-paced environment.
MISSION
To act as a final line of defence within the claims settlement process, ensuring claim outcomes are accurate, fair and supported by policy and evidence before settlement is authorised.
The QA & Authorisation Handler will use strong technical judgement and independent decision-making to protect customer outcomes and financial performance, identifying errors, potential leakage and operational risks before they result in incorrect settlements.
Through Quality Assurance, data analysis and trend identification, the role will also identify wider knowledge, process and control gaps and help turn individual findings into sustainable improvements across Claims Operations

We're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.
Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.
Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.
See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.
Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.
Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

Payments at Duffel
Our Payments team looks after the infrastructure that powers our travel operations: payment acceptance, supplier settlement, reconciliation, commission tracking and payouts, billing, and more. These are some of the hardest and most interesting challenges Duffel is facing as we operate as a global travel platform.
About the role
As the Product Manager for Payments, you'll own the roadmap for the operational backbone of our Payments product. The role is largely internal. You'll work closely with Finance, Engineering, and Operations to optimise settlement, billing, commissions and reconciliation, and to build the platform services that other Duffel teams, and eventually external partners, rely on. There's a customer-facing dimension too, but the bulk of the work is making the inside of the product as well-engineered as the outside.
You'll spend most of your time with engineering, define the weekly goals and milestones for the product squad, work closely with internal stakeholders (Finance especially), and bring real depth to a team that values getting the detail right. You'll own the overall Payments roadmap, to shape where your areas go next, including parts of the product we've barely touched yet.
What we're looking for
- You're fluent in payments without being wedded to the rails. You understand how money moves (settlement, reconciliation, commissions, FX, chargebacks) but you're more energised by building great internal product on top of that than by optimising payment rails for their own sake.
- You're a builder. Most of what this team needs, we build rather than buy. You like designing the systems, automated commission flows, supplier reconciliation, billing, that Finance, Operations and eventually external partners rely on.
- You translate between worlds. A big part of this job is sitting between Finance and Engineering: turning finance narratives into technical requirements, technical realities into language Finance and Ops can act on, and getting both sides to genuinely understand each other.
- You prioritise ruthlessly. This is a small, in-demand team (three engineers) constantly trading internal needs against customer-facing work. You're good at deciding what matters now and saying no to the rest.
- You sweat the detail. Reconciliation logic, commission edge cases, audit trails: this is the kind of work that energises you rather than drains you.
- You shape product direction. You can take a roadmap area, work out where it should go and why, and drive it.
- You've got commercial instinct. You can spot when something we've built for ourselves (like reconciliation) could become a product customers would pay for.
- You're API-literate. You don't need to write code, but you can have a meaningful conversation with engineering about how systems actually work.
- You handle ambiguity, breaking complex, undefined problems into a clear way forward, and use both quantitative and qualitative analysis to back your calls.
- You think being challenged on your assumptions makes you better, and that challenging others helps them grow.
- Nice to have: exposure to travel-specific payments (BSP, IATA, virtual cards, agency settlement). Useful, not essential.
Some reasons why you’ll love working here:
🏡 Work From Anywhere - work abroad for part of the year
🛩️ Duffel Travel Allowance - because building in travel should come with travel perks
🍼 Enhanced parental leave
🧘 Sabbatical options - proper time to recharge

Flow is seeking software engineers to build AI-powered capabilities that help teams author, review, and manage requirements more effectively. You will work on agentic systems engineer and agentic domain engineer workflows—bringing AI into the center of how teams reason about their systems.
This role sits at the intersection of AI, product, and full-stack engineering: you will take ideas from prototype all the way to stable, observable features in production.

- Evaluate and integrate language models and related tooling, optimizing for reliability, latency, cost, and debuggability in production.
- Build and maintain the surrounding infrastructure: data pipelines, evaluation harnesses, prompt and model management, observability, and safety/guardrails.
- Work across the stack—from backend integrations and APIs to simple UI hooks—to deliver complete AI features, not just model endpoints.
- Partner with product and customers to identify high-value workflows, run experiments, and iterate quickly based on usage.
ABOUT YOU
- 3+ years developing production software, including designing, testing, and operating services at scale in a cloud environment.
- Hands-on experience with modern LLM providers and tooling (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, vector stores, RAG patterns).
- Familiarity with prompt design, retrieval-augmented systems, evaluation methods, and safety/guardrail approaches.
- Ability to reason about tradeoffs between different models, architectures, and deployment patterns and make pragmatic decisions.
- Comfortable working in a high-ownership, fast-paced environment where experiments and iteration are the norm.
OUR STACK (AI-LEANING)
- TypeScript/Node.js and Python for AI and backend services.
- Modern LLM APIs and orchestration libraries for building agentic workflows.
- Postgres and other managed cloud services for data and state.
HOW WE WORK & VALUES

At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.
We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.
With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?
ABOUT THE ROLE
We’re seeking a Solutions Engineer to join our Solutions Engineering team and sit on the frontline of industrial decarbonisation.
This role blends industrial process expertise, control engineering, and deployment leadership. You’ll work directly with plant management, process engineers and operators to understand complex chemical processes, design optimal AI control strategies, and integrate Gigaton’s AI into live production environments. Your mission is to ensure that we delight our customers by using our AI solutions to solve critical operational problems and deliver real, measurable cost and carbon impact.
YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
- Build trust and engagement with plant managers, process engineers and operators by clearly explaining technical decisions and demonstrating measurable benefits aligned to operational needs.
- Analyse plant data to assess and identify opportunities, and evaluate the performance of Gigaton’s software.
- Develop and refine control strategies, leveraging APC, MPC, and PID principles.
- Deploy and integrate Gigaton AI into live plants, ensuring stable, safe, and effective operation.
- Collaborate with plant and process teams to identify optimisation opportunities, tune control loops, and validate performance improvements.
- Collaborate with machine learning engineers to refine algorithms and recommendations based on real-world outcomes.
- Create and refine deployment playbooks and templates, ensuring repeatable, scalable, and high-quality rollouts across plants.
- Act as a feedback loop into Gigaton’s product and machine learning teams, providing field insights that shape our product roadmap.
- Travel to sites (~1 week/month) to work hands-on with teams during commissioning, testing, and optimisation phases.
WHAT A GREAT FIT LOOKS LIKE
- Strong process or control engineering background, ideally in cement, chemicals, energy or heavy manufacturing.
- Comfortable collaborating with operators, plant managers, engineers, and data scientists, bridging industrial know-how with data-driven insights.
- Strong analytical skills and outcome-oriented mindset, able to dig into industrial data, identify root causes, generate actionable solutions, and deliver them.
- Excellent communication skills, able to build credibility and trust in complex industrial environments.
- Excellent project management skills, with the ability to work independently, drive clear actions for yourself, your team and the customer, deliver against the plan, and manage project risks.
- Practical problem-solver who enjoys working on real-world process challenges.
- Willingness to travel: regularly to deployment sites (~25%).
YOU’LL EXCEL IF
- You thrive in dynamic, high-impact environments. Fast-paced, ambiguous settings energise you, and you’re motivated by work where every deployment contributes directly to decarbonisation.
- You take ownership and thrive when you’re given full responsibility for projects and can see them through end-to-end. You spot problems and act decisively to solve them.
- You have experience with industrial control (APC/MPC/PID), automation (DCS, PLC) or data (OPC, Historian, LIMS) systems.
- You have an understanding of AI/ML applications, such as forecasting, optimisation, anomaly detection.
- You have implemented or tuned control systems and understand how to balance process stability, quality, and energy efficiency.
- You are confident working across technical, operational and business interfaces, turning complex problems into structured solutions and communicating complex ideas to multiple audiences.
SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE MEANS
- Plants achieve measurable performance improvements — lower costs, reduced CO₂, improved stability.
- Customer process engineers trust you as a reliable partner who understands their world.
- Deployments become more repeatable, efficient, and scalable thanks to your control and process insights.
- Your field insights help Gigaton’s solutions evolve into robust, operator-friendly process control systems.
- 💡 You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match.
We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from all walks of life, with different countries, cultures, and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths.
We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you.

3. Technical Interviews:

1. The Task: Work through a kiln optimisation scenario, balancing process stability, clinker quality, fuel use, and emissions to recommend an operating and control strategy.
2. What it’s assessing: Ability to reason about complex plant dynamics, weigh competing trade-offs, and connect process decisions to overall plant performance and cost impact.

The Platform team works across a broad range of problems at Gigaton, from CI/CD for our monorepo and networking and data integration with on-premise plant systems, to hardening our IoT OS image and building customer-facing software around our control systems.
The work is currently split across two squads:
1. Enablement, focused on helping engineers move faster.
2. Product, focused on supporting our control software.
Whichever squad you join, you’ll work across technically challenging problems with plenty of scope to learn, contribute and shape how we build software.
YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
- Write reliable, well-tested software in Python and Terraform.
- Monitor, support and improve software running in production.
- Mentor less experienced engineers and help them develop their craft.
- Identify, articulate and drive architectural improvements.
- Bring strong software engineering practices to code developed across the wider engineering and ML teams.
- Contribute to improving the quality, maintainability and reliability of our systems.
BONUS EXPERIENCE
You don’t need all of these, but experience in any of the following would be useful:
- Control engineering, machine learning or MLOps.
- AWS IoT, Greengrass or Mender for managing device fleets.
- Working across multiple cloud environments, such as AWS, GCP or Azure.
- Managing CI/CD environments using GitHub Actions.
- Building production artefacts using tools such as Docker.
- Functional programming languages such as Haskell, F# or Elm.
- Building or working with more complex AI-enabled workflows beyond simple prompting.

- Pragmatic about engineering trade-offs and know when good enough now is better than perfect later.

- Able to improve existing systems, not just build new ones from scratch.

- Strong Python skills and experience implementing machine learning models using tools such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch.
- An interest in working closely with engineers and taking responsibility for how your methods perform in practice.
- Practical experience deploying machine learning and control algorithms.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/harmonic-security-inc/a.description_excerpt:
AI is being run everywhere, by humans and agents. Harmonic Security governs all of it. The AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform understands user / agent intent and data context in real time, giving security teams visibility and control across every tool and workflow so companies can move faster with AI while minimizing risk.
We operate in one of the fastest-moving spaces in tech: the emerging intersection of AI and cybersecurity. It's a market still being defined, and we're among the first to build natively for it - protecting sensitive data in real time, at the endpoint, with minimal friction for the teams using it. Enterprises get full visibility and control. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.
Named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, Harmonic is gaining serious recognition and serious traction. We're led by deep cybersecurity expertise and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel.
As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.
HOW WE WORK: AI-FIRST BY DESIGN
Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively leverages AI tools to perform their best work — from deep research and writing to building robust processes and automating complex workflows. We expect every new hire to bring a genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to using it to work smarter, faster, and with greater creativity.
For some, this involves tinkering and remaining open to emerging tools; for others, it means architecting entirely new systems with AI at the core. We will be transparent about expectations for every role and provide the tools and support needed for you to thrive.
ABOUT THE TEAM
Our Product Delivery team is the engine that turns vision into impact. We ship early and often, getting valuable features into the hands of customers quickly and iterating from there. We work in the open by default, sharing progress and ideas, and we trust each other to own outcomes. We’re a small but mighty crew where every person plays a critical role and we’re committed to using AI to work smarter and faster.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We’re looking for a Backend Engineer who has an appreciation for all things security and system interconnectivity. This is a very hands-on technical role where you will be responsible for designing, building and maintaining scalable integrations between our core applications, identity providers and data security platforms.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Own deliveries and features from start to finish
- Design, build, and own backend services in a microservices-based, event-driven architecture
- Implement core domain logic that drives key product workflows and system behavior
- Ingest and process high-volume usage and event data from customer-facing endpoints
- Build backend services that support operational, analytics, and reporting use cases
- Model, persist, and manage domain data, enabling querying, filtering, and lifecycle management
- Expose well-designed APIs and webhooks consumed by customers, UIs, and external systems
- Power customer-facing UI experiences by providing backend APIs for visibility, analytics, and configuration
WHAT YOU BRING
- 3–5+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend services and distributed systems in the Java ecosystem (Java, Spring Boot, Maven/Gradle)
- Strong understanding of event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing patterns, messaging systems, and distributed system design
- Proven experience designing and maintaining RESTful APIs, web hooks, and service-to-service integrations
- Comfortable operating in AWS, GCP, or Azure environments and working with modern observability tooling, logging, and monitoring platforms
- A track record of delivering performant, reliable and scalable applications
- Excellent collaboration and communication skills in cross-functional teams
YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU
- Have experience building products in cybersecurity, identity, governance, compliance, data protection, or enterprise SaaS environments
- You understand not just how to build systems, but why architectural decisions matter
- You can balance scalability, reliability, maintainability, and speed of execution
- You think critically about security, observability, and operational excellence from day one
- Love the idea of blending software development, distributed systems and data-intensive applications
- Strong familiarity with authentication and identity technologies such as OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, SCIM, Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, or other enterprise identity providers
- Thrive in fast-paced startup environments where ambiguity is the norm
- Enjoy shaping culture and engineering practices, not just writing code
- Leverage AI tools as an engineer to help you build smarter, faster and better
WHY JOIN US
This isn't just a job - it's a chance to help define a category. Harmonic Security was named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, and we're just getting started. We're building at the intersection of AI and security, carving out an emerging market where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.
We believe today's talent is tomorrow's success, and we're committed to creating an environment where you can do the best work of your life.
- Recognized momentum - We made the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, a signal that the market is taking notice
- Rare market opportunity - Join early in a category-defining company at the convergence of AI and security, where your work directly shapes how enterprises tackle one of the biggest unsolved problems in tech
- Competitive pay and meaningful equity - A real stake in Harmonic's success, not a token gesture
- Comprehensive benefits - 401K, pension plan, generous PTO, and flexible hybrid work
- A small, high-trust team that values transparency, creativity, and continuous learning - no politics, no bureaucracy
- Thoughtful leadership - that cares deeply about your growth, not just your output
- Annual global off-sites - past trips include Lisbon, Portugal and Nashville, TN
- Real ownership - you'll shape the product, the culture, and the direction of the company from day one
HARMONIC'S CORE VALUES
🌱 Flourish in the Unknown
We embrace new, unfamiliar situations that require initiative and rapid decision-making. We orient ourselves quickly and deliver results with minimal guidance.
🔥 Never Full
We raise our hands, take on challenges, and assist others whenever possible. We hunger for opportunities to learn and do more.
🤝 Perfect Harmony
We support one another to create cohesion and unity. We collaborate openly, share feedback honestly, and help everyone produce their best work

About Legal 500
Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients.
Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. We bring the legal market together through a global programme of events - awards ceremonies, conferences and roundtables that convene leading law firms, in-house teams and their advisers. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms.
We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol.
About the Role
This is a new role at Legal 500, created as a result of a period of growth due to acquisitons, new products and creating new research capability. We are, therefore, looking to hire two driven and commercially minded Business Development Managers to generate new subscription revenue across our product portfolio. by identifying, engaging, and converting prospective customers.
This role is ideal for a proactive sales professional with experience selling subscription-based products, information services, memberships, or recurring revenue products.
What you'll be doing:
New Business Development
- Identify and target prospective customers across legal market in the US
- Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities.
- Conduct outbound prospecting through calls and email
- Be unfazed by contacting C-suite decision makers across multiple international jurisdictions and confidently presenting and selling the product to marketing and legal professionals across the world’s leading law firms, as well as partners and senior lawyers.
Sales & Revenue Growth
- Manage the full sales cycle from lead generation to contract signature.
- Deliver compelling product demonstrations and presentations.
- Understand client needs and align subscription solutions to business challenges.
- Negotiate commercial terms and close deals to achieve and exceed revenue targets.
Market Intelligence
- Stay informed on industry trends, customer challenges, and competitor activity.
- Provide feedback to marketing, product, and leadership teams on market opportunities.
- Identify emerging sectors and growth areas for subscription sales.
Collaboration
- Work closely with marketing to maximise lead generation campaigns.
- Partner with customer success and account management teams to ensure smooth onboarding and handover.
- Contribute to sales strategy, pricing discussions, and go-to-market initiatives.
What we're looking for:
- Solid experience in business development, new business sales, or subscription sales
- Proven track record of achieving or exceeding revenue targets
- Experience selling subscription information, media, research, or membership products
- Strong consultative selling and negotiation skills
- Excellent communication and presentation skills
- Ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously
Even better if you have...
- Experience selling to professional services firms, legal, financial, or corporate clients
- Knowledge of recurring revenue business models
- Experience using CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics, etc.)
- Experience with social selling and LinkedIn prospecting
- Understanding of customer success and retention principles
Role information
- This role can be based in either our London or Bristol offices
- This is a US-focused role - our working hours are 9.30am - 5.30pm but you will have flexibiliy to make your day work
- We operate a hybrid working policy - 3 days per week in the office and 2 days remote

As Firmware Lead, you will lead implementation and delivery of real-time embedded firmware for Kandou's Randa 1.6T Active Electrical Cable platform. This is a coding-heavy technical leadership role: you will spend the majority of your time writing and reviewing C/C++, debugging firmware and hardware interactions, and supporting pre-silicon and post-silicon bring-up. You will turn the Firmware Architect's system design into production code, own implementation quality and delivery, and mentor engineers while remaining active in the codebase.
Open locations: India (Hyderabad or Bangalore), UK (Reading or Cambridge), Switzerland (Lausanne).
Responsibilities
• Lead the implementation and delivery of real-time embedded firmware for AEC retimer silicon across 224G/lane, 448G/lane and forward-looking 896G/lane configurations; remain a hands-on C/C++ contributor.
• Implement and maintain boot, configuration, calibration, link-training, fault-recovery and run-time supervision state machines on resource-constrained RISC-V or ARM platforms.
• Translate approved firmware architecture into module designs, APIs, task and interrupt models, memory budgets and hardware/software contracts; surface implementation tradeoffs early.
• Code, debug and optimize firmware for SerDes equalization and adaptation, FEC-aware monitoring and re-adaptation, telemetry capture, thermal behavior and power management.
• Own low-level drivers and management interfaces including SPI, I2C/SMBus, I3C, MCTP and JTAG, and integrate firmware services with the CMIS management layer.
• Drive pre-silicon development and first-silicon bring-up; isolate issues across firmware, RTL, boards and lab setups using JTAG, register traces and targeted instrumentation.
• Set coding and review standards; build unit, integration and hardware-in-loop tests; enforce CI, static analysis and release evidence; improve Python-based build, debug and test tools.
• Break the roadmap into deliverable work packages, estimate and track execution, mentor firmware engineers and coordinate with architecture, ASIC, DV, validation, SI and applications teams.
Essential Experience
• 8+ years developing and debugging production real-time firmware in C/C++, including 2+ years leading firmware modules, projects or a small team.
• Expert hands-on C/C++ in resource-constrained systems, with recent evidence of personal code delivery, code review and complex defect resolution.
• Firmware experience on a retimer, gearbox, PHY, AEC, AOC, optical module, networking ASIC or comparable high-speed mixed hardware/software product.
• RISC-V and/or ARM bare-metal or RTOS firmware, including interrupts, traps, CSR or register access, concurrency and tight RAM/flash budgets.
• RTOS development with Zephyr, FreeRTOS or equivalent; ownership of scheduling, synchronization, timing and failure recovery.
• At least one silicon or board bring-up cycle using JTAG and related debug mechanisms, with root-cause analysis across firmware, drivers, RTL and hardware.
• Python, Git/GitLab, Make/CMake, CI, unit and integration testing, and static analysis, with disciplined reproducible development workflows.
BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent experience; strong communication, planning, mentoring and cross-functional leadership.
Useful experience
• IEEE 802.3ck or 802.3dj link training and equalization, SerDes adaptation algorithms, channel-quality monitoring and register-level PHY tuning.
• FEC exposure including KP4 or RS-544, pre-FEC and post-FEC telemetry, symbol-error analysis and FEC-aware recovery behavior.
• CMIS 5.x firmware integration, module or datapath state machines, VDM telemetry, and sideband protocols including SMBus, I3C and MCTP.
• Bootloaders, secure boot, root of trust, authenticated A/B firmware updates, rollback protection and field-recovery mechanisms.
• Pre-silicon firmware development using QEMU, SystemC, FPGA, simulation or emulation; heterogeneous multicore or vector-processing systems.
PCIe or CXL, hyperscaler qualification, interoperability debugging, and production support for field or manufacturing issues.

✅ ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Software Engineer on the AWS Emulator team, you’ll help expand and harden LocalStack’s AWS emulator by taking ownership of individual services and making them behave as closely as possible to real AWS.
The challenge is genuinely unusual: you’ll reimplement cloud services that you can only observe from the outside. Making a service “work” is one thing; matching AWS behaviour — including edge cases and undocumented details — is a very different engineering problem.
We’re looking for someone who learns quickly, enjoys tackling unfamiliar problems, and can turn incomplete information into working solutions. You’ll have end-to-end ownership of your services, from investigating how they behave and deciding what needs to be built through implementation, testing, and ongoing improvements.
AI is a core part of how the team works. You’ll use modern AI coding and agentic tools to make development more efficient while maintaining the quality and reliability expected by LocalStack users. The role offers a clear path to broader service ownership and technical leadership as your scope grows.
✅ WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON/RESPONSIBLE FOR
- Independently take AWS services from third-party-backed implementations to fully first-party implementations, owning store design for persistence, full API operation coverage, and conformance to LocalStack conventions.
- Close parity gaps in owned services by raising snapshot-test coverage against real AWS across the documented API surface, with a measurable reduction in parity defects reported from the field.
- Own services end-to-end after they ship. Act as a first responder for your services, triaging and resolving customer-reported parity bugs within a 5-day median, including issues that surface through Terraform and CDK rather than direct API calls.
- Contribute reusable test infrastructure (conformance harnesses, snapshot tooling, fixtures) that other engineers adopt for services they do not own.
- By month 12, be trusted to scope and sequence an a complete implementation of an emulated service independently, from API documentation analysis and experimentation through implementation, testing, and a shipped provider, without needing the plan handed to you.
✅ EXPERIENCE WE EXPECT YOU TO BRING TO THE ROLE
- mid-level/senior professional software engineering experience, with strong engineering fundamentals.
- Strong programming experience in at least one language. Python is preferred, but we are language-agnostic and value strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn new languages quickly.
- Experience working from documentation, specifications, public APIs, or observable system behaviour to understand and reproduce how a system works — for example, through APIs, protocols, SDKs, emulators, parsers, or reverse-engineering projects.
- A strong testing mindset — you use tests as a tool for understanding and designing systems, not just for checking finished code.
- Hands-on experience with AI coding and agentic development. You should have used these tools substantially to build software and understand how to implement guardrails and validate their output, including their strengths and limitations.
- Hands-on experience building, deploying, and operating applications against a cloud provider, with AWS preferred. Experience with GCP or Azure is also relevant.
- Fast learning and strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar systems and work effectively with incomplete information.
- Experience working in a product-based environment with a strong product mindset — understanding not only how to build software, but also why it is being built and how it serves users.
NICE TO HAVE
- Open-source contribution experience, particularly sustained involvement in an existing project.
- Experience with distributed systems, storage, or protocol conformance.
- Deep AWS expertise.
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, CDK, or Pulumi.
- Experience with Kubernetes and microservices architecture.
- Experience in devtooling, cloud infrastructure, or a similar developer-focused product environment.

We provide liquidity across most cryptocurrency exchanges and trading platforms, a broad range of OTC trading solutions as well as supporting high profile blockchain projects and traditional financial institutions moving into crypto. Wintermute also has a Wintermute Ventures arm that invests in early stage DeFi projects.Wintermute was founded in 2017 and has successfully navigated industry cycles. Culturally, we combine the best of the two worlds: the technology standards of high-frequency trading firms in traditional markets and the innovative and entrepreneurial culture of technology startups. At Wintermute, we believe in the innovative potential of blockchain, the fundamental innovations, we have a long-term view on the digital asset market and are taking a leadership position in building an innovative and compliant market. You can read more here.
Working at Wintermute
We are looking for a C++ Quant Developer who is passionate about technology, interested in both low level details of how computer hardware operates and high-level design of large systems, as well as in data infrastructure. Someone who likes opening the hood to see how things work, has understanding of data structures, experience writing client-server network applications, and writing and optimising code for high performance. We welcome your previous experience from your own personal projects as well as commercial experience. PhD in maths is not uncommon for our Quant Developers, and at least a graduate level of maths skills is required.  Interest in algorithmic and quantitative trading is a plus.At Wintermute you will have an opportunity to grow and make direct impact on trading by developing and improving all the parts of the trading platform, data infrastructure and related software, while also getting advice and guidance from very experienced developers and traders, including the founders. You will get a lot of independence and responsibility right away, and you'll learn at an unprecedented speed! No legacy systems, no multiple levels of approvals, no bureaucracy; all developers report directly to CTO who is very hands on. It is up to you to make an impact!  You will work alongside exceptionally sharp colleagues, learn how to write fail-safe code and improve performance and scalability of the trading system, a real challenge and a rare opportunity! We have flexible working arrangements, it’s the productivity that matters. At least several days a week in the office with our own gym, unlimited food and drinks are required.
What will you work on
A great advantage of this position is that it is varied, and it is also up to you to shape it in the direction that matches your talents and company needs. The focus of the role would be to create data infrastructure to bring the analytics to the next level and support the scaling of quantitative trading. Projects may also include upgrading major trading system components, designing a completely new application from scratch, working on implementation of pricing models. We will share more technical details in the interviews. You will have opportunity to improve your knowledge of software optimisations, of building robust large-scale systems and to understand crypto currency trading.

Being in sales is a rewarding career. Doing so within Life Sciences where your technology can help improve the lives of millions is even better. Our Business Development Associates at ONI have just that opportunity. And more. We’re working with some of the brightest researchers in UK, Norway, Sweden, Finland and Denmark to bring our breakthrough Nanoimager technology to their work; work that’ll lead to their own breakthrough discoveries too.  Sales roles aren’t much more rewarding than that.
As an established target-hitting life sciences salesperson where the technology you sell is exceptional but still requires a deep understanding of how it will be deployed, and how it fits the wider research being undertaken. You’re used to being ‘out in the field’ but remaining connected to the business. Others know they can rely on your CRM records (in our case Salesforce) to have clear visibility of exactly where customers are in the pipeline.  And, of course, your forecasting is renowned for its accuracy regardless of how many opportunities you’re handling.
Reporting to our new Global Director of Sales your focus will be on the UK, Norway, Sweden, Finland and Denmark territory and your responsibilities are going to include:
Identifying customers in academia,  pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries using tender portals, CRM tools, customer references and other resources
Owning the sales cycles including lead generation, demonstrations and close of opportunities  to meet and exceed the territories
Working with leadership on development of annual sales strategy, providing input on ways to maximise revenue, efficiency and product opportunities
Keeping CRM updated with prospective and lost sales opportunities, customer interactions, demonstration outcomes, and market feedback
Representing voice of customer internally to Marketing and Customer Success teams, providing market feedback to influence strategy and product development
To be successful you’re going to need that strong track record of achieving your sales targets within the Life Science market, with a degree in that subject area.  What really sets you apart is your own scientific curiosity and credibility to listen, question and engage with researchers to understand their work and goals. Product pricing means our Nanoimagers are most often classified as ‘capex’ and you’re used to unit sales in the $150,000+ range. The thought of talking with scientists about how they’ll use our technology inspires you – as does their mission – but you’re equally as comfortable talking pricing and commercials with procurement teams.
So if you’re ready to help our breakthrough technology and make a breakthrough move in your career we should be talking….

ABOUT LILT
AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.
We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.
At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation https://www.linkedin.com/company/intel-corporation/, Canva https://www.linkedin.com/company/canva/, the United States Department of Defense https://www.linkedin.com/company/deptofdefense/, the United States Air Force https://www.linkedin.com/company/united-states-air-force/, ASICS https://www.linkedin.com/company/asics/, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.
About the Role:
As a Senior Technical Program Manager of Applied AI, you will sit at the intersection of cutting-edge research and industrial-scale execution. You will operate with an entrepreneurial mindset, effectively acting as the CEO of your customer's business to proactively drive success. You are responsible for leading complex benchmark transformations and data deliverables. Rather than just managing timelines, you are architecting workflows to ensure the next generation of LLMs and multimodal models are trained on the most accurate, diverse, and complex data available, while championing innovative solutions alongside our research lab partners.
- Entrepreneurial Benchmark Leadership: Act as the CEO of your customer’s business by proactively proposing and co-developing benchmark transcreations directly with research lab partners, ensuring our deliverables are innovative, tailored, and aligned with their core research objectives.
- Frontier Lab Program Management: Lead the end-to-end execution of high-priority technical programs for frontier AI labs, managing the delivery of massive-scale datasets and bespoke engineering milestones.
- High-Volume Data Operations: Architect and oversee pipelines for delivering high-volume data samples across multiple modalities (text, image, video, audio), ensuring strict adherence to delivery cadences without sacrificing precision.
- End-to-End Quality Control: Partner with production to implement rigorous, automated, and human-in-the-loop QC frameworks to ensure data integrity across various domains and languages.
- Cross-Functional Leadership: Bridge the gap between forward-deployed engineering resources, research, and production teams to ensure LILT can serve the needs of the frontier AI market.
QUALIFICATIONS
- Education: B.S or M.S. in Computer Science, AI, or a related technical field with 10+ years of industry experience. Equivalently, a Ph.D. with 5+ years of experience in a high-growth AI/Engineering environment.
- Entrepreneurial Mindset: Experience founding or scaling a venture, or operating in an early-stage startup environment where you drove business growth and strategic initiatives from the ground up.
- Strategic Execution: Strong business acumen and the ability to manage high-stakes stakeholder relationships with frontier AI labs.
- Frontier AI Expertise: Proven track record of managing data pipelines for LLMs or multimodal models. Deep understanding of training, inference, and the nuances of data diversity (multilingual and multi-domain).
- Scale & Quality: Demonstrated ability to manage "high-throughput" programs where quality control is mission-critical. You should have experience with automated validation at scale.
PREFERRED SKILLS
- Fluency in multiple human languages.
- Proficiency in Python and experience working with modern AI frameworks (PyTorch, LangChain, etc.).
What We Offer:
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technology in a rapidly growing industry.
- A dynamic and collaborative work environment.
- Significant opportunities for professional growth and development.
- The chance to make a real impact on global communication and business.
WHERE YOU’LL WORK
This position is based in our London, UK office and will be expected to work in the office in a hybrid capacity. Boston and Indianapolis are also acceptable locations. LILT is hybrid with hubs in SF, NY, Indianapolis, Boston, London, and Berlin.
Authorization to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment.
- London, UK (highly preferred)
- Others: Berlin, Boston, New York, Indianapolis
OUR STORY
Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.
LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.
With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.
OUR TECH
What sets our platform apart:
- Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent
- Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing
- 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation
- Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review
LILT IN THE NEWS
- Featured in The Software Report’s https://www.thesoftwarereport.com/the-top-100-software-companies-of-2024/ Top 100 Software Companies!
- LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List https://labs.lilt.com/lilt-listed-on-the-2024-inc-5000.
- LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents https://patents.justia.com/inventor/john-sturdy-denero that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.
- Check out all our news on our website https://lilt.com/news.

- Develop scalable full-funnel acquisition strategies that balance customer acquisition, revenue growth and long-term brand building.
- Translate commercial objectives into media investment strategies that maximise business performance across multiple markets.
Drive Performance & Optimisation
- Manage significant Google media budgets, developing quarterly investment plans and continuously optimising spend based on commercial priorities.
- Identify new growth opportunities through audience segmentation, creative testing, landing page optimisation and first-party data activation.
- Evaluate Google's latest AI-powered campaign types, automation capabilities and measurement innovations to maintain a competitive advantage.
- Champion a culture of experimentation through structured testing across bidding strategies, audiences, creative and landing experiences.
Creative Excellence
- Partner closely with Creative and Brand teams to develop high-performing YouTube and display creative that delivers measurable business outcomes.
- Produce clear creative briefs with defined objectives, audience insights and success metrics.
- Use creative testing frameworks to continuously improve campaign effectiveness and maximise return on media investment.
Collaboration & Leadership
- Work closely with Product, CRM, Analytics, Finance and Growth teams to deliver fully integrated customer acquisition strategies.
- Build strong relationships with Google, media agencies and technology partners, ensuring external partners consistently deliver against agreed KPIs.
- Support international expansion by adapting acquisition strategies for new markets and customer segments.
- Share best practices across the business and help evolve Omaze's performance marketing capabilities.

- We have an excellent Analytics and Data Science team - you will partner with them on robust measurement frameworks using GA4, attribution modelling, Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), incrementality testing and experimentation.
- Analyse campaign performance and customer behaviour to generate actionable insights that improve marketing effectiveness.
- Define KPIs and success measures that consistently evaluate campaign performance across markets.
- Present investment recommendations, campaign performance and strategic insights to senior leadership in a clear, commercially focused way.
🤩 ABOUT YOU
You'll probably have been called a Senior Performance Marketing Manager, Google Growth Manager, Paid Search Lead or Acquisition Lead—but whatever your title, you're passionate about using data, technology and creativity to drive measurable business growth.
You combine strategic thinking with deep platform expertise and enjoy turning commercial challenges into scalable acquisition opportunities.

- Significant experience managing large-scale Google Ads budgets in a high-growth B2C, subscription or eCommerce business.

Who We Are
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes all while raising money for the causes they love.
Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £100 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.
And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.
Why You’ll Love Working at Omaze
- Growth: Omaze is one of the fastest-growing companies in the world.
- Impact: Join a team of world changers dedicated to creating a ripple effect of good.
- Pioneering: Be part of something no one has done before.
- Culture: We work hard, grow together, and spread joy along the way.
🔑 What you'll be doing
As a Senior Mobile Engineer at Omaze, you take genuine ownership of the mobile experience our customers rely on and you care deeply about getting it right. React Native and Expo are your primary tools, and you're experienced enough with both to know their strengths, their limits, and when to reach beyond them. That's where your native knowledge comes in: whether it's Swift, Kotlin, or both, you're comfortable dropping into native code when the situation calls for it when it comes to performance, platform APIs, or something Expo just can't do out of the box. At Omaze, we are aiming for our app to not just be a utility but a premium experience.
🔧What You'll Be Doing
- Own the design, implementation, and testing of features across our TypeScript, React Native and Expo codebase, producing code that's performant, maintainable, and delivers a genuinely great user experience on both iOS and Android.
- Work closely with product and UX from the earliest stages of a feature, contributing to interaction and technical design decisions before they're hard to change.
- Own the quality of what you ship end-to-end: writing well-tested components, holding a high bar in code review, and taking responsibility for production behaviour.
- Contribute to release pipeline and EAS build and deployment workflows to help the team ship frequently, safely, and with confidence.
- Uphold and actively contribute to mobile engineering standards and best practices, patterns, performance budgets, and platform-specific conventions that keep the codebase healthy as it grows.
- Use AI-assisted and agentic coding tools as a natural part of your workflow, applying the same rigour and judgement to AI-generated code as you would to anything hand-written.
🤩 About You
- Passionate about mobile craft: you notice when an animation is 2ms off, when a transition doesn't feel quite right, or when a scroll list isn't as smooth as it should be and you do something about it.
- You understand that for a premium experience, performance is the product. You think about frame rates, responsiveness, and perceived speed not as nice-to-haves but as core quality requirements, and you have the tools and instincts to measure, diagnose, and raise the bar.
- Significant experience as a mobile engineer, with strong hands-on expertise in React Native and Expo, including EAS build and submission workflows.
- Experience working across iOS and Android within a shared React Native codebase, with a solid understanding of platform-specific behaviour and constraints.
- Native mobile experience in Swift (iOS) and/or Kotlin (Android) is desirable. You can read, write, and debug native code.
- Strong understanding of mobile performance. You know how to diagnose and fix issues across JS thread, native thread, and render pipeline.
- Experience with automated testing for mobile unit, integration, and end-to-end (e.g. Jest, Maestro, Appium).
- Familiar with App Store and Google Play submission, review processes, and release management.
- A collaborative, clear communicator who works well with product, UX, and backend engineers. You can translate mobile constraints into language the whole team understands.
🙌 What’s In It For You
- Generous stock options scheme
- 25 days annual leave PLUS Bank Holidays
- Private medical and dental insurance
- 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%
- A generous personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships
- Enhanced family leave policies
- Life assurance of 4x your salary
General Information
🌍 Location: Holborn, London
⭐ Office Policy: 3 days in person, 2 days at home each week

We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.
🔑 ABOUT THE JOB
Having launched the Million Pound House Draw in 2020, one of the UK’s fastest ever growing products that to date has raised over £150M for charity, Omaze is preparing to build and launch our next big thing. Designed to take our playbook of dream property prizes to new audiences we are seeking a talented and hungry marketeer to help us make it all happen.
Alongside the General Manager you will shape the new proposition and the strategy to bring it to a new audience defining that audience, positioning the brand and running the creative platform, launching the proposition, and creating a sustainable engine for both brand and commercial growth.
This is a rare opportunity to take something from zero to one and then build the operating rhythm that allows it to grow. You'll start by developing a deep understanding of the customer, defining our positioning and go-to-market strategy, and leading the launch. From there, you'll own the marketing approach for a regular cadence of new campaigns, using customer insight, brand signals and performance data to improve the proposition each time.
You won't have a large dedicated marketing team around you. Instead, you'll need to roll your sleeves up and get it all done, with support from specialists inside and outside of Omaze — including Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, Brand, PR, Analytics and Product — bringing it all together, delivering a clear strategy and executing brilliantly.
This role is ideal for someone who combines strong consumer marketing instincts, brand and creative judgement, commercial thinking and hands-on execution.
🔧 WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
BUILD THE GO-TO-MARKET STRATEGY
- Develop the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for a new Omaze proposition, from initial customer understanding through launch and scale.
- Define our priority audiences, their motivations and barriers, and the occasions that will drive participation.
- Define what this new product should stand for in customers' minds, how it should differentiate itself and how it should relate to the wider Omaze brand and product set.
- Develop the brand positioning, messaging architecture and creative platform that can build recognition, relevance and desire over time.
- Determine how the new proposition should relate to the broader Omaze brand and existing product portfolio - including driving incrementality
- Partner with Product, Commercial, Analytics and Research teams to shape decisions around the customer experience, offer and proposition.
- Build a clear acquisition and retention strategy, identifying the channels, messages and customer journeys most likely to drive sustainable growth.
- Translate strategy into measurable objectives, combining brand and commercial KPIs.
LEAD EVERY CAMPAIGN
- Own the marketing strategy and integrated campaign plan for each new property prize launch.
- Turn each new campaign into a compelling customer story with a clear audience, insight, proposition and creative brief.
- Ensure every individual property campaign strengthens the brand as well as delivering its immediate commercial objectives.
- Set a high creative bar and work closely with Creative teams to develop work that is distinctive, emotionally compelling and capable of building the brand over time.
- Lead the cross-functional marketing squad responsible for bringing campaigns to market.
- Partner with Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, PR, Social and other teams to deliver against the strategy.
- Ensure every customer touchpoint works together as one coherent campaign, from first impression through conversion and repeat participation.
- Make clear prioritisation and investment recommendations based on expected commercial impact.
BUILD THE PLAYBOOK
- Establish the processes, templates, measurement framework and operating cadence required to run campaigns repeatedly and efficiently.
- Track and develop our understanding of brand health alongside commercial performance, using measures such as awareness, consideration and customer perceptions where appropriate.
- Design and prioritise tests across audiences, propositions, messaging, creative, channels and customer journeys.
- Know when to experiment and optimise, and when consistency and creative conviction are more important than reacting to short-term campaign data.
- Build a strong understanding of what drives performance by customer segment and campaign type.
- Turn learnings from each campaign into improvements for the next, creating a compounding growth loop rather than starting from scratch each time.
- Bring customer insight and market intelligence back into the wider business to help shape the future product roadmap.
🤩 ABOUT YOU
We're less interested in a particular industry background than in finding someone who has the right attitude and has shown success at building consumer brands and growing new consumer propositions.
You'll probably have:
- Significant experience in consumer marketing, brand, growth or integrated marketing roles.
- Experience taking a new proposition, product or category from early-stage concept through launch and growth.
- Strong customer and commercial instincts: you can move comfortably between qualitative customer insight, proposition development and quantitative performance data.
- A strong understanding of how brand building and customer acquisition work together to create sustainable growth.
- Experience developing positioning, messaging, customer segmentation and integrated brand and marketing strategies.
- Strong experimentation instincts and experience using data to improve marketing performance over time, without becoming overly dependent on short-term performance signals..
- The ability to lead complex cross-functional work without needing direct reporting lines.
- Excellent briefing and communication skills, particularly with creative and channel specialists.
- Comfort operating in ambiguity and building processes where none yet exist.
- The judgement to know when something needs deep analysis and when it simply needs to get done.

This role is based out of our Amsterdam office 🇳🇱 or London office 🇬🇧
We are an office-first company & believe great products are made when we are together.
About Stacks
Stacks is building an AI-native platform that reinvents how modern finance teams run the monthly close. The opportunity is massive: every growing company depends on accurate, timely financial data, yet most are still operating with tools and workflows built for a different era.
In just two years, we’ve grown from a team of 2 to 30+ and are on a rapid trajectory. We’ve raised a $23m Series A led by Lightspeed Venture Partners https://stacks.ai/resources/stacks-raises-23-million-to-reinvent-finance-operations-with-agentic-ai, and we were recently recognised as one of Harmonic’s Hottest Startups of 2026 https://harmonic.ai/hot-25-companies/q2-2026.
We’re already trusted by leading European scale-ups including Pleo, Freetrade, and Motorway.
Our team is a blend of finance, product, and technical experts from top-tier companies like Uber, Plaid, Miro, Mollie, and Bunq, united by the drive to create a game-changing solution.
We’re a team that is deeply customer-obsessed, plays to win, and isn’t afraid to take big, bold bets. We move fast, hold a high bar, and are committed to growing together as we scale.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Stacks is looking for a fiercely ambitious, entrepreneurial, and commercially driven Accounting Engineer / Solutions Consultant to join our GTM team!
In this high-impact role, you’ll contribute to create and execute our GTM strategy at Stacks. If you’re excited by the idea of limitless growth and fast-paced challenges, this is a unique opportunity to accelerate your career as you help shape the future of Stacks.
🧱 WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Drive Solutions Engineering: Own the technical and accounting aspects of the sales and post-sales journey, from discovery and demos to implementation and optimization. You’ll regularly interact with Controllers, VPs of Finance, and CFOs.
- Accounting Expertise Meets Customer Focus: Leverage your deep accounting knowledge to advise prospective and existing customers on best practices & help them translate complex accounting workflows into solutions using Stacks.
- Sales Engineering Excellence: Partner with Sales, Customer Success & Engineering to lead technical discovery, deliver demos, and drive successful POCs that win deals.
- Seamless Implementation: Lead implementation for new customers, ensuring they are fully onboarded and confident in using the product to transform their monthly close process.
- Cross-functional Collaboration: Work directly with product and engineering to translate real-world accounting needs into product features and enhancements
- Strategic Growth: As an early team member, you’ll help define Solutions Engineering at Stacks, building playbooks, processes, and eventually future teammates.
🧩 WHAT YOU NEED
- 3–7 Years in Solutions Consulting: You've led technical sales cycles in a SaaS environment, and bring hands-on experience from an accounting or controller background.
- Accounting Domain Knowledge: You’ve worked in or closely with accounting teams, ideally as a Controller, CPA, or someone deeply familiar with the month-end close process, reconciliations, and reporting.
- Customer-Facing Confidence: Comfortable engaging with senior finance leaders and technical stakeholders alike. You know how to listen, challenge assumptions, and earn trust.
- Product Mastery: Quick to understand and explain complex systems. You’re able to turn accounting pain points into clear product solutions.
🚀 WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU
- Foundational role: Help shape a category-defining company from an early stage, working directly with founders and a small, high-agency team.
- Meaningful ownership: Competitive equity in a company scaling rapidly towards $10m ARR, where your impact will directly shape the outcome.
- Cutting-edge product and tech: Work at the intersection of AI and finance, building systems that fundamentally change how companies run their financial close.
- High-calibre team: Collaborate with people from companies like Uber, Plaid, Miro, and Mollie.
- Exceptional workspace: Our London HQ is based in Fora — a modern, design-led space in the heart of the city with access to a gym, classes, and an environment built for focused, in-person building
- Strong team culture: We run regular socials and off-sites that bring the team together properly, we recently have our 2-year anniversary party https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7452732855543259136/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAACQ1TQUB9bCcNVJHhIuwqSi-01DyuyrCVXE in Amsterdam, with board games, a tarot card reader and live music 🎶
🤝 THE HIRING PROCESS
- Step 1: 30-minute screening call with Farid (COO) to discuss your background, motivation, and experience
- Step 2: 30-minute conversation with Mickael (our Solutions Engineer) to dive deeper into your commercial and accounting background
- Step 3: Take-home and 1-hour on-site panel interview with our team at Stacks with Farid (COO) and Naman (Founding Product)
- Step 4: 30-minutes with Albert (our Founder)
- Step 5: Offer!

ABOUT THE ROLE
Stacks is hiring a sharp, technical and curious Founder Associate who understands finance and can explain complex financial concepts in clear terms.
You'll work directly alongside our CEO, Albert, and our Marketing Lead, Irina, shaping how Albert and Stacks are seen in the world. You'll own how we communicate, especially in the small moments that add up: a LinkedIn post, a line on the website, an event topic. You'll write in Albert's voice and build the AI workflows and automations that let one person do the work of a team.
If you read about AI and finance because you find it fascinating, love questioning experts until a complex idea clicks and then turning it into content people want to read, and automate anything you've had to do twice, this is the role for you.
🧱 WHAT YOU'LL DO
LINKEDIN AND SOCIAL
- Own Albert's and Stacks' LinkedIn accounts, drafting and publishing in Albert's voice
- Track the conversation across AI, finance and tech, and spot where Stacks has something worth saying
- Grow our follower base and engagement among CFOs and senior finance leaders
- Consistently publish high-quality micro-content that shows a deep understanding of our customers and the finance space
NARRATIVES AND EXPERT NETWORK
- Own the content narratives Stacks wants to be known for, and build a network of finance and accounting subject matter experts who fuel fresh ideas, sharper questions and new perspectives across everything we publish
- Bring that network to life through different channels: choosing guests and speakers, researching topics, writing questions and talking points, handling recording and event logistics, and turning every piece of content into clips, comms and follow-up content
- Work with sales so content shows up in deals and drives pipeline
AUTOMATION AND AI
- Build AI workflows and automations that turn one recording or idea into posts, clips and emails with minimal manual work
BEYOND COMMUNICATIONS AND GROWTH
Communications and growth are where you'll start, but they won't be the only thing you do. This role is constantly evolving with the company, and you'll pick up projects across the business as priorities shift. You are a Founder Associate: when you see a gap, you move toward it.
🧩 WHAT YOU NEED
- Technical instincts: you build with AI tools and automation platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n, Clay or similar), not just prompt a chatbot
- A voice on social: you enjoy writing for social, you have opinions, and you can pick up someone else's voice quickly
- Finance and commercial fluency: you follow AI, finance and tech closely. You're commercially sharp enough to hold your own in a conversation with a CFO.
- Speed: you ship fast, iterate in public and keep several workstreams running at once
- Low ego: you're happy for your best work to go out under someone else's name, and you get better with every edit
- Excellent written English: native or native-equivalent speaker
Bonus points: you've grown an audience, for yourself or someone else, or you've built something of your own.
🚀 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU
Foundational role: Work directly alongside the CEO and Marketing Lead at the centre of how Stacks tells its story and builds its presence in the market, from day one.
Ownership, not execution: This is a role where you set the strategy, build the plan, and own the result. You will not be handed briefs.
Trajectory: Previous Founder Associates at Stacks have moved into product and revenue functions. The ceiling is yours to set.
Cutting-edge product and tech: Work at the intersection of AI and enterprise finance, building something that fundamentally changes how companies run their financial close.
High-calibre team: Colleagues from Uber, Plaid, Google, and Miro, backed by Lightspeed, General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and operators from Stripe, Netflix, and OpenAI.
Compensation: Competitive salary, equity for all employees, and an annual performance bonus.

Step 2: Conversation with Irina, our Marketing Lead, about writing, voice and what's happening in the space.
