Please Note: B Lab is not working with a third party to fill this role an no part of our process requires applicants to pay fees. Applicants should only use our job board to submit an application, and will interact directly with our team during this process.

This is a Full-Time Role (40 hours per week, 5DWW) with no option for part-time work. While this is a remote-first opportunity, the candidate filling this role must be a resident of the Netherlands, the U.K., Brazil, Pennsylvania, or New York at the start of employment. Additionally, they must be within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam, London, São Paulo, Philadelphia, New York City. 
Please visit our Careers page to review all opportunities and submit your application for the role(s) that best fit your location and work authorization. This job ad will close automatically at 5:00pm EST on October 28th.

About the Team

Brand & Communications is responsible for B Lab's global brand, narrative, communication strategy, and reputation management. The department ensures a consistent, compelling, and mission-aligned public presence for B Lab across all channels, audiences, and markets, spanning strategic communications, public relations, brand identity, integrated campaigns, and digital channels. Brand & Communications plays a critical role in how B Lab is perceived and in how it builds and protects its reputation globally. The department sits within the Chief Impact & Movement Building Officer’s portfolio with Programs & Policy, Partnerships & Development, and Community & Movement, ensuring brand and communications strategy supports and amplifies the organization's wider mission and movement-building work.
Strategic Communications & PR shapes B Lab's public narrative and protects its reputation. The function manages media relations, storytelling, and crisis response, owning external messaging, media relationships, and reputation risk management. The function also provides strategic oversight of internal communications, ensuring coherence between B Lab's internal and external voice.

About the Role

The Communications & PR Manager owns B Lab's press office and earned media delivery, balancing proactive story pitching and thought leadership placement with reactive press response: building and holding journalist relationships, drafting and issuing statements and releases, and acting as first point of contact for incoming press inquiries across the global network.
Reporting to the Director, Strategic Communications, this role shapes and delivers the earned media plan within the Director's global communications strategy, editorial standards, and crisis protocols: leading proactive pitching, owning media monitoring and insights, and preparing spokesperson briefings. The role requires sound news judgment, comfort operating under time pressure during reactive moments, and the independence to run the press office and represent B Lab publicly on non-crisis media matters, escalating emerging reputational risk to the Director.
This role is highly collaborative with strong stakeholder management skills: works with market PR leads to amplify coverage, facilitate cross-team learning, and uplift regional news highlights; collaborates with the Digital Communications Coordinator and Copywriter to align messaging across earned, owned, and thought leadership channels; and complements Brand & Campaigns' work through media support.

 

Core Responsibilities 

Press Office & Media Relations [45%]

  • Oversee inbound media relations efforts, triaging and responding to press inquiries
  • Run proactive pitching and maintain media lists
  • Identify, cultivate, and maintain relationships with priority outlets, journalists, and writers to pitch for targeted coverage, in close collaboration with the Director
  • Pitch and place the thought leadership content, bylines, and narrative positioning that the Copywriter develops, securing earned-media coverage for it
  • Feed press insights, media trends, and real-time news judgment into B Lab's thought leadership strategy, flagging timely opportunities and emerging risks
  • Plan, write, and distribute proactive announcements and press releases, and maintain the press assets that support them, so B Lab's news reaches priority outlets
  • Lead drafting and coordination of reactive statements and press responses, aligning subject-matter leads and regional teams on the position and escalating emerging reputational risk to the Director


Writing & Speaker Support [25%]

Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

As a Mid Market Account Executive (200 - 1000+ employees) at Apollo.io, your primary focus will drive new business revenue across Apollo’s mid-market businesses. When leads come in from these companies, you will be the main point of contact to guide founders, Sales, and Operations professionals through their evaluation of Apollo’s all-in-one Sales platform, while offering consultative guidance to help them develop their pipeline generation strategy.

A day in the life…

Pipeline & Sales Process Execution 

  • Manage the entire sales process from initial conversation, trial management, negotiation, legal, and close with an average deal cycle of 60 days or less. 
  • Manage a pipeline of primarily inbound prospects to identify, engage, and develop relationships with potential buyers
  • Responsible for taking 4 net new meetings per day, running 20 meetings per week. 
  • Consistently create 3x pipeline coverage 
  • Achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly quotas 
  • Capable of time management and accountable to own your schedule to structure your day and accomplish - running initial meetings, showing a demo of our platform, salesforce.com hygiene and admin work, customer escalations, follow up meetings, pricing calls and various company calls and meetings.

Sales Strategy & Deal Management

  • Proficient in the sales process, and specifically the Discovery step. Asking questions to quantify the pain in a consultative way and actively listening to tie back to value and business driven outcomes.
  • Collaborate with businesses that have a minimum of 200 employees.
  • Communicate directly with Director and above level contacts primarily within the sales, marketing, and RevOps departments.
  • Clearly articulate and overview of your pipeline and deals in your funnel at each stage
  • Accurately predicting your most likely outcome within a 10% margin.

Mindset and Behaviors 

  • Bring your thinking, strategies, and ideas to advance our company’s values, unique culture, and vision for the future.
  • Engage as your unique self in a diverse, inclusive and high-performing team
  • Thrive in a competitive environment, embracing challenges, enjoying objection handling, and using setbacks as fuel to improve and win.
  • Have a positive outlook, a strong ability to take responsibility for successes and failures, and a relentless drive to keep improving.
  • Maintain a sharp focus on your goals and a belief that your daily, weekly and monthly activities will help achieve them
  • Possess a competitive spark, a hunger to win, and a determination to outperform in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.
  • Be a self-starter who proactively identifies opportunities, takes initiative, and stays motivated in the face of multiple objections and “no’s.”
  • Embody a team selling approach. Proactively engaging with leadership to support selling. 

Qualifications

  • Minimum 2-3 years of quota-carrying direct Account Executive experience 
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting targets, min of 3 trailing quarters
  • Use strong consultative selling skills to identify pain points and align Apollo use cases to solve customer challenges. Versed in Sandler, Command of the Message, MEDDPIC or similar. 
  • Ability to articulate Apollo’s value proposition with C-level executives, revenue teams, and decision makers
  • Ability to communicate, present to, and influence key stakeholders across both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Adaptable with the ability to pick up new technologies, assess situations quickly, and find smarter ways to achieve goals.
  • Coachable— loves to learn, receive feedback, and improve their skills.

We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

Apollo is building the definitive open GTM platform, and we're building the ecosystem to match. We're hiring our first dedicated partnerships hire in EMEA — someone to own the regional strategy, build the agency ecosystem from the ground up, advance our existing technology alliances across the region, and explore where reseller partnerships make sense country by country. This is not a role for someone who runs playbooks handed to them from HQ. The job is to write the EMEA playbook, execute it, and help us understand where the global strategy needs to bend to fit regional realities.

You will work in close alignment with Apollo's Head of EMEA Sales and operate as an equal partner in shaping how partnerships fits into the regional go-to-market. Equal parts builder, operator, and strategist — you'll need to move between long-range thinking and hands-on execution without losing altitude.

What you'll do:

1. Own Apollo's EMEA Partnerships Strategy

  • Develop and own the EMEA partnerships strategy, including where it diverges from US or global priorities based on market dynamics, buyer behavior, and the regional competitive landscape
  • Serve as the primary voice of the EMEA ecosystem internally, advising cross-functional stakeholders on where the global strategy fits, where it doesn't, and what needs to be built locally
  • Partner closely with Apollo's Head of EMEA Sales to ensure the partnerships strategy ladders to regional revenue goals and is genuinely integrated into how the EMEA team goes to market
  • Track and report on partner-influenced pipeline and revenue across the region; use that data to prioritize where to invest time and push for executive decisions

2. Build the EMEA Agency Ecosystem

  • Build Apollo's agency partner program in EMEA from scratch — identifying, recruiting, and onboarding high-potential GTM, RevOps, and AI-native agencies across key markets
  • Enable agency partners to build differentiated practices around Apollo, with a focus on helping them generate real revenue from the relationship through services delivery, customer co-sell, and Apollo's demand-routing programs
  • Develop the enablement, capability verification, and matchmaking infrastructure needed to put agencies in front of the right Apollo customers — with the goal of driving retention and expansion in the installed base, not just new-logo sourcing
  • Work with the global agency team to translate and adapt the GTME certification program and playbooks for the EMEA context

3. Advance Strategic Technology Alliances Regionally

  • Own the regional execution of Apollo's CRM and technology partner relationships (Salesforce, HubSpot, and others) — working with global alliance owners to unlock co-sell motion in EMEA and connect Apollo's field reps with counterpart partner reps in the region
  • Identify integration and co-sell opportunities that improve Apollo's ability to compete and win in EMEA mid-market and enterprise accounts
  • Explore and evaluate where net-new strategic alliances make sense for EMEA distribution, building business cases for investment when the opportunity is real

4. Explore and Develop Reseller Partnerships

  • Assess where reseller partnerships make commercial sense in specific EMEA markets, particularly in countries where direct coverage is thin or where local distribution partners can accelerate Apollo's reach
  • Define the commercial model, partner criteria, and enablement requirements for any reseller motion; build the first partnerships if there's a clear path, and bring in the right internal stakeholders to support it
  • Be honest about where reseller adds leverage and where it adds complexity — this is a charter to explore, not an assumption that it's the right model everywhere

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years in technology partnerships, alliances, or channel roles with significant EMEA market experience
  • Demonstrated experience building a partner program or regional partnerships function from an early stage, not just managing an inherited book
  • Comfortable working across multiple partner types: agency/SI relationships, technology alliances, and channel or reseller models
  • Track record of driving partner-influenced or partner-sourced revenue in a commercial-facing role
  • Strong instincts about how GTM motions differ across EMEA markets and how to adapt a global playbook accordingly
  • Experience working in close partnership with regional sales leadership; you earn trust with a sales organization by making deals move, not by managing relationships in a vacuum
  • Based in EMEA; fluency in English required, additional European language a plus

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Salesforce and/or HubSpot partner programs in an EMEA context
  • Familiarity with the EMEA agency and RevOps ecosystem
  • Prior experience at a high-growth B2B SaaS company with a product-led or sales-led motion

job-boards.greenhouse.io/banyansoftware/.description_excerpt:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

 

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact opportunity to work directly alongside one of Banyan’s seasoned Operating Leaders, each overseeing a portfolio of software businesses in a buy, hold and grow investment model. As Chief of Staff, you become a trusted right hand to your Operating Leader and a close working partner to the CEOs and functional leaders across their companies.

The role is deliberately broad. Rather than a fixed rotation, you will move across multiple operating companies and business problems: shaping a go-to-market plan for one company, improving customer onboarding at another, or standing up the first 100 days of a newly acquired business. You will gain exposure to software M&A, but the core of the job is hands-on value creation and operating work. You own initiatives end to end.

The Executive Leadership Program (ELP) runs two years. Development is intentional. You will work through a range of experiences spanning go-to-market, M&A, customer, and finance priorities portfolio-wide, plus gain hands-on leadership reps, with regular check-ins and development opportunities to ready you for your next role. High performers move from the ELP program into a CEO or C-suite role within a Banyan operating company, or into a leadership role at Banyan Software HQ.

For those who want to learn how great vertical software businesses are built and run, and who want the fastest path available to running one themselves, this is the job.

What You’ll Gain

  • A cohort of high-calibre peers. You grow and learn alongside other ELPs at Banyan, building a long-term network of future operators.
  • Direct apprenticeship with senior operators. You will work very closely with an Operating Leader and see first-hand how experienced leaders make decisions across different software businesses.
  • Dedicated development support. External executive coaching in Year 2, plus mentorship from Operating Leaders with decades of software experience.
  • The fastest track we offer to running a business. High performers move directly from this program into a C-suite seat inside a Banyan operating company or a leadership role at HQ. It is not guaranteed, performance decides placement, but it is the first place Banyan looks when those seats open and we have a strong track record of placing CEOs through our ELP.
  • Real operating reps, not case reps. You carry a genuine initiative inside a live business and leadership-level stretch assignments, decisions that show up in a P&L.

What You Will Own

Portfolio Value Creation

  • Partner with CEOs and functional leaders across multiple operating companies to identify priorities and implement the Banyan Operating System, turning strategy into measurable operational improvements.
  • Lead high-impact, cross-functional projects across product, go-to-market, sales, marketing, pricing, and customer success as the right hand to Leader.

M&A and Integration

  • Gain exposure to Banyan’s acquisition process, including value-creation plan framing during diligence.
  • Support integration planning and onboarding for newly acquired businesses, helping establish operating rhythms and priorities while respecting what already makes each business work.
  • Help execute the value-creation plan once a deal closes, turning the diligence thesis into the specific operating bets a business needs to win in year one.

Executive Partnership

About Berkeley Myles Group:

Berkeley Myles Group has recently brought Javelin into the business, bringing together two established manufacturing software providers under one roof. The Role:

This is a new role for Berkeley Myles — created to build a dedicated Account Management function from the ground up. As Key Account Manager, you’ll own and grow our entire existing customer base (700+ SME manufacturers) once integrated, focused on retention, licence expansion and module growth.

You’ll work with production, operations, finance and IT stakeholders inside SME manufacturing businesses — helping them get more value from the system they already run, and identifying where additional modules, users or capability can support their growth.

You report directly to the Commercial Director, and will play a central role in shaping how Berkeley Myles does account management going forward. You’ll carry clear commercial targets across retention, renewal and expansion revenue, set by the Commercial Director and reviewed regularly. We’re not looking for someone who manages relationships and waits for renewals to happen; we’re looking for someone who goes after the number. You will:

  • Own and grow the full customer base (700+ SME manufacturers) across
  • motorsport, aerospace, defence, electronics and beyond
  • Build trusted relationships with production, operations, finance and IT stakeholders within existing accounts
  • Develop and execute account plans focused on retention, licence expansion and module growth
  • Lead commercial conversations on renewals, upsell and expansion — owning the numbers behind them
  • Consistently meet or exceed the quarterly and annual retention and expansion revenue targets set for
  • the role
  • Identify growth opportunities within accounts, working with Support, Implementation and Product to drive adoption and uncover expansion potential

About LEVL Telematics:

LEVL Telematics is a leading UK and European fleet telematics provider and a Geotab Elite Partner — a status held by only a small number of partners worldwide. We deliver connected-vehicle intelligence, compliance and workflow solutions to commercial fleets ranging from national OEM programmes to owner-operated businesses, across sectors including commercial vehicles, waste management, utilities and cold chain.

What sets LEVL apart is depth, not just data: multi-OEM device aggregation, UK and EU regulatory expertise (DVSA, FORS, DVS, tachograph and driver-hours compliance), and integration of telematics into customers' downstream operational workflows. We are part of Banyan Software, a buy-and-hold acquirer of enterprise software businesses, which gives LEVL long-term ownership stability and access to a growing portfolio of sister companies in the UK, Europe and North America — including active cross-sell opportunities in Italy and in cold-chain monitoring.

The fleet telematics market is at an inflection point. Agentic AI is moving from marketing language to shipped product, connected-vehicle volumes continue to grow, and fleet operators are consolidating suppliers. That creates a genuine opportunity for a commercially-led partner with deep integration and compliance capability — and it is why we are investing in sales leadership now.

The Role:

We are hiring a VP Sales to own the revenue function end to end. This is a build role, not a caretaker role. You will inherit an established customer base, a strong OEM and channel footprint, and live pipeline — and you will be expected to design, hire and lead your own team, structured around dedicated new-business (hunter) and account-growth (farmer) motions.

You will report directly to the CEO, sit on the leadership team, and carry personal accountability for the company's revenue number. In the near term you will sell as well as lead: this is a player-coach role until your team is built and performing.

Key Responsibilities:

Team build and leadership

  • Design the sales organisation: define the hunter/farmer split, role profiles, territories or segment ownership, and headcount plan with supporting business case.
  • Recruit, onboard and develop your own team, including setting activity standards, ramp expectations and a documented playbook for each role.
  • Manage and develop the existing sales team members, with clear objectives, structured 1:1s and honest performance management.

New business (hunter motion)

  • Personally lead flagship and strategic pursuits, including multi-stakeholder, multi-year OEM and framework opportunities.
  • Build repeatable outbound and channel-sourced pipeline rather than relying on inbound and referral flow.

Account growth (farmer motion)

  • Establish structured account management for the existing base: retention, contract renewal, hardware refresh cycles, and expansion into adjacent products (cameras, cold chain, compliance modules, AI-enabled workflow).
  • Protect and grow strategic OEM and key accounts, with executive-level relationship ownership and formal account plans.
  • Drive cross-sell across the Banyan portfolio where LEVL customers and sister-company capabilities overlap.

Commercial rigour

  • Own the number: forecast accuracy, pipeline coverage ratios, and win-rate improvement, reported monthly to the CEO and quarterly to the Banyan portfolio team.
  • Enforce a disciplined qualification methodology in HubSpot — every forecast deal must have a scored business case, mapped power and influence, a close plan and a compelling event. No exceptions, including your own deals.
  • Work with marketing to align lead generation, campaign focus and partner co-marketing (including Geotab MDF) to pipeline targets.
  • Contribute to pricing, packaging and commercial policy, including multi-year and usage-based structures.

  • Proven B2B sales leadership in telematics, fleet technology, SaaS, IoT or an adjacent connected-hardware-plus-software market, with personal ownership of a revenue number of meaningful scale.
  • A track record of building a team — you have hired, ramped and managed hunters and farmers, not just inherited an existing organisation.
  • Demonstrable personal selling ability at enterprise level: complex, multi-stakeholder deals with long cycles and formal procurement.
  • Genuine command of sales process and CRM discipline — qualification methodology, forecast hygiene and pipeline maths are second nature, and you hold teams to them.
  • Comfortable operating as a player-coach in a growing SME: hands-on, low-ego, and effective without a large support function around you.
  • Knowledge of the UK/EU commercial fleet landscape: OEMs, leasing and rental, compliance regimes (DVSA, FORS, DVS, tachograph), and channel/reseller dynamics.
  • Experience selling recurring-revenue propositions with a hardware component, including renewals and refresh economics.

  • Experience in private-equity or long-term-hold ownership environments, and comfort with portfolio-level reporting.

About Digital Asset & the Canton Network

Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. Uniquely combining privacy, compliance, and scalability, Canton enables real-time, secure settlement across multiple asset classes. Governed by the Canton Foundation with participation from leading financial institutions, it is the proven link between the promise of blockchain and the power of global finance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney— we are on a mission to transform finance— and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

The Senior CX Software Engineer is a role for people  with prior experience and exposure to distributed computing, Canton Network or our product. These individuals are able to stand in front of a client to provide sound advice without support, and to work effectively on components implementation as  one of the team when working with clients on client solutions. They can engage confidently with their senior leadership.

About the role:

As the Documentation Lead for Canton Network, you will serve as the guardian of the ecosystem's knowledge, owning and maintaining world-class documentation as the single source of truth for the entire community. You will sit within the Education vertical and work to ensure that every builder has the resources they need to successfully build on Canton.

Responsibilities:

  • You will go beyond simple editing and actively manage the documentation strategy to deflect support tickets and accelerate developer onboarding. Your success will be defined by the content's digestibility and discoverability, ensuring developers can find answers quickly and independently. You will collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to keep documentation synchronized with rapid release cycles while also leveraging ecosystem partners to scale content production.
  • Own, maintain, and evolve world-class documentation that serves as the single source of truth for the Canton ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to drive feedback loops to ensure documentation stays synchronized with the latest software release cycles.
  • Produce and maintain Canton’s developer docs, including conceptual docs, tutorials, guides, upgrade notes, SDK/API documentation, etc.
  • Monitor and improve documentation SEO and searchability to minimize "no result" queries and close content gaps.
  • Leveraging LLM-enhanced search tools and search analytics to identify content gaps where users are asking questions but finding no documentation.
  • Analyze documentation metrics including drop-off rates, heatmaps, and sentiment feedback to continuously optimize the information architecture and content flow.
  • Work to increase the Deflection Rate by proactively solving user issues through clear documentation and reducing the volume of support tickets coming into Sales and Client Experience.
  • Collaborate with ecosystem partners and vendors to expand documentation coverage and quality.
  • Support the Evangelism team by providing accurate technical content to inform outreach and advocacy efforts.
  • Maintain the documentation repository architecture, including automated deployments via GitHub Actions and a single source of truth.

What We're Looking For:

  • You are obsessed with clarity and know that good documentation is the difference between a developer adopting a tool or abandoning it.
  • You have proven experience as a technical writer or technical writing lead, including managing writers and driving documentation strategy.
  • You have experience treating documentation as a product by tracking usage, sentiment, and success metrics like ticket deflection to prove ROI.
  • You have a strong technical aptitude and can read code and work closely with engineers to translate complex technical concepts into accessible guides.
  • You are data-driven and comfortable using tools like Google Analytics or heatmaps to identify where developers are getting stuck.
  • You have experience working in a fast-paced environment where software updates are frequent and you know how to keep docs from going stale.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.

Responsibilities:

  • Owns the technical narrative for strategic prospective and early-stage clients — translates a prospect's problem statement into a working Canton Network prototype, registry model, or demo application in days to weeks, not quarters
  • Designs and builds prototype and demo code on Canton and Daml — smart contracts, registry apps, DA Registry and DA Utilities components, integration adapters — that hold up to technical scrutiny from engineers at the world's largest banks, financial market infrastructures, and crypto-native and stablecoin companies

  • Knowledge and experience with Daml, Canton Network and ability to ramp up quickly

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

The role

As Associate Legal Counsel (5 to 8 years of PQE), you will focus on a number of legal areas and advise UK teams across the business. You will take a consultative approach and work closely with the business - never working alone, or able to concentrate on purely legal issues. As a member of a busy legal team you will also be expected to contribute to team-wide initiatives. 

For people with more senior experience, we are open to look into a Sr. Legal Counsel title.

The key responsibilities of this role include:

    • Support and advise the Partner team and negotiate strategic Partner deals 
    • Support and advise the Go-To-Market teams in the UK on the most strategic and/or highest value deals
    • Work closely with your manager to support on strategic projects
    • Work on specific projects, for example when we roll out new templates/launch new products
    • Review and negotiate customer, partnership and supplier contracts by providing pragmatic and commercial support
    • Supervise more junior lawyers on negotiations or on specific files
    • Instruct and manage external legal counsel
    • Build out and maintain self-help tools, playbooks and guides for the legal team and for the wider business 
    • Focus on constant process improvement related to high volume work - for example by iterating our contracting automation and management workflows
    • Be prepared to deal with any legal issue, at any time.

Desired skills

We’re looking for a lawyer with private practice training and/or in-house experience in a fast-paced environment. You will be driven, able to work independently and able to apply your existing knowledge and approach across a very wide range of legal (and quasi-legal) areas. As a technology business, it helps if you have had experience in a similar area, or perhaps you have a keen interest in tech outside of your day to day work.

Candidates must be qualified in the UK.

  • You have experience negotiating complex contracts with sophisticated counterparties
  • You have experience reviewing marketing materials in accordance with applicable laws and regulations
  • You grasp new legal concepts quickly, and are not afraid to use your common sense.
  • You are able to appropriately challenge ways of working and not be afraid to ask why.
  • You are a self-starter who is proactive and you are willing to roll up your sleeves to get the job done. 
  • Your communication skills are first class, and you are able to distil complex and cumbersome legalese into understandable English.
  • You love tech and tools, and love exploring how they can contribute to efficiency and customer experience.  
  • You enjoy project management and thrive on operational efficiency.
  • You are easy to work with, do not take yourself seriously and want to work in a fun, fast-growing and challenging environment.

 

Bonus points if:

  • You have knowledge of FCA requirements or payment services.
  • You have experience in IP management and handling IP related issues.
  • You have experience with selling and supporting SaaS solutions.
  • You can explain what an API is.

 

Base salary range: £64,000  - £96,000

The Associate Director of Regulatory Affairs Strategy will serve as an EU Regional Lead for our mid/late-stage CNS programs and may have the opportunity to be the Regulatory Program Lead for early programs in Alnylam pipeline.  The will work on assigned programs with the respective Global Regulatory Portfolio Lead, Global Regulatory Lead and cross-functional team to lead the EU regulatory strategy and facilitate submission of data packages to the EMA.  The role is responsible for planning and coordinating all aspects of regulatory submissions necessary to support product development, clinical trials and product registration. The role will represent RA on multidisciplinary product development subteams and Global Regulatory Team. Additional responsibilities include involvement in the writing and oversight of regulatory submissions, coordinating all aspects of paper and electronic regulatory submissions, proactively keeping updated on EU regulatory requirements, and interpreting regulatory intelligence for the internal teams.

Summary of Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as EU Regional Lead for assigned program (s); additional responsibilities may include serving as as Regulatory Program Lead (leading the Global Regulatory Team), for one of the early programs in the Alnylam pipeline.
  • Work with the Global Regulatory Lead and Regulatory Affairs management to lead and define regulatory strategy and to compile and submit, in a timely manner, regulatory documents according to regulatory requirements and lead EU HA interactions. Regulatory documents may include the relevant forms, meeting requests, Briefing Documents for HA meetings, new Clinical Trial Applications (CTAs), Marketing Applications, Paediatric Plans, Orphan Designation and Expedited Pathway Applications (e.g. PRIME), and any amendments.
  • Develop detailed regulatory strategy and project plans and support regulatory activities relating to specific portfolio of products/projects.
  • Serve as member of the Global Regulatory Team, may serve as Regulatory representative in multidisciplinary product subteams or core team for assigned programs and participate as an active team member to provide strategic regulatory advice in relation to EU regulatory activities.
  • Coordinate responses to regulatory authorities’ questions with strict adherence to deadlines.
  • Serve as a liaison within internal departments at Alnylam, with CROs and with regulatory program managers at HAs.
  • Maintain regulatory files in a format consistent with internal requirements.
  • Facilitate as necessary the review of technical regulatory documentation and recommend changes to documentation or processes, including SOPs for regulatory compliance.
  • Provide EU specific regulatory intelligence to internal stakeholders as appropriate.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree with 6 or more years of experience in a Regulatory Affairs role; minimum of 8 years’ experience working in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry. Higher degree would be a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including negotiation and influencing skills.
  • Solid understanding of regulations and experience in interpretation of guidelines.
  • Ability to think strategically and to proactively identify issues and mitigation strategies in various aspects of the drug development process.
  • Experience with regulatory filings, including electronic submissions, e.g., CTAs, post-marketing variations, safety reporting, paediatric plans, PRIME etc.
    • MAA filing and Type II variation experience is preferred.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills; demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple projects.
  • Ability to work in a team environment, possessing interpersonal skills to work effectively with other departments at various levels and with CROs and external consultants.
  • Technical system skills (e.g. word processing, spreadsheets, databases, online research) including submission-ready formatting.
  • Clear alignment with Alnylam Core Values including:
    • Commitment to People,
    • Fiercely Innovative,
    • Purposeful Urgency,
    • Open Culture, and
    • Passion for Excellence.

Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality.

By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients.

The Clinical Operations and Regulatory Affairs Placement offers broad experience across the Clinical Operations and Regulatory Affairs functions, to those completing an Industrial Placement as part of their degree course. You will support cross-functional initiatives that help deliver the UK and Ireland business strategy, while developing an understanding of how different functions work together towards shared goals. The role is suited to a curious and collaborative individual with strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to think critically.

 The successful candidate will be based at Alnylam’s Maidenhead office, with a minimum of x2 days per week working at that location.

Summary of Key Responsibilities – Clinical Operations 

  • Support the organisation, maintenance and updating of clinical trial tracking systems and tools throughout a clinical study lifecycle, from study start-up through to close-out
  • Assist with the development and maintenance of study management tools, monitoring tools, study manuals, training materials and presentations
  • Support the scheduling of study team meetings and assist with the preparation and distribution of agendas, meeting minutes and follow-up action items.
  • Set up, organise and maintain clinical trial study files and hared electronic workspaces in accordance with study requirements and company procedures
  • Assist with the coordination and tracking of study training activities and associated training records
  • Support the maintenance of clinical trial documentation, including filing and performing routine quality checks to ensure documents are complete and accurate
  • Assist with the timely, complete and compliant filing and archiving of essential documents within the electronic Trial Master File (eTMF)

  • Assist with the preparation, review and maintenance of study-specific documents and materials used to support clinical trial conduct
  • Prepare and maintain clinical development presentations, reports, study status updates and other materials for internal and external meetings
  • Collaborate with Clinical Operations, cross-functional study team members and external vendors including Contract Research Organisations to identify, communicate and help address study-related issues

  • Assist with basic clinical trial financial or budget tracking activities where appropriate

  • Support Global and Regional Regulatory Leads with assigned programmes to contribute to global and regional regulatory strategy
  • Assist with preparation, compilation, and submission, in a timely manner, of regulatory documents according to regulatory requirements. Regulatory documents may include cover letters, application forms, Health Agency meeting requests, Briefing Documents for Health Authority (HA) meetings, Clinical Trial Applications (CTAs) and components of Marketing Authorisation Applications

Overview

Alnylam Pharmaceuticals is seeking an imaginative physician drug developer. This is an opportunity to provide clinical leadership in developing RNAi therapeutics in Alnylam’s rapidly expanding portfolio, which spans the areas of rare genetic diseases, cardio-metabolic diseases, neuroscience, hematology and hepatology.

The successful candidate’s primary role will be to drive the pipeline forward through leadership of clinical development programs.  While the primary focus responsibility will be as clinical lead physician on Alnylam’s Huntington’s program, the role may support across a range of therapeutic areas and all stages of development may be required as pipeline assets evolve. The Sr. Director is expected to play a leading and influencing role in the overall clinical development strategies and drive progress and operational excellence for associated clinical trials. In addition, this role will include interaction with Alnylam’s research group, helping to advise the team on the clinical development feasibility of novel targets and the design of proof-of-concept studies. This work will also involve extensive consultation and collaboration with external experts. It is expected that additional opportunities will arise to lead bench-to-bedside early phase clinical development programs.

The Senior Director, Clinical Research, will work in a matrix organization across Regulatory, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, Preclinical, Commercial & QA teams to ensure fully harmonized and integrated development strategies. They will be a key Alnylam Development spokesperson at external meetings, including regulatory interactions and scientific meetings.

This position is hybrid and will be primarily located at our Cambridge, MA headquarters or Maidenhead, UK location.

Key Responsibilities

  • Be the strategic leader providing a strong, clear voice for the clinical programs
  • Develop creative but realistic approaches to drug development and lead clinical efforts to secure global regulatory approvals
  • Oversight of trial conduct and safety
  • Provide strategic consultation and guidance to Research on all decisions that have significant clinical components and implications. 
  • Collaborate closely with Preclinical, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs and Commercial to ensure tight strategic integration of product development plans
  • Be accountable via Clinical Research and Operations for all relevant timelines and deliverables
  • Drive/supervise all major written deliverables (regulatory submissions, original articles, abstracts), and presentation materials
  • Be responsible (as appropriate in line with SOPs) for final review and sign off with respect to all controlled documents including protocols, IBs, informed consent forms
  • Influence internal and external audiences in a high impact, highly visible fashion

Qualifications

  • MD with strong research background or MD PhD, with a track record of successful research support and peer review publications. Board Certification (or equivalent) or specialist training is highly desirable; drug development experience in neurology (Huntington’s Disease) would be a great advantage, but not essential
  • 10+ years industry experience or equivalent clinical academic experience
  • Sound scientific and clinical judgment
  • Successful track record of leading Phase 2/3 clinical programs (preferably in Huntington’s drug development), including major interactions with Health Authorities

  • Experience and knowledge of working with biotech/pharma partner(s) a plus
  • Thrives in highly entrepreneurial biotech environment and embraces Alnylam’s culture of science, passion and urgency.

About the Role
We are looking for a Senior or Lead Gameplay Animator with strong AAA FPS experience to help shape responsive, compelling character movement and moment-to-moment gameplay.
With a focus on Character, Controls, and Camera (3C), you will combine animation craft with practical implementation skills to develop features from early prototypes through final in-game polish. Working closely with gameplay designers, programmers, and technical animators, you will help ensure that character animation, player input, and camera behavior work together to deliver a cohesive player experience.
This is a hands-on role with meaningful ownership of gameplay animation features and opportunities to influence the systems and workflows behind them.

What You’ll Do

  • Own gameplay animation features from concept to completion, including reference gathering, prototyping, asset creation, engine integration, debugging, and polish.
  • Create high-quality character movement and action animations, covering locomotion, directional changes, stance transitions, traversal, and combat interactions.
  • Contribute to first-person animation and its relationship with full-body movement, weapon handling, and camera feedback.
  • Partner with designers and programmers to refine movement responsiveness, action timing, transitions, and interruption behavior while preserving believable weight and physicality.
  • Build and refine animation graphs, state machines, blend setups, and animation layers within the project’s engine and tools.
  • Use keyframe animation and motion-capture workflows to deliver animation that meets gameplay and visual requirements.
  • Evaluate your work in playable builds, identify the causes of animation issues, and collaborate across disciplines to resolve them.
  • Work with technical animation and engineering teams to improve workflows and address runtime, asset, and production constraints.
  • For Lead-level appointments, guide feature planning, establish animation quality benchmarks, provide actionable feedback, and mentor teammates while continuing to create and implement animation directly.

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience creating and implementing gameplay animation for AAA first-person shooters, with clear ownership of features or animation systems.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating body mechanics, weight, timing, posing, and a clear understanding of responsive gameplay animation.
  • Practical experience taking animation assets into a game engine and iterating on their behavior in playable builds.
  • Working knowledge of animation graphs, state machines, blending, additive animation, and gameplay-driven transitions.
  • An understanding of how character movement, player controls, and camera behavior influence each other and shape game feel.
  • Proficiency in professional animation tools, with experience in keyframe animation and motion-capture editing.
  • The ability to investigate animation problems, explain their likely causes, and work with design and engineering partners to deliver effective solutions.
  • Strong ownership, clear communication, and a consistent record of delivering work within production constraints.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Hands-on experience on recent AAA FPS productions with a high standard of player movement, first-person animation, and combat responsiveness.
  • Direct involvement in establishing or evolving 3C animation systems, particularly from early development through production.
  • Additional experience on AAA action or action-adventure games involving sophisticated traversal, melee combat, or character interactions.
  • A technical animation background that enables you to understand and resolve issues across animation assets, runtime systems, and gameplay logic.
  • Experience with techniques such as inverse kinematics, motion matching, procedural animation, motion warping, or animation retargeting.
  • Scripting or tool-development experience that improves animation workflows and iteration speed.
  • Experience maintaining consistency between first-person presentation and third-person character animation.

Senior / Lead Expectations
Senior: Independently own complex animation features, make sound creative and technical decisions, and drive implementation and polish with cross-disciplinary partners.
Lead: Combine strong individual delivery with the ability to guide others, align animation work with gameplay goals, and maintain quality across interconnected features.
We also welcome high-potential candidates with relevant production experience and exceptional portfolios who demonstrate the ability to grow into broader ownership. Level will reflect demonstrated capability and contribution.
Location & Working Arrangement
Relocation to China is preferred. Remote arrangements may be considered based on location, time-zone compatibility, and collaboration needs.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity:
NetEase is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity in its workforce. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We also comply with applicable federal, state, and local laws regarding applicants with criminal histories. If you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any part of the application process, please email globaltalent@service.netease.com.

Data Privacy 

In order to administer our recruiting process, we collect and process certain information including personal information. For further information on what personal information we collect, how we use it and process it, please see our Candidate Privacy Notice.

You’ll bring together financial and operational data to develop a clear point of view on business performance. Whether assessing an investment opportunity, understanding movements in EBITDA, challenging a forecast or evaluating performance across products and markets, we’ll expect you to turn your analysis into recommendations that help the business make better decisions.

The difference at this level is what you do with that information: connecting the dots, influencing senior stakeholders and helping turn insight into action.

Your Impact:

  • Be a trusted Finance Business Partner to our iGaming leadership, building a deep understanding of the business and using financial insight to challenge, influence and support commercial decision-making.
  • Turn performance into action, analysing the P&L as well as operational and commercial KPIs to identify the underlying drivers of performance and recommend what the business should do next.
  • Shape investment and commercial decisions, building financial models, business cases and scenario analysis to assess opportunities, trade-offs, risks and returns and help determine where we should invest our resources.
  • Own and continuously improve forecasting and planning, bringing together financial, operational and commercial assumptions to create robust forecasts while constructively challenging the assumptions behind them.
  • Proactively identify opportunities and risks, using data and your understanding of the business to surface issues early, investigate their root causes and drive conversations around potential actions.
  • Influence through insight, presenting clear recommendations to senior finance and non-finance stakeholders and being comfortable constructively challenging established thinking when the data points to a different conclusion.
  • Drive better decision-making across the Gaming business, partnering with Product, Commercial, Marketing and Data teams to connect financial performance with the operational decisions behind it.
  • Raise the standard of FP&A, identifying opportunities to improve our models, reporting, processes and use of data so Finance can spend less time producing information and more time influencing decisions.

 

What You'll Bring:

  • A fully qualified accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) alongside strong FP&A or Commercial Finance experience.
  • Demonstrable experience operating as a Finance Business Partner, working with senior non-finance stakeholders and influencing commercial decisions.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to move beyond explaining the numbers to developing a clear point of view and recommending a course of action.
  • Examples of where your analysis has directly influenced a decision, investment, change in direction or improvement in business performance.
  • Strong financial modelling, forecasting and scenario-planning capability, with advanced Excel skills and the confidence to build and interrogate models independently.
  • Strong understanding of P&L and EBITDA performance and the ability to connect financial outcomes with operational and commercial drivers.
  • The confidence to constructively challenge senior stakeholders, test assumptions and ask difficult questions while building strong, trusted relationships.
  • A proactive and curious approach, you don’t wait to be asked for analysis when you can see an opportunity, risk or question worth investigating.
  • The ability to take complex financial and operational information and communicate the key message and recommendation clearly and concisely.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, commercially complex environment; experience within iGaming, gaming, digital media, technology or another data-rich consumer business would be advantageous.

Position Overview:

The Director, Product Marketing will own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for Diligent Boards, driving positioning, messaging, product launches, market intelligence, sales enablement, pricing and packaging, and customer adoption across key segments and regions. 

We are looking for a strategic B2B SaaS product marketer with strong technical aptitude who can translate complex technology into compelling customer value. The ideal candidate has experience in a SAAS technology company. Exposure to product-led growth (PLG) is highly valuable. 

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, AI/Data, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Enablement, Finance, and senior leadership to identify market opportunities, influence product strategy, and bring differentiated technology solutions to market. 

This is a high-impact role requiring someone who can move seamlessly between technical product detail, customer insights, commercial strategy, and compelling storytelling. 

 

Key Responsibilities:

Go-to-Market & Product Strategy 

  • Own end-to-end GTM strategies for Diligent Boards across key customer segments and regions. 
  • Develop differentiated positioning, messaging, value propositions, and launch strategies based on customer, market, and competitive insights. 
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to understand product roadmaps, technical capabilities, integrations, data, AI functionality, and translate these into compelling customer benefits. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve product-market fit, adoption, expansion, and revenue growth. 

AI & Technical Product Marketing 

  • Develop GTM strategies for AI-powered products and capabilities, translating AI/GenAI functionality into clear business value and differentiated market positioning. 
  • Build sufficient technical depth to credibly understand and communicate complex SaaS technologies, including APIs, integrations, data, automation, security, and AI capabilities. 
  • Partner with technical product and engineering teams to ensure accurate and compelling communication of product capabilities. 

Market & Customer Insights 

  • Develop deep understanding of our ICP, personas, buying committees, customer journeys, TAM, competitive landscape, and market trends. 
  • Lead Voice of Customer and market research initiatives and translate insights into actionable GTM and product recommendations.

Position Overview: 

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented company secretary to joint our UK based team as a Senior Corporate Services Associate. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a diverse portfolio of international clients, leading on the delivery of high quality corporate secretarial and compliance services across multiple jurisdictions. As primary day-to-day contact for our clients, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring compliance and building strong, trusted relationships that span the globe.  

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Serve as lead client contact for assigned clients and coordinate the delivery of company secretarial services in collaboration with in-country experts. 
  • Respond promptly and professionally to client queries and requests, ensuring exceptional service and client satisfaction.
  • Proactively monitor deadlines and ensure ongoing compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements. 
  • Prepare and file statutory documents including annual returns, confirmation statements, and regulatory filings with Companies House.  
  • Draft and review board resolutions, minutes, and other corporate documentation. 
  • Maintain data and document storage within Diligent Entities software. 
  • Support junior members of the team in developing their knowledge and skills base.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to ensure seamless service delivery
  • Apply strong organisational, analytical, and problem-solving skills to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

 

Required Experience

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in corporate secretarial or corporate services roles, ideally with international exposure
  • Strong working knowledge of UK company law, corporate governance principles, and global compliance requirements
  • Strong document drafting skills
  • Good understanding of corporate structures and statutory obligations
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
  • Excellent organisational and time management skills
  • Clear, professional verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to lead client engagements and work independently whilst managing multiple client priorities
  • Professional, client-focused mindset with discretion in handling confidential information
  • Adaptable, curious, and eager to learn in a growing, evolving function
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office
  • Ideally, experience in using Diligent Entities
  • Degree-level education or equivalent relevant work experience

Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. We are seeking a transformative Senior Director, Talent Acquisition to lead the overall recruiting function and deliver a high-impact, modern, and scalable hiring experience across the organization. In this role, the successful candidate will partner closely with senior business leaders and HR stakeholders to align hiring priorities, shape workforce plans, and support business growth through innovative, data-driven talent strategies.

This leader will oversee end-to-end recruitment strategy and operations, guide team performance, and drive process improvements that strengthen hiring outcomes, scalability, speed, and quality of hire. A key focus of the role will be leading the successful implementation and optimization of Workday Recruiting and related processes, while advancing the use of AI-enabled recruiting tools, automation, talent intelligence, and analytics to improve sourcing effectiveness, decision quality, operational efficiency, and candidate experience.
 
The ideal candidate is an AI-forward talent acquisition leader who brings strong leadership, stakeholder management, strategic thinking, and communication skills, along with deep expertise in recruiting operations, team development, talent analytics, recruiting technology, and enterprise process transformation. They will also bring a fresh and creative approach to attracting top talent and play a key role in advancing and strengthening our employer brand in the market.

  • Lead the global Talent Acquisition function across a broad team or portfolio, with accountability for recruiting strategy, delivery, team capability, technology adoption, and performance against hiring goals.

Harbor is looking for a Data Migration and Integration Consultant to join our HR and payroll transformation practice. This is a technical consulting role at the heart of our delivery work, responsible for moving client data safely and accurately into modern HR platforms and for designing and building the integrations that keep those platforms connected to the wider technology landscape.

You will work across engagements involving SAP SuccessFactors, Workday and Oracle HCM, taking clients from messy, fragmented legacy data through to clean, validated go live loads, and from integration requirements through to tested, supportable interfaces. The role suits someone who enjoys the detail of data work but can also explain it clearly to HR and business stakeholders who do not speak in file formats.

This is a remote position based in the UK, with travel to client sites as needed.

What you will do:

Data migration

  • Lead and deliver data migration workstreams into SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or Oracle HCM, from strategy and planning through to go live and hypercare
  • Define migration approaches, including scoping of data objects, load sequencing, cutover plans and rollback positions
  • Profile and assess legacy data quality, identifying gaps, duplicates and inconsistencies, and agreeing cleansing ownership with the client
  • Design and maintain mapping and transformation rules between legacy sources and target system structures
  • Build, execute and reconcile data loads across multiple test cycles, mock conversions and production cutover
  • Produce validation and reconciliation reporting that gives clients confidence in the accuracy and completeness of migrated data
  • Advise clients on data retention, archiving and the treatment of historical records

Integration design and delivery

  • Gather and document integration requirements across HR, payroll, benefits, finance and third party providers
  • Produce integration designs and specifications covering data flows, transformation logic, error handling, scheduling and security
  • Build, test and deploy integrations using platform native tooling and middleware
  • Support end to end and payroll parallel testing, resolving defects across connected systems
  • Define monitoring, error resolution and support processes so that integrations are sustainable after go live
  • Advise clients on integration architecture, including the trade offs between point to point connections, middleware and file based approaches

ETL and data engineering

  • Use ETL tooling to extract, transform and load data at scale across migration and integration workstreams
  • Develop repeatable, auditable transformation routines rather than one off manual manipulation
  • Automate validation and reconciliation checks where practical to reduce cycle times and manual effort
  • Contribute to the development of practice accelerators, templates and reusable migration assets

Client and practice contribution

  • Act as the trusted technical voice on engagements, translating data and integration matters into plain language for HR and programme stakeholders
  • Support proposals, scoping and estimating for migration and integration workstreams
  • Coach junior consultants and share technical knowledge across the team

What we are looking for:

Essential

  • Proven data migration experience into at least one of SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or Oracle HCM, across multiple full lifecycle projects
  • Integration design and technical delivery experience, including producing specifications and building and testing interfaces
  • Hands on experience with ETL tooling and confidence manipulating large, imperfect datasets
  • Strong understanding of HR and payroll data structures, including the sensitivities around personal data and the importance of accuracy at cutover
  • Experience running reconciliation and validation across test cycles and production loads
  • Clear communicator, able to work with both technical teams and HR stakeholders
  • Right to work in the UK and willingness to travel to client sites when needed

Desirable

  • Experience across more than one of the three target platforms
  • Knowledge of platform specific tooling such as Workday EIB, Core Connectors and Studio, SAP Integration Suite and Infoporter, or Oracle HDL and OIC
  • Experience with payroll migrations and parallel run reconciliation
  • Familiarity with UK GDPR and the data protection considerations that apply to migration and integration work
  • Exposure to professional services or legal sector clients
  • Consulting experience, or client-side experience with a clear consulting mindset

What you can expect:

  • Varied technical work across three major HR platforms, rather than being tied to a single technology
  • A collaborative practice with direct access to senior leadership and genuine input into how we grow
  • Investment in platform certifications and wider professional development
  • Competitive salary, bonus and benefits, with flexible and remote working supported

Join TRG Screen: Building World-Class Teams. One Expert at a Time.

Are you ready to be part of a dynamic team at the forefront of subscription spend management innovation?

At TRG Screen, we're not just redefining how organizations manage their subscription expenses – we're shaping the future of the industry. With cutting-edge solutions and a commitment to excellence, we empower businesses around the globe to optimize their subscription investments and drive sustainable growth.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize subscription management and make a meaningful impact on the way businesses access and utilize critical information. At TRG Screen, your talent and ambition will find a home, where opportunities for growth and advancement abound.

About TRG Screen

TRG Screen is the leading provider of market data and subscription management technology and automation solutions, tailored to the unique needs of financial institutions and legal firms. Our integrated suite of solutions includes market data and subscription spend management, usage management, compliance reporting, and comprehensive managed services, which hundreds of clients worldwide use to remove cumbersome and inaccurate manual processes and gain control over market data and subscription costs at scale. For more than 25 years, TRG Screen has enabled businesses who rely on market data to monitor and strategically manage spending and usage of data and information services, including market data, research, software licenses, consulting and other necessary corporate expenses. TRG Screen solutions give decisionmakers full transparency into subscription spend and usage, enabling them to proactively manage subscription costs at scale, conduct more informed vendor negotiations, improve governance, and avoid unnecessary spending on these mission-critical business services. TRG Screen is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Europe and Asia, as well as a 24x7 client support center in Bangalore, India.

TRG Screen is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s largest and most respected private equity firms.

The Role

Our data spans multiple products, including spend analytics, contracts, invoicing, market data inventory, and real-time telemetry, but it currently sits in separate, disconnected domains. We are bringing this together into a unified, governed, multi-tenant Lakehouse to enable cross-product analytics, customer benchmarking, and AI-driven innovation. We are looking for a Data Architect to define how our data is structured, connected, and governed, making sure it is consistent, trusted, and easy to discover across the organisation.This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and a real opportunity to shape how TRG Screen uses data going forward.

Responsibilities

Data architecture

  • Author the canonical data model across the ten-product estate:  logical and physical modelling, entity relationships, SCDs, and tenant isolation patterns.
  • Define data contracts with product teams; own the data dictionary, naming standards, and reference-data discipline.
  • Lead master data management - entity resolution, golden records, and cross-product joins at scale
  • Define data domains, ownership boundaries, and federated governance suited to a product-aligned organization.
  • Design the semantic/query layer (Dremio) for analysts, products, customers, and AI agents; set governance standards covering cataloguing, lineage, quality, access control, and PII.

Lakehouse architecture

  • Define the Lakehouse target architecture: storage, table format, query engine, ingestion, metadata, and the standards that govern it.
  • Set the patterns for multi-tenant isolation, row- and column-level security, and PII handling.
  • Define the streaming and batch ingestion architecture, building on our investments in NATS JetStream, Apache Flink, and Debezium CDC patterns, and direct the engineering team on execution.
  • Specify the catalog, lineage, and data-quality foundation  and own the operational practice that keeps them honest.
  • Make the build-vs-buy and tool selection calls, including revisiting current technology bets where the data warrants it.

Strategy and partnership

  • Partner with the Director of Data Solutions to ensure the architecture delivers against the product roadmap.
  • Represent data architecture in design reviews and customer-facing conversations.
  • Establish the architecture practice: patterns, review forums, hiring standard, as the team continues to expand.

Skills and Qualifications

Required

  • 8–10+ years in data / information architecture at a multi-product SaaS company.
  • Deep expertise in conceptual / logical / physical data modelling, master data management, and domain-oriented governance.
  • Proven track record reconciling semantically divergent source systems into canonical models across multiple products.
  • Strong grounding in Lakehouse architecture trade-offs: table formats, query engines, ingestion patterns (Iceberg vs Delta; Dremio vs Trino vs Snowflake; streaming vs batch).
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Dremio, Snowflake, or Databricks
    • AWS data services (S3, Glue, Athena, Lake Formation, or equivalent)
    • NATS / Apache Kafka or similar, and CDC patterns (Debezium or equivalent)
    • Stream processing (Apache Flink, Spark Structured Streaming, or equivalent)
    • SQL and query optimisation at scale
    • Data and table formats (Parquet, Avro, Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake)
  • Experience designing SaaS data models,  tenant isolation, shared schemas, access patterns, at scale.
  • Ability to communicate architecture decisions to engineers, product leadership, and executives.

Strongly preferred

  • Market data, financial services, or enterprise software-licensing domain experience.
  • Familiarity with modern data catalog and lineage tools, and the operational reality of running them at scale (DataHub, OpenMetadata, Atlan, Glue Catalog or equivalent).
  • Experience designing data products that feed AI and agentic use cases, such as, vector stores, RAG, embeddings, tool surfaces.
  • Python for data pipeline scripting and orchestration.
  • Exposure to real-time analytics use cases - dashboards, alerting, and anomaly detection.

About ROLLER

ROLLER is not your average software-as-a-service company. With a global presence in over 30 countries, we're here to bring some excitement to the leisure and attractions industry and make a difference! Our mission is to help businesses operate smoothly and create fun and memorable guest experiences by providing seamless ticketing, point-of-sale, self-serve kiosks, memberships and digital waiver processes.

But here's the best part: our team. We're a group of 300+ highly passionate, enthusiastic, and down-to-earth professionals located all around the world who are all working together to build something truly remarkable. We're aiming high and believe that the possibilities are endless. As we continue to grow globally, we're excited to write our success story and have fun along the way.

We genuinely love what we do, and we're looking for like-minded people to join us on this amazing journey. If you're ready to be part of a dynamic team and make a real impact, come aboard, and let's create some unforgettable experiences together at ROLLER!

 

About the Role

We’re on the lookout for a Business Development Representative (BDR) who is fluent in French and has an interest in working both inbound and outbound leads to help grow our sales pipeline. Reporting to the Director of Business Development, you’ll be the front-line connection with prospects, mastering the sales process and qualification and setting our Account Executives up for success. This role is a hybrid (in-office/remote) position that involves researching, initiating and maintaining relationships, and capitalizing on every opportunity to foster growth. 

 

What You'll Do

Inbound and Outbound Prospecting:

  • Swiftly respond to inbound inquiries, reducing initial response time
  • Generate new business leads through outbound opportunities via calls and emails

Lead Qualification:

  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads through effective discovery calls
  • Understand prospect needs and pain points, articulating our product's value proposition

Pipeline Generation:

  • Drive urgency to progress prospects through the sales funnel
  • Collaborate with the sales team to meet company goals and targets

Relationship Building and Event Representation:

  • Initiate meetings between prospects and Account Executives
  • Drive engagement and seize new business opportunities from events

 

About You

  • You are based in London, and excel in a hybrid work environment, balancing in-office collaboration and remote productivity.
  • You are fluent in both French and English.
  • While 1-2 years of BDR experience in the B2B SaaS industry is a plus, we welcome candidates who show potential, drive, and a passion for sales even if they are new to the role.
  • A proven track record of meeting or exceeding quotas, with a solid grasp of qualification frameworks like MEDDICC or BANT. Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM platforms is a big plus, as is proven success running outbound sales strategies.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills are second nature to you—you know how to build strong relationships and communicate clearly with both clients and team members.

 

Perks!

  • Attractive compensation package.
  • We offer visa sponsorship support for qualified candidates, where required. 
  • You get to work on a category-leading product that customers love in a fun, high-growth industry! Check our Capterra and G2 reviews.
  • 20 days of paid time off (PTO), 10 sick days, and local paid Bank Holidays.
  • 16 weeks paid Parental leave for primary carers and 4 weeks paid Parental leave for secondary carers.
  • Employee-only Private Medical and Dental Insurance.
  • Company Pension with The People's Pension.
  • Life Insurance – Group Life Cover from day one.
  • Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) – Access to 24/7 GP and mental health support, physiotherapy, wellbeing resources, long-term condition support, and specialist services.
  • Engage in our ‘Vibe Tribe’ - led by our team members; you can contribute to company-wide initiatives directly. Regular events and social activities, fundraising & cause-related campaigns... you name it. We're willing to make it happen!
  • Team member Assistance Program to proactively support our team's health and well-being, access to coaching, education modules, weekly webinars, and more.
  • Highly flexible work environment with an All Access pass to WeWork, depending on your location.
  • Work with a driven, fun, and switched-on team that likes to raise the bar in all we do.
  • Individual learning and development budget plus genuine career growth opportunities as we continue to expand!

 

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check (including criminal history) prior to commencement of employment

ROLLER is a global software-as-a-service company designed to help businesses in the leisure and attractions industry operate more efficiently and deliver great guest experiences.
