At the heart of ROLLER is our team - which consists of 300+ highly energetic, driven, intelligent, and humble professionals, all contributing to help build a great and enduring business. We truly believe that the sky's the limit for us, and we are well on our way toward becoming a global success story. But most of all, we love what we do, and we are looking for like-minded people to join us on this amazing journey!

 

About the Role

We are seeking a Fluent French-speaking Customer Onboarding Manager to join our Customer Experience team!

You’ll manage the end-to-end implementation program for new customer accounts onboarding onto ROLLER, while partnering with them to become a trusted advisor. We’re looking for someone who can continue the momentum created by Sales and drive value throughout the implementation phase of the customer journey.

The Training & Implementation Manager will become an expert in our platform and use this knowledge to provide best-practice advice when training customers. You’ll take a proactive approach to managing key stakeholders and ensure the successful delivery of goals and objectives.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own the successful onboarding of new customers across EMEA, with a focus on France
  • Utilise strong project management skills to ensure implementation projects are completed on time and to a high standard
  • Become an expert in our product and apply a hands-on approach to platform configuration and implementation
  • Gather requirements and configure customer accounts to meet their needs
  • Consult with customers on how best to use our platform for their business
  • Develop strong customer relationships that promote retention and loyalty
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure our customers have an incredible experience
  • Partner with our payments team to implement payment solutions both online and in-venue for new and existing customers

About You

  • You have at least 3 years of experience in onboarding or project management, ideally within a SaaS or technology-driven environment.
  • Must be a C1 fluent French speaker.
  • Experience in the leisure and attractions industry is a plus.
  • You’re tech-savvy and quick to learn new systems.
  • Your time and resource management skills, combined with a sharp attention to detail, set you up for success.
  • You’re genuine, grounded, and value authentic interactions.
  • You’re self-motivated and thrive in an autonomous work environment.
  • You know how to take ownership, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and effectively prioritise day-to-day tasks.
  • You’re comfortable in fast-paced, evolving environments and adapt quickly to change.
  • You bring a process-driven mindset with a focus on efficiency, scalability, and continuous improvement.

Perks!

  • Attractive compensation package and benefits.
  • You get to work on a category-leading product that customers love in a fun, high-growth industry! Check our Capterra and G2 reviews.
  • Work with a driven, fun, and switched-on team that likes to raise the bar in all we do.
  • Individual learning and development budget plus genuine career growth opportunities as we continue to expand!

About ROLLER

ROLLER isn't your average SaaS company. We operate globally across 30+ countries, powering millions of real-world experiences in the leisure and attractions industry. What we build doesn't just live on a screen. It shows up in busy venues, peak weekends, and unforgettable moments for guests.

Our mission is simple but ambitious: help operators run better businesses while creating great guest experiences. That means solving complex, real-world problems across ticketing, point of sale, self-service, memberships, kiosks, and digital waivers, all at meaningful scale.

Just as importantly, it's the people. We're a team of 300+ smart, grounded, and genuinely passionate humans working across the globe. We care about quality, ownership, and doing work we're proud of, without taking ourselves too seriously.

We're growing fast, aiming high, and building something that matters. If you want to work on real problems, with real customers, alongside people who care deeply about their craft and impact, ROLLER is a great place to do it.

 

Why You’ll Enjoy This Role!

🎯 Own the Full Deal And Outcome - You’ll run discovery, deliver demos, manage objections, negotiate pricing, and close deals end-to-end. This is a true closing role - not just qualification or handoff. The French market is pretty much greenfield! 

💻 A Product The Sells on Value, Not Hype - ROLLER is a category-leading platform in a complex, operationally critical space. Customers feel the impact immediately - on revenue, efficiency, and guest experience. That makes conversations deeper, more consultative, and far more satisfying than feature-led selling.

🎡 Fun Industry With Real-World Energy - We power go-kart tracks, trampoline parks, waterparks and other attractions around the world. Our customers are passionate operators creating memorable experiences, and you’ll see ROLLER in action firsthand. Site visits aren’t sterile office tours - they’re energetic, hands-on and genuinely a blast!

🏆 A Sales Org Reps Actually Rate Highly - ROLLER is ranked in the top 5% of companies on RepVue, based on feedback from real sales professionals. That reflects strong leadership, fair quotas, clear processes, and an environment where early-career sellers are supported to learn and grow. Don’t take our word for it - check out our RepVue page and see what reps say about working here.

 

Why You Want To Work With Us!

🩷 Loved by Customers - ROLLER is consistently highly rated on Capterra and G2, and trusted by leading operators worldwide. That doesn’t happen by accident. Customer obsession isn’t a value on a wall here, it’s embedded in how we prioritise, build, and measure success.

🏆 A Great Place People Choose to Stay - We’ve been Great Place to Work certified across multiple regions for several years running. That reflects a culture that values trust, autonomy, and growth, and an environment where high standards and psychological safety coexist.

💸 Competitive Package & Real Career Growth - We offer competitive compensation and benefits aligned to the level of ownership we expect. As ROLLER scales, so do the opportunities. People grow here by taking on bigger problems, broader scope, and greater responsibility. Progression is driven by impact and capability, not tenure, and strong performance is recognised and rewarded.

 

About the Role

  • As an SMB Account Executive, you will play a key role in driving new customer acquisition across small and growing operators within the leisure and attractions industry.
  • We have launched France in 2026 and it is going really well. You're working a market that is relatively Greenfield and ripe for the picking! 
  • You’ll work inbound demand while partnering closely with a BDR to generate additional outbound pipeline. This is a high-velocity, full-cycle closing role focused on strong qualification, disciplined execution, and consistent quota attainment.

About ROLLER

ROLLER isn’t your average SaaS company. We operate globally across 30+ countries, powering millions of real-world experiences in the leisure and attractions industry. What we build doesn’t just live on a screen. It shows up in busy venues, peak weekends, and unforgettable moments for guests.

Our mission is simple but ambitious: help operators run better businesses while creating great guest experiences. That means solving complex, real-world problems across ticketing, point of sale, self-service, memberships, kiosks, and digital waivers, all at meaningful scale.

Just as importantly, it’s the people. We’re a team of 300+ smart, grounded, and genuinely passionate humans working across the globe. We care about quality, ownership, and doing work we’re proud of, without taking ourselves too seriously.

We’re growing fast, aiming high, and building something that matters. If you want to work on real problems, with real customers, alongside people who care deeply about their craft and impact, ROLLER is a great place to do it.

 

Why You’ll Enjoy This Role!

🚀  Work that keeps venues trading - You’ll own fiscal and regulatory compliance across Europe. If it’s wrong, a venue can’t legally trade, so getting it right matters.

🤝  Your squad owns it - Squads are self-managing. The London squad owns localisation and compliance for Europe end to end, and you’ll work with your PM to decide what gets built, how it’s built and when it ships.

🌍  Real scale, real consequences - Thousands of requests per second across hundreds of containers, powering over 100 million guest experiences in 2025 alone.

✨  Help shape a growing team - Be one of the first engineers in London, set how the squad works, and help new engineers get up to speed.

 

Why This Role Matters

ROLLER is growing fast across Europe, and every new market brings its own rules on tax, invoicing, receipts and language. Our London squad makes sure venues in those markets can trade legally and run in their own language. Recent work includes fiscal compliance for markets like France, Germany and Austria, and AI-assisted translations across the platform.

You’ll join a small London squad reporting to a London based Tech Lead. Our HQ is in Australia, so most of your work with the wider team is async, with live time together every week or two. You’ll be comfortable owning your work, unblocking yourself and finding your own ways to stay connected.

Our backend runs on C#, .NET, T-SQL and AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, SES and SQS. On the front end, we use Angular alongside our own design system and component library.

 

What You’ll Do

Build

  • Design, build and ship changes across backend services, APIs and the Angular interfaces venues use every day
  • Build patterns for regional rules and compliance that we can extend to new markets

Own integrations

  • Lead integration-heavy work with third-party providers, like fiscal and certification partners: define the contract, handle the edge cases and plan for failure
  • Work directly with those providers when something needs chasing or clarifying

Own production

  • Collaborate closely with the SRE team to monitor system performance and proactively identify potential issues
  • Triage compliance alerts and fix the root cause

Raise the bar

  • Share what you know through code reviews, pairing and honest feedback
  • Work with your PM to break vague regulatory requirements into small, shippable pieces

 

About You

  • You have a high appetite for Technology and AI and a natural curiosity for how it can transform your work. You’re comfortable using AI tools to automate repetitive 'busy work,' freeing you up to focus on high-impact work.
  • Solid mid-level or senior experience building and shipping full-stack software in a SaaS product company
  • Deep backend experience in C# and .NET, and enough Angular or TypeScript to work across the stack
  • Deep knowledge of cloud patterns, application and database performance, with experience applying them to varying workflows and workloads
  • You’ve built integrations with third-party systems where the details matter: payments, tax, invoicing, compliance or similar
  • You can take a vague requirement, like a new country’s tax rules, and turn it into something shipped
  • You do your best work async: you write things down clearly, unblock yourself and don’t need constant check-ins

Bonus points for experience with European fiscal rules, or for speaking French or German. You don’t need to match every point.

We believe AI is a career-defining inflection point. ROLLER is a fast adopter of new technology like AI, and every team member is empowered to own their learning and use the latest tools to supercharge their impact. We’re looking for candidates with the proficiency and curiosity to embrace AI and technology, not just as a technical skill, but as a core competency to help us achieve big goals. Our engineers use Claude and other AI coding tools day to day.

 

Perks!

🚀  You get to work on a category-leading product that customers love in a fun, high-growth industry - check our Capterra and G2 reviews.

🏥  Private medical insurance through Vitality, plus dental cover.

💷  Company pension.

🛡️  Life insurance at 4x your base salary.

💙  Team member Assistance Program to proactively support our team’s health and wellbeing - access to coaching, education modules, weekly webinars, and more.

🍼  16 weeks paid Parental Leave for primary carers and 4 weeks paid Parental Leave for secondary carers

🎉  Engage in our ‘Vibe Tribe’ - led by our team members; you can contribute to company-wide initiatives directly. Regular events and social activities, fundraising & cause-related campaigns... you name it. We’re willing to make it happen!

💡  Work with a driven, fun, and switched-on team that likes to raise the bar in all we do.

Go on, hit apply. Let’s build great tech together. If you’ve got questions, don’t be afraid to reach out to Reuben at reuben.jamieson@rollerdigital.com.

You'll lead other engineers through problems of high ambiguity, set the technical bar for how we build for failure and not just the happy path, and follow a problem across the full institutional lifecycle rather than stopping at a boundary. Flexibility is the job: some weeks that's a settlement edge case in the backend, others a client onboarding flow or an ops dashboard, and you're happy owning whichever the work needs.

Just as importantly, you’ll support the growth and wellbeing of the artists you work with, helping them develop their skills and confidence through clear direction, feedback, and regular support.

Your artistic judgement and hands-on experience will help you guide quality, solve problems, and step in where needed to keep things moving.

Thanks for your interest in FloQast! Most of our team members have transitioned out of accounting to successful careers here at FloQast, from Sales to Customer Success. Given that our software is made for Accountants by Accountants, our Company is too! FloQast is where Accountants work!

Accounting Success Manager - You would be a relationship consultant and work with our clients for the duration of their contract.  ASM's take over the client relationship after the implementation process and handle anything from basic customer questions to quarterly business reviews and work to inform clients of new product releases and how those releases can benefit their company and processes.
Accounting Technology Consultant - You would be an implementation consultant working with new clients to onboard them successfully on the FloQast software! We are looking for motivated individuals with an accounting or audit background who are ready to transition into a consulting role and lead client launch calls, advise best practices within the software, and deliver training to accounting teams.
Business Development Representative - You would be taking your accounting knowledge to cultivate new business opportunities and create outreach strategies to build rapport with senior level executives at potential clients. This is a great way to leverage your accounting background and pivot to a sales career.
If you are interested in joining FloQast, but do not see an opening that fits your background, please submit your resume here. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will reach out to you if we have a role that could be a great fit!
Our office is located in central London and teams work in a hybrid capacity, in office 3 days a week.

About Iru
Iru is the AI-powered security & IT platform used by the world’s fastest-growing companies to secure their users, apps, and devices. Built for the AI era, Iru unifies identity & access, endpoint security & management, and compliance automation—collapsing the stack and giving IT & security time and control back.
Iru is backed by some of the smartest investors in tech—General Catalyst, Tiger Global, Felicis, Greycroft, and First Round Capital. In July 2024, Iru raised $100 million from General Catalyst, valuing the company at $850 million. Customers include Cursor, Vercel, Bumble, Plaid, Glean, Apollo, Replit, and Mercor, and Iru partners with industry leaders such as ServiceNow and AWS. Iru was named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startup Employers 2025 list for employee engagement and satisfaction.
The Opportunity
As Iru continues to redefine how organizations secure and manage their digital ecosystems, our enterprise customer base across EMEA is expanding rapidly. As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will be at the forefront of this growth, driving strategic sales initiatives into some of the region’s largest and most influential organizations.
With a unified platform that brings together UEM, EDR, Vulnerability Management, Compliance Automation, and Workforce Identity, you will help enterprise customers modernize how they secure users, apps, and devices through AI-powered orchestration.
This is a high-impact role based in our London office, with an in-office presence Tuesday through Thursday. You will partner with enterprise customers across EMEA to unlock the full value of Iru’s platform and position Iru as the definitive leader in unified identity, endpoint, and compliance management.
Success in this role means consistently exceeding expectations, navigating complex, multi-country sales cycles, and helping establish Iru as a category-defining platform across the EMEA market.

Iru was named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startup Employers 2025 list for employee engagement and satisfaction.
The Opportunity
We're hiring a Manager, Customer Success to lead our EMEA Customer Success team. The team is 5 CSMs today and will grow to 8 in the next year. You'll own the outcomes of every customer we serve in the region across Commercial, Mid-Market, and Enterprise: how fast they get to value, whether they renew, and how much they grow with us. You'll report to our Global Director of Customer Success and be the senior CS leader on the ground in EMEA. This is a full-time leadership role, not a player-coach seat: you won't carry a book of your own, because your number is the team's number.
Our EMEA CSMs carry the renewal and expansion number. This is quota-carrying renewals and installed-base account management, not generic customer success: CSMs own retention and expansion across their books and are measured on gross revenue retention and gross expansion ARR. Each segment runs a different motion, from scalable, high-volume playbooks in Commercial, to consultative growth and product attach in Mid-Market, to multi-year strategic partnerships in Enterprise, and you'll run all three. Your job is to make that team the best-run part of Iru's revenue engine: a renewal motion that never surprises anyone, expansion that comes from customers who are getting real value, and a forecast leadership can trust. Renewals at Iru are earned, not automatic, so the discipline you bring to renewal planning shows up directly in the number.
This is a London-based role with an in-office presence three days a week. You'll work side by side with EMEA Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Support, and with CS Operations and GTM Strategy & Operations on books, metrics, and planning. As the team grows, you'll help decide how it's shaped by segment and market. If you're a CS leader who coaches hard, inspects the details, and would rather build the regional playbook than inherit one, we'd love to talk.

Aave Labs began with a simple question: how do we make financial services like borrowing, saving, and earning more accessible globally?
We built the Aave Protocol, now the world’s largest and most trusted onchain lending market, connecting decentralized finance with individuals, traditional finance, and fintech.
Today, we build trusted, high-quality products that expand access to lending, credit, and savings globally
Our culture
We build trusted products that help people access and discover economic opportunities.
We hold a high bar for quality and craftsmanship. No detail is too small. Trust depends on it.
We’re a global team building products people can actually use, turning complex technology into something simple and reliable.
We stay aligned, move quickly, and think long term, while keeping teams lean and focused on impact.
About the Role
We're hiring a Principal Backend Engineer to lead the engineering team behind Push, Aave Labs' regulated, non-custodial on-ramp and off-ramp.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role spanning the systems that connect banking and open-banking partners, identity and compliance controls, payment processing, blockchain settlement, customer wallets, and the applications through which customers access Push.
You'll set the technical direction for a high-stakes financial product where correctness, security, auditability, and operational resilience directly affect customer funds and regulatory obligations. Alongside designing and building critical systems, you'll provide day-to-day leadership to the engineering team, create clarity from product and regulatory requirements, and ensure the team can deliver safely at pace.

The Role
We're hiring a Product Lead to own a product area at Kota. You'll set the vision and strategy, make the calls on what gets built, and lead the engineers who build it. Product Leads managing their own engineers is unusual and it's deliberate: one person accountable for the product and the team shipping it.
You'll start in Insurances, which powers how employers offer and manage group cover: health, dental, vision, critical illness, life and income protection. It's our most complex area, and the work is turning underwriting and compliance rules into flows an employee can finish in minutes.
That won't be the whole of it. Our teams are loosely split between Insurances and Core/Finance, and people work across the problem set. As we add products and move into new countries the areas will change, so we want someone adaptable and opportunistic who'll own whichever part matters most as we grow. The remit is broad with little structure around it, so it suits a high ownership drive.
What You'll Do
- Own the vision and strategy for your area, and make the product calls on what gets built
- Lead and grow a group of product engineers, coaching them on scope and delivery decisions rather than assigning tickets
- Shape and lead 6-week cycles for new features and provider integrations
- Simplify insurer onboarding, plan setup, premium management and benefit workflows
- Translate compliance and underwriting complexity into flows people complete
- Work across the whole business. Support, success, sales and operations all have a stake in what you own
- Help shape what the product areas become as we add products and enter new markets
- Ship fast at a high quality bar, and hold the team to it
What We're Looking For
- Product experience at lead, staff or principal level. Strong senior candidates are in scope if the rest lines up
- An entrepreneurial streak. You've founded something, worked at an early-stage startup, or spent time in engineering before moving into product
- You've owned the vision and strategy for an area, not just executed against someone else's
- Comfortable with fluid scope. You've picked up an unfamiliar domain before and become useful quickly
- Genuine AI fluency. You use AI tools daily in how you work, not just aware of them. We're an AI native company and this is part of the job, not a nice to have.
- Genuine cross-business collaboration. You've worked with support, success and sales, not only with engineers and designers with the occasional customer call
- You come from an environment with a high quality bar. It usually shows in the product itself
- Clear, concise communication, spoken and written, focused on value and outcomes rather than process
- Scale-up experience, roughly Series A to D. Seed-stage experience on top of that is a plus
- Comfortable managing people, or ready to start
- Domain experience. Fintech or Insurtech is the closest match to what you'll work on, then HR tech, benefits, employee expenses or travel. Anything sold to an employer that employees then use. The business model matters more than the industry label: if you've had to serve both an HR buyer and the employees using the product, that's the experience we care about
Not every box needs ticking. We'd rather see someone strong on several of these and light on others than someone who technically matches everything.
Our Values
- Have Integrity. We care deeply about our why and it won't jeopardise our how.
- Care Deeply. Our products are our story, we look at the details, go the extra mile to delight customers.
- Own Your Ship. Ask why, do the work, get the data, solve the problem, be an owner.
- Raise the Bar. We continuously look to push past good enough. Expect more, move faster, and never stop raising your and the team's standards.
- Play to Win. We exist because we decided to say no to the norm, now we do this every day.
Kota Benefits
- Health Insurance via Kota
- Workplace Pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota (country dependent)
- WFH stipend to support your home office needs
- Generous paid time off, work hard and take the time you need
- Annual company-wide offsite and dedicated team offsite
Our Hiring Process
We like to keep things simple and respectful of your time.
- Screening call (30 mins) with our talent team: your background, what you're looking for, and the practicalities
- Competency interview (60 mins) with one of our Product Leads, covering how you work, what you've owned and how you make product calls
- Task session (60 mins) with our GM and one other, working through a real Insurances problem together
- Call with founders (30 mins) with our CEO and CTO: our vision, and your thoughts on it

🚀 ABOUT NIVODA
Nivoda is a fast-growing B2B marketplace that is transforming the global diamond and gemstone industry. We connect buyers and sellers across the world, processing $300M+ in annual transactions and unlocking a $350B industry opportunity. We move fast, think big, and care deeply about the businesses and people we serve.
🌍 OUR MISSION
The diamond trading industry has historically been fragmented, opaque, and inaccessible. Nivoda was founded to change that: to empower businesses of all sizes and locations to participate in a fair, efficient global marketplace. Every line of code, every integration, every automation we build brings us closer to that mission.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Growth and Demand Gen Lead to own how Nivoda finds and wins new jewellers. This is a hands-on role for someone who lives in the channels and the numbers. You will run our paid, SEO, and account-based programs yourself, and you will be the person who works out which repeatable, scalable channels actually drive qualified leads, then builds them into an engine.
We do demand gen a particular way. Rather than pushing people to a product page and hoping, we lead with genuine value: free tools, content, and resources that help jewellers run better businesses, and we let that earn the relationship. Your job is to build the acquisition machine around that model and prove, channel by channel, what works.
You will start as an individual contributor with real ownership of the function, working alongside our paid, lifecycle, and GTM engineering talent. As the channels prove out and the work grows, there is a clear path to build and lead a team beneath you.
WHAT WOULD YOU BE DOING?
- Own net-new customer acquisition: set the demand-gen strategy, then go and execute it yourself, hands-on, across paid and beyond.
- Run our paid channels day to day, Google and Meta to start. For now, the ad accounts are something you are in, not something you hand off.
- Find and build repeatable, scalable channels that drive qualified leads. The goal is a system, not a string of one-off campaigns.
- Grow our SEO and AEO (answer-engine) presence, so jewellers find us when they are looking for help, not only when we are paying to reach them.
- Design and run account-based programs aimed at the specific jewellers we most want as customers.
- Lean into our value-first model: point spend at free tools and content, like our Jeweller Business Health Check, rather than product pages, and build the funnel that turns that attention into signups.
- Work inside our attribution from day one. Partner with our data and GTM engineering leads so every channel is measurable and every dollar is accountable.
- Hand qualified leads off cleanly to the SDR team, and close the loop so you know which channels produce customers, not just clicks.
- Raise the bar on how rigorously the whole team tests and scales growth ideas, wherever those ideas come from.
- Report on what is working in plain terms, kill what is not, and reinvest in what is.
WHAT DO WE NEED FROM YOU?
- 5+ years in growth or demand gen, with a track record of building acquisition channels that scaled, not just managing a spend number.
- Deep, hands-on paid expertise. You can build, run, and optimise Google and Meta campaigns yourself, today.
- Real experience across more than one channel: paid plus some mix of SEO, ABM, lifecycle, or net-new experiments.
- You think in systems, repeatable and measurable and scalable, and you are suspicious of any win you cannot explain or repeat.
- Fluency with attribution and analytics. You start from the numbers and you can defend them.
- Comfort as a hands-on IC on a small team, building process where none exists, with the ambition to grow into leading a team.
- A bias for experiments. You ship, measure, learn, and move, rather than planning forever.
- Happy to use AI and modern tooling to move faster.
NICE TO HAVE
- Experience acquiring small business owners, retailers, or a trade audience.
- A marketplace, self-serve, or product-led growth background.
- Hands-on with the tools in our stack: Google Ads, Meta, HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay, and Mixpanel.
- Experience with a value-first or content-led acquisition model.
- Real SEO and AEO depth as search shifts toward AI-generated answers.
🌟 OUR CULTURE AND WHAT WE OFFER
We're a high-growth company in an exponential expansion phase. We move fast, operate with low hierarchy, and give people real ownership from day one. If you want to work somewhere you can genuinely shape things: not just maintain them: Nivoda is the place.
OUR CURRENT BENEFITS
- 🕐 Flexible working hours and vibrant company culture
- 🏡 Remote work
- 📈 Opportunities for growth and learning
- 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance
- 🚀 Chance to join during our exponential expansion phase
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let that stop you from applying: we hire for potential and mindset, not just a checklist.
Please submit your CV in English.
NOT QUITE THE RIGHT ROLE?
If this role isn't for you but you're excited about Nivoda, join our Talent Pool and we'll reach out when something's a better fit: nivoda.com/talent-pool http://nivoda.com/talent-pool

The Data & Financial Platform team owns Nivoda's data platform plus the shared financial capabilities of the marketplace. Its job is to make core data and financial systems reliable, useful and scalable.
This role sits in the team but works day to day with GTM. You will work with the Head of Data, engineers, analysts, Sales and Marketing as we rebuild Nivoda's GTM infrastructure.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Nivoda is rebuilding its GTM infrastructure. Too much of the funnel still relies on manual steps, disconnected tools and fragile hand-offs. This role exists to replace them with reliable systems and automation.
You will work across our platform, GTM Engine, Salesforce, Customer.io http://Customer.io, enrichment services, Snowflake and other tools. Salesforce is an important integration point, but you will not own it. Start with the problem, choose the simplest sensible approach, then build or configure what is needed.
This is a hands-on engineering role working closely with the Head of Data and experienced engineers. You will have context and clear priorities, with room to work through the detail, propose an approach and ship it safely.
WHAT WOULD YOU BE DOING?
- Work with GTM stakeholders to turn unclear process requests into clear technical requirements and a sensible implementation approach.
- Build integrations, customer or prospect event flows, automations and changes to our GTM Engine. Use APIs, webhooks, queues, scheduled workflows or small services where they fit.
- Choose build, buy or configure based on the problem. Prefer native platform capability first, tooling or middleware second, custom code where it creates real value.
- Build for production from the start. Test common failure paths, handle duplicates and retries, then add the monitoring needed to spot problems quickly.
- Ship and support what you build using version control, code review and safe deployment. Help troubleshoot or recover failures after launch.
- Work with Salesforce, other platform owners and our Commercial Data Analyst to integrate cleanly while making sure systems emit the data needed to measure performance.
- Document important flows, decisions and recovery steps so the stack does not depend on one person.

- You think about failure cases such as unavailable APIs, duplicate records or conflicting updates before they become production problems.

p(X) provides aggregated, institutional-grade digital asset liquidity through a curated network of global trading venues. In today's highly fragmented market, counterparties that trade directly with p(X) gain access to deep, diversified liquidity while simplifying execution and settlement. This eliminates the operational burden of establishing and maintaining separate relationships with multiple liquidity providers while at the same time allowing for superior execution quality.
p(X) operates as an independent business unit, separate from the Talos Platform business, governed by its own AML, compliance, risk management, and operational frameworks designed to meet the requirements of a regulated trading and liquidity provisioning business.
As a distinct legal entity, p(X) maintains its own balance sheet, counterparty onboarding processes, governance structure, and Board of Directors. While p(X) leverages certain shared corporate services — including Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Information Security — it operates independently from Talos, with its own management and staff, in all core commercial and operational activities.
We are hiring a Sales Lead/Director to drive counterparty acquisition, onboarding, and revenue growth for our p(X) liquidity provision business. - 7-10+ years in institutional trading sales (some overlap with crypto will be a bonus), with proven revenue-carrying responsibility

jobs.ashbyhq.com/talos-trading/75908243-.description_excerpt:
Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.
At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.
We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.
SALES DIRECTOR, EMEA
This is a senior sales opportunity for an experienced commercial leader to drive Talos’s growth with banks and TradFi institutions as institutional finance moves into digital assets and tokenized, multi-asset trading.
As Sales Director at Talos, you will own new business and key relationships across the UK, with a focus on banks and TradFi institutions entering digital assets. You will run the full deal lifecycle, from origination and discovery through solutioning, trials and close, partnering closely with Solutions and Account Management to make sure clients are set up for long-term success.
Talos runs a structured, consultative sales environment. This role suits someone with an established TradFi network, a proven record of originating revenue, and the ability to clearly articulate how institutional trading infrastructure is changing.
RESPONSIBILITIES
- Originate and close new business across banks, broker-dealers and TradFi institutions, alongside Talos’s core client segments including hedge funds, market makers, prime brokers and digital asset service providers.
- Use and expand your network of senior bank and TradFi relationships to build a high-quality pipeline from day one.
- Lead senior-level discovery and demo conversations, mapping institutional workflows and requirements to Talos’s product capabilities.
- Position Talos clearly within the evolving digital asset ecosystem, translating TradFi requirements across connectivity, risk, compliance and workflow into Talos’s value proposition.
- Manage and grow an existing book of business in partnership with Account Management, driving retention, expansion and executive-level relationships.
- Coordinate cross-functionally with Solutions, Account Management, Product and Engineering to advance deals and make sure client commitments are accurate and deliverable.
- Capture and communicate client and market insights to inform product roadmap and go-to-market strategy.
- Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting in Salesforce.
- Act as a senior Talos presence in the London market, representing Talos at industry conferences and client events.
- Share expertise and informally mentor junior members of the sales team.
REQUIREMENTS
- 7+ years of client-facing sales or commercial experience within institutional financial services, fintech or enterprise SaaS serving capital markets.
- An established network of active relationships across banks and TradFi institutions, particularly in the UK and Europe.
- A proven track record of originating and closing new business, with quantifiable results.
- Deep understanding of TradFi market structure and institutional trading workflows. Experience in FX, fixed income, equities or multi-asset trading environments is highly valued.
- Familiarity with digital assets is advantageous but not required. You should bring genuine interest in how TradFi is adopting digital assets and tokenization.
- The ability to lead consultative, senior-level sales conversations and explain complex infrastructure in clear, client-friendly terms.
- Strong commercial judgment, with the discipline to set realistic client expectations and avoid overcommitting on product or timelines.
- A self-directed, high-ownership approach: you can build a pipeline and maintain momentum independently, without ramp-up or close guidance.
- A collaborative, team-first mindset, comfortable in a fast-paced, distributed environment with a high degree of autonomy.
- Based in London, or able to work from the London office.
OUR SALES APPROACH
Talos operates a systematic, consultative sales process built around a simple principle: listen first, sell second. We take the time to understand a client's workflows, constraints, and goals before positioning a solution. We sell what we have - with deep product mastery and honest conversations about what's on the roadmap and what isn't.
We maintain a balanced pipeline across focus segments, use Salesforce rigorously to track progress, and hand off every closed deal with a documented account plan so the relationship starts on solid footing from day one.
We play the long game. Underpromise, overdeliver, and build the kind of relationships that compound over time.
MORE ABOUT TALOS
Check out these videos and links to learn more about Talos and our culture!

Andreessen Horowitz re: Talos: "The company best suited to drive institutional adoption is one that understands traditional capital markets deeply and is forward-thinking enough to fully grasp the promise of crypto. Talos is that company."
BENEFITS
You will also enjoy a comprehensive array of competitive benefits, regardless of your location, within our warm, welcoming, and ambitious company culture. Some of our benefits include:

About the role
We’re looking for a Founding European SDR to help launch and scale Tremendous’ outbound motion internationally. As one of our first international SDR hire, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and booking meetings with high-potential prospects, while helping define how we sell into new European markets.
You will partner closely with Account Executives to generate meetings and act as the first point of contact for prospective customers. This role requires strong outbound execution across email, phone, social, events, and field marketing, with meaningful ownership over account development and early market strategy.
As a founding hire, you will have the opportunity to shape messaging, process, and best practices for international sales while directly impacting pipeline, revenue growth, and Tremendous’ expansion internationally.
What you'll do
- Work primarily to bring in new deals through outbound prospecting
- Own your pipeline through cold calling first. The phone is your primary weapon; you'll be expected to make 100 cold calls per day, book meetings over the phone, and treat every unanswered call as the next opportunity to dial again. Email and LinkedIn support your outreach; they don't replace it
- Collaborate with Account Executives, as well as members of our Marketing, Strategy, and RevOps teams, to develop new strategies to build our sales pipeline and grow our business
- Use prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging
- Learn our technology and effectively communicate our value proposition. Work to understand their goals and challenges to better understand how we can help.
What you'll bring
- You're fluent in English as well as French or Spanish to engage prospects across our European markets.
- You pick up the phone before you open email. Cold calling isn't something you tolerate - it's how you start your day, every day, without being told to.
- Demonstrated history of consistently exceeding personal and professional goals, with a strong commitment to excellence in all endeavors
- Curious, lifelong learner mindset with a passion for continuous improvement, staying updated on industry trends and best practices, and showing enthusiasm for applying newly acquired knowledge to improve job performance
- Customer-obsessed sales approach, demonstrating a deep commitment to understanding and addressing the unique needs of our clients
- Independent. We all work together to solve tough problems here at Tremendous, but taking pride in experimenting and finding your own answers is the best way to learn.
- Collaborative. When our SDRs uncover new trends and tactics that work to set meetings, they share them with their teammates so everyone can benefit.
- Ambitious. Ambition isn't a dirty word at Tremendous. We're a team of achievers collaborating on a fast-growing product and that means personal growth in both role and responsibility as well as tons of personal upside for you.
What's cool about the role
- Competitive pay and equity.
- Base salary for this role (UK): £39K – £43K. OTE £55K - £62K.
- Base salary for this role (Europe): €39K – €45K. OTE €56K - €64K.
- Fully remote.
- Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook https://handbook.tremendous.com/.

AI Solutions Manager
About Andela:
At Andela, we know brilliance is evenly distributed around the world, but opportunity is not. For over 10 years, Andela has connected its customers with top global, remote technical talent from over 135 countries with the majority residing in emerging markets like Africa and Latin America.
As one of the world’s largest talent marketplaces, Andela gives companies greater flexibility to quickly deploy qualified technologists. With talent highly skilled in advanced technologies to support Application Development, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud & DevOps, Data Engineering, and much more, customers experience 33% faster project delivery. The company’s exclusive AI-powered platform, Andela Talent Cloud, is the industry’s only unified platform managing the complete global talent lifecycle and enables customers to fill individual roles or engage fully managed teams up to 66% faster.
Andela is on the precipice of two breakout industry transformations: one in staffing/hiring and the other in software development, both accelerated by generative AI.
Are you an exceptional, hungry leader seasoned in scaling businesses through transformation and growth? Join us and change the world.
Job Summary:
The AI Solution Manager drives the strategy and commercialization of assigned AI solutions, transforming custom programs into scalable, high-margin Solution Packages.
This is a strategic and commercial role combining product management, go-to-market, and partnerships, requiring strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and technical fluency.
Exceptional Leadership:
As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you – if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you.
- Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.
- One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.
- Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.
- Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.
- Player-coach: You fly high (create strategy) AND low (know the details that matter). You roll up your sleeves and get scrappy. You do this proactively collaborating with your team while actively engaging in important details.
- Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert; you consistently get praise for approaching your function through the lens of solving business problems.
Key Responsibilities (by weight):
1. Solution Strategy & IP Development (40%): Design scalable Solution Packages (50-70%+ margin, outcome-based), define roadmaps, capture IP/build playbooks for 10X faster deployment, and define solution scope/success criteria.
2. Commercialization & Go-to-Market (40%): Create sales enablement (battle cards, ROI calculators, training), design pricing (T&M → outcome-based), define ICPs, support demand generation, and identify "lighthouse customers."
3. Partnerships & Ecosystem (20%): Identify and cultivate strategic technology (AWS, Databricks, LLM platforms) and SI (Accenture, Deloitte) partnerships; develop co-marketing/co-selling motions; represent Andela in thought leadership.
Success Metrics:
- 90 Days: Approved solution strategy, sales enablement complete, 2-3 lighthouse customers engaged.
- 6 Months: First Solution Package (alpha) launched, $500K-$1M pipeline, 3-5 reference case studies, 1-2 partnerships activated.
- 12 Months: Solution Package matured (beta/final), $2M-$5M revenue, 50-70%+ margins, solution becomes a competitive differentiator.
Required Qualifications:
- Experience: 8-12 years in solutions consulting, product management, or GTM, with 5+ years in B2B enterprise software/services. Proven 0-to-1 track record (strategy → packaging → commercialization → revenue).
- Skills: Strategic, Commercial (pricing design), Sales Enablement, Executive Communication, Technical Fluency (moderate depth), and AI/ML Fundamentals (preferred).
Preferred Qualifications:
- Top-tier consulting or boutique firm experience.
- Product management with full GTM responsibility.
- Partnerships experience.
- Startup/scale-up experience.
- AI solutions expertise (LLM/RAG, ML platforms).

ABOUT ARTSY AND ARTNET
Artsy and Artnet have combined to create the world’s largest online art marketplace and information platform. Together, we connect collectors, galleries, auction houses, and institutions across a global market valued at over $60 billion. Our products serve both the art world’s largest institutions and individual collectors – supporting art discovery, research and transactions.
We are at a pivotal moment. The combined company brings together the broadest customer base in the online art market, uniquely valuable proprietary data, a proven team, and new velocity as a combined organization. We believe the rapid evolution of AI will reshape not just how we build our products, but how our users interact with them. We want a technology leader who is as excited about that future as we are.
THE ROLE
We’re looking for a Chief Technology Officer to lead the combined engineering organization through a period of ambitious growth and technological transformation. This is not a maintenance role. It’s a mandate to retool how an entire organization builds software, to mentor a talented team through that transition, and to ensure that what we’re building today is designed for the world our users will inhabit tomorrow.
The right person is energized by a set of hard questions: Which parts of our platform are durable advantages, and which will be commoditized by AI? How should we build for an agentic user who discovers and transacts through AI intermediaries rather than browsing a website? Where are we underinvested? What does a world-class engineering team look like when AI fundamentally changes how software is written?
Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll own the full technology function: engineering, infrastructure, and technical architecture. You’ll be the company’s eyes on the technology frontier, constantly scanning what’s emerging, and pressure-testing our assumptions about what’s feasible. As a key member of the senior leadership team, you’ll surface information and opportunities to help shape company direction and make the best possible strategic decisions.
Just as importantly, you’ll be a mentor and teacher to the entire organization. The transition to AI-augmented workflows isn’t just a tooling change, it’s a cultural one. We need a leader who can bring the team along, raise everyone’s capabilities, and create an environment where engineers, product managers, designers, and business operators are all fluent in what’s now possible.
WHAT YOU’LL DO

ABOUT THIS ROLE
Astronomer’s products run on a complex, multi-cloud platform — and the scalability, and operational maturity of that platform is what we’re actively investing in. The work ahead on our Platform team isn’t about managing data or curating pipelines; it’s about building the foundational systems that everything else runs on — the kind of systems where the failure modes matter, the latency budgets are real, and getting it wrong has visible consequences for hundreds of enterprise customers.
We’re looking for a Staff+-level engineer who has built production platform systems at scale before — not just consumed them. You’ve designed systems under load, reasoned carefully about failure, and made your colleagues’ lives better by giving them something solid and well-understood to build on top of. You write strategy documents and then write the code that proves them out. You’ve been the person who made the call, and lived with the consequences.
This is a foundational role at a consequential moment: your work will directly shape what Astronomer’s products — Astro, Observe, and our IDE — are capable of over the next several years.
WHAT YOU GET TO DO
Astronomer has a healthy and complex infrastructure estate spanning multiple cloud providers, a mix of managed and self-hosted systems, and an increasingly ambitious set of requirements as our products evolve. We have a clear sense of where we need to go; we need the right person to figure out how to get there and then go build it.
This is very much a technical role — you’ll be just as involved in building these systems as in specifying and designing them. We’re not looking for someone to write strategy documents; we’re looking for someone who writes the strategy and the code, and who has done exactly that before at scale.
- Blaze a Trail: Own and develop our platform infrastructure strategy, with the sponsorship and responsibility to match. Map out what we need, make the calls, and own the outcomes.
- Be an Owner: Be directly involved in deciding what we work on and how we work on it. Make promises, and keep them.
- Do Sensible Things: Make principled build vs. buy assessments and advocate for the right tools for the right job — not the fashionable ones, not the ones already in the estate just because they’re there.
- Garage Door Open: Create and maintain comprehensive internal documentation and decision records for systems and processes. Participate in architectural forums and make principled, open decisions that the rest of the organisation can learn from and hold us to.
WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE
- Distributed systems depth, grounded in practice. You have a solid working model of how production systems fail — consistency and availability tradeoffs, failure cascades, backpressure, graceful degradation. You can draw the diagram, explain the failure modes at each node, and make a reasoned argument for which ones actually matter in a given context. NALSD https://sre.google/workbook/non-abstract-design/ thinking is how you naturally approach a new system design.
- Kubernetes at operator depth. You know what happens inside the scheduler and the control loop when things go wrong, because you’ve been there. You’ve operated clusters under real load, not just deployed workloads onto them.
- Strong Go proficiency. The platform team writes production Go. You should be fluent: you’ve built and shipped systems in it, and you have opinions about what good Go looks like.
- Multi-cloud experience, not just multi-cloud exposure. You’ve made considered architectural decisions across AWS, GCP, and/or Azure — not just consumed managed services, but evaluated tradeoffs between them and lived with those decisions in production.
- Experience defining requirements and driving technology choices across an engineering organization. You’ve been the person in the room who frames the decision correctly, not just the one who executes it.
- Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a design doc that changes minds, and a postmortem that makes the organisation smarter. You’ve worked effectively in a globally-distributed team.
BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE
- Experience with storage primitives at the system level — you’ve reasoned about when to reach for a relational store vs. an object store vs. something else, and you have real opinions informed by real failures.
- Experience working on a SaaS/PaaS product across multiple cloud providers.
- Familiarity with Apache Airflow or workflow orchestration systems.

At Body & Soul, we create luxury intimate portrait experiences for everyday women – most of whom have never done a shoot before. By the time a guest meets you, she’s already had her session, felt the transformation, and is seeing her images for the first time on Zoom.

This is the power of Intimate Portraiture. As our remote Art Curator, you’ll be a direct source of that change every single day – not just “selling photos,” but helping guests choose artwork that changes how they see themselves for life.
If you want to use your sales craft to guide high‑trust, emotionally rich conversations – and you’re confident asking for several thousand pounds on a call – keep reading. If you’re looking for a side‑gig where you can dabble, this won’t be the right home.
ROLE AT A GLANCE
- Location: Remote, UK Timezone (or very close)
- Schedule: 5 days per week, including regular evenings and weekends
- Typical day: 3–4 x 60–90 minute Zoom reveals + prep, notes and light follow‑up
- Compensation: ~£28,000 base salary + uncapped commission
- Realistic OTE: ~£70,000–£85,000/year for consistent performers; top performers earning up to ~£110,000–£115,000/year at our present pricing
- Reports to: Sales Manager
YOUR MISSION
Help guests make clear, confident decisions about artwork that reflects how they now see themselves – and lead those decisions into clean, joyful payments on a single Zoom call.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Run 3–4 pre‑booked Zoom reveal sessions per day with guests who have already completed their shoot (no cold calling, no prospecting)
- Guide each guest through her gallery, help her narrow down favourites, and design artwork collections and wall pieces that fit her space, style and budget
- Confidently present pricing, explain our collections and payment options, and take payment on the call using our proven structure
- Use our call framework, scripts and tools while still bringing your own warmth and personality
- Capture clear notes in our system so production, framing and delivery teams can fulfil flawlessly
- Manage focused follow‑up for guests who genuinely need to confirm details with a partner or adjust an order, within clear guardrails (no endless chasing)
- Participate in regular call reviews and coaching to keep improving your communication and results
- Collaborate with photographers, Guest Experience and ops so the whole journey feels seamless for the guest
HOW WE’LL KNOW YOU’RE WINNING
- Most of your reveals end in a clear, confident “yes” or “no” and a completed artwork order, not vague maybes
- Your average artwork order sits around £2,000+ with many guests happily investing £3,000–£4,000+
- You consistently meet or exceed your monthly artwork revenue targets while protecting guest experience and boundaries
- Guests leave calls feeling seen, respected and excited – not pressured, shamed or confused
- You’re a calm, grounding presence on emotional calls, even when money, body image or relationships come up

This is a base‑plus‑commission role with uncapped upside.

- Typical artwork orders currently range from ~£2,000–£4,000+
- Realistic total earnings for consistent performers: ~£70,000–£85,000 per year (base + commission)

YOUR MISSION
You are the beating heart of the guest experience. Your job is to make sure no woman gets lost or feels left behind, and that our guests, our team and our studio all have a brilliant experience.
By the time a guest reaches you she has spoken to our front-end team, had her onboarding call and joined a community call. From there you are her point of contact. You support her by phone before her shoot, look after her in person on the day, and take her through our artwork in the studio before her reveal.
To do that well, you become the person who understands all of it: our art, how a guest should prepare, how to steady her nerves, and how to see a problem before it arrives. Our photographers, makeup artists and art curators walk in knowing who they are meeting and what she needs, because you have already read her notes and passed them on.

- Call guests before their shoot to answer questions, settle nerves and confirm the practical details. We pick up the phone far more often than we send emails

- Fill last-minute gaps when a guest reschedules, so the studio stays full
- Read each guest's notes in advance and find ways to personalise her day, such as marking a birthday
- Welcome guests in person and look after them through the day: drinks, belongings, timings and comfort
- After the shoot, show guests our artwork in person and prepare them for their reveal
- Keep our CRM accurate and make sure guest notes are handed over properly between departments
- Work with the production team on artwork orders and on guest satisfaction at every stage
- Keep reception and the guest areas immaculate

- Problems are caught early. The team is rarely surprised, and the guests are the ones who get the surprises
- Guests arrive at their reveal prepared and familiar with the artwork
- The CRM is clean, and notes are complete when another department picks them up
- You consistently ask for feedback rather than waiting to be given it
- You work well with every member of the team
THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF…
- You are driven by the mission. You care about what this work does for women

- A customer experience background at the premium end: luxury retail, a five-star hotel, a private members’ club, premium airline cabin crew, luxury beauty or somewhere comparable. General hospitality or retail experience on its own is unlikely to be enough

Radical Accountability.
Uncompromising Excellence.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/bodysoul/83ad185f-783a-.description_excerpt:
---------
Why This Role Is Available
Our guest facing team is currently comprised of 13 brilliant women. The studio team specifically has two full-time photographers and two full-time makeup artists. We are about to release evening sessions for our community, which has made room for two more full-time Photographers & HMUA's to join the company.
This is an evening-based role. You will work evenings and weekends as the standard pattern, not as occasional cover. We are looking for someone who actively wants those hours and prefers later starts and finishes, not someone willing to put up with them.
The role would be full-time starting December 1st 2026 in our new Farringdon headquarters, which we have just bought. For the right artists who impress up, paid training and onboarding may begin as early as October.
Our guests are all women as we specialise in fine art & implied nudity, you'll be part of an all-female creative floor team for their comfort and safety.
If you want to be part of a tight in‑studio team and push your styling craft to a world‑class standard, keep reading.
Your Mission
A pure craft role. No sales. No editing. Your job is running three bespoke shoots a day, every day.
This role has two equally important parts: the artistry, and the relationship you build with each guest. While most studios fit as many women through the doors as they can, you hold just three sessions a day, two hours per woman. Each guest has an hour getting her makeup done, at which time you are part of that experience and getting to know her.
You'll know all about the guest from consultations the rest of the team has had, and will be looking to use that time to build trust, get deep with her and understand her vision before bringing it to life. During the shoot you will have roughly 45 minutes with your guest. The makeup artist will be with you all day and vice versa to provide the most personal support.
Most of our guests have never done a shoot before. Your job on set is to direct and pose a woman who does not think of herself as someone who gets photographed, and to do it so calmly that she forgets to be nervous. It's also to build rapport & connection with every woman who walks through the door. A 50 year old mother of three and 19 year old about to step into university. New married and int he midst of divorce. CEO boss babes and fellow creatives.
What The Role Entails
- Run three sessions a day to our timing, gallery and guest experience standards
- 45 minute shoot, 3 outfits & a nude flow with 75 final unique images delivered
- Direct and pose everyday women with calm, grounded leadership so they feel safe, supported and genuinely seen
- Present, engaged and part of the conversation during the makeup hour
- Keep sets, wardrobe, gear and the studio floor immaculate every shift
- Log clear notes after every guest so the rest of the team can do their best work
- Engage fully in training: implement feedback, attend gallery reviews and develop your craft weekly
How We'll Know You're Winning
- You arrive able to brief the team in detail on every guest you are shooting that day. You have read her consultation before you walk in
- You consistently ask for feedback rather than waiting to be given it
- Sessions run to time without the guest ever feeling rushed
- Gallery quality is consistently high, with minimal reshoots and clean file hygiene
- Guest scores sit at or above studio baseline
- You work well with every member of the team. There are no cliques here. You support others and allow yourself to be supported
- You finish your days feeling empowered rather than drained. This work is demanding, but it should not leave you depleted
This Role Is For You If…
- You want to make a real difference in women's lives
- You get genuine satisfaction from hitting tight timings and following a proven process
- You want to go all-in on your craft, even if that means long, intense days rather than "perfect balance"
- You like clear standards, honest feedback and being held to numbers
- You thrive in a high-standard, direct, team-first environment
Requirements
1. Two or more years working in the industry. Studying does not count. Studio photographer, weddings, boudoir or luxury portrait environments. Otherwise a portfolio specifically showcasing an array of studio sessions with women, capturing an array of ages and bodyshapes, along with nudes and fine art portraits required.
2. Confident directing and posing non-models with empathy and emotional presence
3. Strong technical skills across exposure, focus, composition and continuous lighting
4. Excellent time management, able to run emotionally intense back-to-back sessions without rushing the guest
5. Open to learning and following a proven process before suggesting changes to it
6. You will work evenings and weekends consistently. These are not occasional shifts, they are the standard working pattern for this role

- Starting band: Junior Photographer. All new hires start here while you learn our style and systems
- Starring base salary: £34,000 - £36,000
- On-target earnings year one: £38,000
- Progression: Your base may rises to £40,000 after being a Core Photographer for 12+ months. Top performers grow into Senior and Lead bands on £45,000 to £55,000 OTE as the studio scales. Progression is not based upon tenure but experience, output and values alignment.
- 28 days paid leave including bank holidays
Growth & Perks
- Structured 90-day ramp with close coaching, clear milestones and a simple scorecard so you know exactly what good looks like
- Weekly gallery reviews, 1:1s and calibration sessions to refine your eye and your presence
- Therapy, fully covered. Up to 30 sessions a year from day one. Independent, confidential and entirely yours
- Healthcare cash-back. Everyday costs like dental, optical and physiotherapy come back to you, up to £2,500
- Your artistry, championed. Real encouragement and support to push your own artistry, and the artistry of Body & Soul
- Gathered often. Team huddles, dinners, outings and community events through the year
- A team and community behind you. People who genuinely want you to be your best
We do not employ part-time or freelance creatives.

Click Apply on this page and complete the short application form.

Sincere Candour.
Radical Accountability.
Uncompromising Excellence.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/bodysoul/5e513fb1-f507-.description_excerpt:
WHY THIS ROLE IS AVAILABLE
At the end of this year we move into our own building in Farringdon, which we have bought. With it we start offering out-of-hours sessions, so women from all walks of life can come to us. That takes us from roughly 120 women a month to 180.
That growth is why we are doubling our team. This role exists to grow the sales department so that more women are inspired to take the step.
YOUR MISSION
As our Sales Consultant, you are the front door to Body & Soul. You are the first person a woman speaks to, and you represent the brand and our ethos.
Body & Soul is application-only. Nobody can book an experience online. Every woman has a discovery call with you first, and she comes to the studio only if you invite her.
This is a remote, phone-based role. She has seen our work and got in touch, so every lead is warm and inbound, and there is no cold calling. You invite her to the studio and help her past fear and doubt.
You also make sure we invite the right women. We do not sell to vulnerable women. You qualify that she is emotionally, financially and mentally in the right place, and that she values the art and shares our values. You are judged on the women you turn away as well as the women you book.
Our sales are ethical and built on empathy, and that standard holds through every part of the process. When you qualify a woman and welcome her into our community, you fill the studio, and that creates the work for everyone else in the company.
THE TEAM YOU'RE JOINING
You join a sales team of two Art Curators and two Sales Consultants, led by our CEO, who is also acting Sales Director.
There is a sales huddle every morning. Clear data, dashboards and KPIs show you where you stand, and you get a 30, 60 and 90 day ramp plan from day one.
Our sales process has been built over six years and it is thorough. The expectations are extraordinarily high.
WHAT THE ROLE ENTAILS
- Run 20 to 25 minute phone consultations with women who have enquired
- Follow our sales process and scripts
- Take payment on the call and get her session in the diary
- Follow up no-shows, "thinking about it" and past enquiries when your calendar is light
- Keep your pipeline and CRM notes clean so the next person can pick up without asking
HOW YOU'RE MEASURED
We are a target-based company. We work from metrics, data and KPIs, and your income reflects the impact you make.
You own your numbers and bring them to Huddle every morning. Once you are ramped, the minimum is 15 paid bookings a week. The standard is 20. Our best performers reach 25.
Qualifying is a big part of this role: who you invite and who you turn away. Our close rate is around 40%, because we turn away most of the other 60%.
THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF
- You are a top performer where you are now, or you know you should be
- You are happy being on the phone all day
- You like being measured and want to see your numbers every morning
- You take coaching and use it on the next call
- You can talk with women about confidence, body image, fine art nudity and money in the same conversation
- You want a career in sales with somewhere to go
REQUIREMENTS
- Sales experience over the phone or video, selling to individuals
- You have worked on commission before
- Your experience is in a service or premium business: a studio, clinic, salon, gallery, members’ club, events, travel or premium retail. Selling art, or selling for another studio, is ideal
- Experience selling phones, software, courses or information products on its own is unlikely to be enough
- Ideally you have worked remotely before
- You live within two hours of central London, ideally within 90 minutes
- You have the right to work in the UK
- You can work five days a week, with weekends as part of your normal schedule
- You are comfortable that our studio specialises in fine art nudity, and that you will talk with women about it
YOUR HOME OFFICE
This is a remote role and guests hear everything behind you, so your set-up matters.
- A private room with a door, where nobody else comes in while you work. We strongly favour a dedicated office over a bedroom
- Fast, reliable internet: at least 100 Mbps download and 100 Mbps upload
- Your own laptop and monitor for your first 60 days. The company supplies equipment after 60 to 90 days
WHERE IT LEADS
There is a lot of support and a lot of growth in this seat: daily sales training, one-to-one coaching and a clear scorecard.
As you prove yourself you can be cross-trained to sell our artwork and collections on onboarding calls, and progress to an Art Curator role. We promote from within.
PAY
This is a base salary plus uncapped commission role. On-target earnings are £50,000 to £70,000.
HOW TO APPLY
Complete the short application form. If it’s a fit, the next step is three short video answers.

Sincere Candour.
Radical Accountability.
Uncompromising Excellence.

The AI Operating System for Private Capital.
Capsa
Private capital funds have to find potential investments, research and analyse them thoroughly, monitor them over time, drive improvements, and decide when to buy and sell. They've got to see through the marketing. They've got to outbid the competition. And they've got to learn from every deal they do. Historically, these processes have run on people, we are building the AI Operating System that will run them in the future.
We're focused, ambitious, and obsessed with building a category-defining company. In the last 12 months we've grown ARR 15x, achieved product–market fit with leading multi-billion-dollar PE firms, and expanded across the US, UK, and Europe. Now we're doubling down: we've raised a large Series A from top-tier VC investors to scale the team. We're hiring hyper-talented people who want to work at the forefront of AI and revolutionise an industry.
The role
You’ll manage the engineers across three squads (intelligence, experience and platform), own hiring and people development, and strengthen technical leadership within each team.
You’ll partner with the product managers in Intelligence and Experience and the squads’ technical leads to translate company priorities into clear objectives, shape solutions together, and agree credible delivery plans. You’ll make sure engineers contribute to understanding customer problems and exploring solutions rather than just implementing requirements.
Across the three squads, you’ll be accountable for engineering capability, the quality of our work, and delivery against agreed commitments. You’ll make capacity, dependencies and risks visible, resolve obstacles, and work with Product and the CTO when priorities, scope or timing need to change. Alongside the squads and Product, you’ll share responsibility for the outcomes the work achieves.
The opportunity
- You’ll own hiring, coaching and performance management across all three squads, developing engineers and technical leads who can make good decisions and take responsibility for their work.
- There’s real scope to shape engineering management at Capsa, working with the CTO and Product to establish clear responsibilities and a consistent operating approach in a lean, flat structure.
- You'll work alongside a small, senior and high performing engineering team
- Meaningful equity in a company that grew ARR 15x last year
What you'll achieve in the first six months
- Formed an evidence-based view of the codebase, delivery process and engineering capability across all three squads, and agreed the most important improvements with the CTO and Product.
- Made your first hiring and team-shape decisions, grounded in the capabilities and capacity each squad needs.
- Established regular coaching and clear expectations for your engineers, with a grounded view of who’s thriving, who needs support and where the gaps are.
- Established clear technical ownership within each squad, with engineers taking responsibility for decisions and technical leads working effectively with Product.
- Helped the squads deliver meaningful improvements end to end, and assessed their impact on customers or the teams that depend on them.
- Put an agreed, lightweight planning and delivery rhythm into practice across the squads, making commitments, dependencies and risks visible without centralising every decision.
Recent projects from the team
- Agent Harness: our own agent harness built on a custom, streaming-first graph execution framework
- Code Execution Framework: interruptible and resumable mid-execution, for programmatic tool calling
- Document Ingestion, Indexing, and Search: a VLM-based OCR pipeline, a self-hosted search cluster, domain-aware search strategies
- Citations: an end-to-end approach to reviewing supporting documentation behind AI-generated statements
- Document Authoring: agent tooling and a document editor supporting collaborative authoring across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and email
Track record
- Managed engineers directly for a few years; before that, a strong individual contributor at a venture-backed startup or a serious tech company
- You’ve coordinated work across teams or substantial parallel workstreams, resolving dependencies and competing demands while keeping ownership with the engineers doing the work.
- Hired people, developed them, and made calls about team shape as things scaled or didn't go to plan
- Shipped distributed systems, data pipelines, or platform services to production through a team you led
- Comfortable operating at pace, with incomplete information
How you operate
- Takes responsibility for what your team ships and its effect on customers, not just internal velocity metrics
- Thinks carefully about the problems being solved and the decisions the team makes; uses AI to sharpen that thinking, not replace it
- Accepts that time is short and information is incomplete, makes progress anyway, and adjusts as more is known
If this opportunity excites you
We'd like to meet you. Initial conversations are direct and substantive, going deep on the work, the team, and what you'd own in the first six months.

THE ROLE
We are hiring a Founding Customer Success Lead/Manager for the UK market.

You will own the full customer journey, from executive alignment and implementation through long-term adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion. You will build trusted relationships with C-level and VP-level leaders, help customers navigate the organizational change that comes with adopting AI, and turn successful customer outcomes into a repeatable Customer Success motion from our London HQ.

Dust is an AI-native company, and that changes what Customer Success can look like. You will help customers understand how AI can reshape their work while using AI to make your own practice more effective, scalable, and precise.
This role is suited to someone who combines executive presence with a strong builder's mindset. You should be comfortable operating without a finished playbook, making decisions with incomplete information, and taking responsibility for outcomes from beginning to end.
