DIRECTOR OF PRODUCT, WORKFLOWS
CreatorIQ is the software enterprise brands and agencies run their creator marketing programs on. A large customer works with thousands of creators a year across dozens of programs and several markets, and every one of those partnerships has to be sourced, vetted, agreed, briefed, tracked and paid for. You'll own that operational core and lead the product teams that cover it today, accountable for making the whole thing feel like one operation instead of a series of handoffs.
The mandate is to rebuild that operation around AI. Tooling in this category, ours included, was designed for a world where a person did each step by hand, and it still assumes that. It scales by adding people. A community manager keeping a 2,000-creator program on track lives in spreadsheets. An agency casting 300 creators against a brief in a week gets there by throwing bodies at it. Your job is to change what the software is responsible for, so programs scale without the headcount and the people running them spend their time on decisions that need judgment.
IN THIS ROLE, YOU’LL GET TO:
- Own the workflow end to end. Discovery, Lists, Community, Campaigns and Messaging are one continuous job for our customers, and today they feel like separate products. Making them one, and making most of it happen without a human clicking through it, is the mandate.
- Lead and grow a team of product managers. You'll set the bar for how they work, coach them on discovery and judgment, and give them enough room to own their surfaces without you in the middle of every decision.
- Decide what gets rebuilt agentically, what gets simplified, and what gets deleted. Plenty of our existing workflow exists because someone needed a manual solution in 2020. Some of it should be automated, some should be replaced by a better model of the problem, and some should just go away.
- Get the trust model right. Provenance, confidence, human-in-the-loop review, honest failure, and clean rollback are what decide whether an enterprise customer lets an agent touch a live campaign.
- Partner with engineering and design leadership on architecture and delivery. Schema, core service, bulk operations, permissions, the data model that both the UI and the agents read from. You need to be credible in those conversations, not just present for them.
WHO YOU ARE AND WHAT YOU’LL NEED FOR THIS POSITION:
- You've spent 8+ years in product, including 2+ leading product managers. Titles matter less than the work, but we need someone who has managed PMs before and knows the difference between coaching and taking over.
- You've owned a broad, workflow-heavy B2B SaaS surface where the product is the customer's daily job.
- You have a builder's mindset and haven't stopped being hands-on. You prototype. You use AI tools to build the thing rather than write a doc about the thing, and you expect the same from your team.
- You've rebuilt a manual workflow around AI and know the difference between removing the work and putting a chat box in front of the same twelve clicks. You're fluent in the mechanics too: retrieval, tool use, evaluation, human-in-the-loop review, and where an agent shouldn't be allowed to act alone.
- You have real product taste and you use it on AI output. You can look at an agent's plan, a generated brief, or a search result and say why it's good or why it's plausible-sounding filler. You ask the same question of a big customer's request or an inherited roadmap item: does this actually solve the problem?
- You're technical enough to hold your own on data model and API design. Schemas, CRUDL, bulk operations, permissions, third-party integrations. You can tell when a small-sounding request is touching something structural.
- You can prioritize across teams with genuinely competing claims and explain the tradeoff so the people who lost the argument still understand it.
- You write well. Most of how we work is async and in docs, and a Director who can only communicate in meetings will not scale here.
- You take initiative and own outcomes. You don't wait to be told the priority, and you'd rather bring a proposal than a list of questions. You're curious, self-driven, low-ego, and allergic to "that's not my job."
- Comfortable working with distributed teams across time zones. Most work is async and flexible, but occasionally we'll ask for a later call.
Nice to have
- Experience with influencer marketing, creator workflows, or martech.
- Experience building search, discovery, or recommendation products, including semantic or multimodal search.
- Experience shipping CRM, relationship management, or lifecycle products.
- Experience shipping AI features into enterprise accounts where governance, auditability and permissions were part of the deal.
- Experience hiring product managers and building a team from a partial bench.

PRODUCT MANAGER, SAFETY & COMPLIANCE
CreatorIQ is the software enterprise brands and agencies use to run their creator marketing programs. Customers include Burson, Delta Air Lines, Google, LVMH, Nestlé and Sephora. Those programs only hold up if the content is brand safe, sponsorships are disclosed, the music is cleared, and every campaign follows the rules in the markets it runs in. You'll own the product that makes that happen.
The core is SafeIQ, our always-on brand safety system. It runs multimodal AI classification on audio, video, images and text across millions of creator posts, and flags risk before it becomes a headline.
If you like turning messy classification and regulatory problems into workflows that risk, legal and compliance teams trust, you'll fit in. We're growing fast, and we work with teams around the world who care about doing great work.
IN THIS ROLE, YOU’LL GET TO:
- Own the in-app brand safety review and workflow experience end to end, with one goal: shorten the path from "AI flagged something" to "a human made a confident decision." Ship, measure, learn, repeat.
- Decide how AI classification reaches people: severity, categories, thresholds, review states and false-positive handling. Work with data science on what the models look for across audio, video, images and text, how confident they need to be before surfacing something, and where a human stays in the loop. Make every flag explainable and auditable.
- Own compliance beyond content risk: sponsorship and ad disclosure under FTC guidelines and their equivalents, music licensing and rights clearance, legal drinking age (LDA) rules for alcohol promotion, and GDPR and regional privacy requirements. Work with Legal, Trust & Safety and regional compliance stakeholders to stay ahead of regulatory change without making every workflow wait on a legal review.
- Understand the business nuance for API contracts, webhook payloads and data models with engineering so customers can pull safety and compliance signals into their own systems.
- Work with GTM on positioning, packaging and enablement so what we sell matches what the product does and what regulators require.
WHO YOU ARE AND WHAT YOU’LL NEED FOR THIS POSITION:
- You've spent 4+ years in product management or equivalent technical product ownership in B2B SaaS.
- You have good product taste. You can look at an AI-generated feature or output and tell good UX from an AI slop, and you can say why.
- You think critically and independently. You don't take a model's output, a legal requirement, a stakeholder request or a roadmap item at face value.
- You can turn a dense, ambiguous regulatory or licensing requirement into a workflow engineers can build, and write it up clearly without needing a meeting.
- You know the basics of AI classification pipelines: inference, confidence thresholds, false positives and negatives, and human review. You don't have to build them.
- You're comfortable with API contracts, webhooks and role-based access well enough to write requirements with engineers.
- You care more about solving real user problems, like getting a risk team to zero backlog with confidence, than about shipping features for their own sake.
- You're curious, self-driven and low-ego. You own the product end to end, don't wait to be told what's next, and are allergic to "that's not my job."
- You're comfortable working with distributed teams. Most work is async and flexible, but occasionally we'll ask for a later call. Stakeholders for this role are distributed across NA, EU, and APAC timezones

- Experience with multimodal AI, content classification or ML evaluation workflows.

- Build trusted relationships with technical and scientific stakeholders at customer organizations
- Champion the adoption of AI delivery practices within the PS team and with customers

- Background developing a team that has proven technical, business or scientific, and consulting skills for delivery success.
- Proven experience leading distributed teams across multiple European countries, including navigating differing labor environments and travel/delivery cadences.
- Experience leading and developing a strong set of managers that own delivery quality and execution, as a second line leader.
- Direct experience managing delivery through third-party systems integrator partners, including holding partners accountable for quality.
- Strong commercial acumen: comfort owning SOW economics, margin, and forecasting
- Executive presence with technical and scientific buyers; ability to run high-stakes EBRs and escalations.
- Fluency in English required; additional European languages (German, French) a strong plus given the DACH and French-speaking customer base.
- Genuine enthusiasm for AI-enabled delivery models.

This is a highly visible role that partners with both external and internal teams to develop the optimal solutions that drive the most value for our customers. The SC is a pre-sales role, and as such works closely with Benchling sales leadership, account executives, professional services, and product leaders to ensure the best solutions are presented. SCs work with senior scientific and IT leaders from prospects and customers, to establish credibility and confidence from the first meeting, and to create solutions based on cutting-edge technologies.

- Manage organized discoveries to uncover customer needs and requirements that relate to decision criteria and key business issues.
- Craft solutions based on Benchling capabilities, industry best practices and standard R&D functions, with data models and processes that map to the customer or prospects' science and that fit into their current technology landscape.
- Present and demonstrate the solution in a persuasive way based on key messages, decision criteria, and key business issues. Manage customer questions and objections and resolve concerns. Ensure that the solution is presented competitively, with awareness of alternatives including build in house.
- Engage with product management to provide insight into prospect and customer needs and industry trends. Influence the roadmap for market success. Ensure that the roadmap is clear to customers as required to influence buying decisions.

QUALIFICATIONS
- Master’s in Biology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Biochemistry, Chemistry or similar Life Science field, with a minimum of 4 years of work experience, ideally customer facing.
- Experience with scientific/informatics software such as LIMS, ELN, or others preferred. Familiarity with antibody engineering software is a plus.
- Experience in demonstrating scientific software in a pre-sales setting to top 20 biotech and pharma companies is highly desired.
- Demonstrated capacity to effectively model scientific data, and craft solutions, based on product knowledge and industry best practices. Prior experience in demonstrating and supporting research instruments, reagents or software desired.
- Understand research technology generally adopted by biopharma companies.
- Have an agile and adaptable mentality, and can quickly implement new customer engagement processes.
- Ability to establish as a trusted advisor for scientists, and successfully pitch to scientific buyers.
- Must be fluent in English. Fluency in German or French is a plus.
- Willingness to travel to customer sites 25-30%.

- Contribute actively to the evolution of CUBE Intel's GTM strategy, using market and customer insights to refine targeting, messaging and sales execution.

- You will be a hands-on sales professional with a strong new business sales background and a proven track record of selling SaaS solutions
- Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
- Ability to build trusted, long-term relationships with new prospects and senior stakeholders.
- Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles in a B2B environment.
- A self-starter who is proactive in building their own pipeline; whilst a dedicated BDR function will support lead generation, candidates must be comfortable with independent outreach and market mapping.

- Experience with structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or equivalent.
- Background in financial services, compliance, risk or regulatory technology - direct sector experience is a strong advantage but not a necessity.
Interested?

Role Mission
The Data Solution Architect defines and owns the design of scalable, secure, and high-performing data solutions that support customer and operational systems. This role is responsible for setting architectural direction, ensuring alignment with business needs, and guiding teams to deliver robust, production-grade solutions.
The Data Solution Architect works across engineering, product, and data teams to ensure solutions are well-designed, maintainable, and aligned with standards for performance, security, and governance.
Key Responsibilities
- Design and own end-to-end data solution architectures that meet defined requirements for scalability, performance, security, and maintainability.
- Translate complex business and product requirements into clear architectural designs, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and future scalability needs.
- Define and enforce technical standards for data architecture, including data modelling, integration patterns, and system design.
- Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineering teams, supporting implementation and ensuring adherence to architectural principles.
- Review and approve solution designs, code, and implementations to ensure quality, consistency, and alignment with standards.
- Ensure solutions meet defined performance and reliability benchmarks (e.g. system throughput, latency, fault tolerance).
- Lead the identification and resolution of complex technical issues, including performance bottlenecks and architectural limitations.
- Drive improvements in system design, scalability, and maintainability through proactive refactoring and architectural evolution.
- Define and support implementation of CI/CD, testing, and deployment strategies to ensure reliable and efficient delivery.
- Ensure all solutions adhere to security, privacy, and compliance requirements, including secure data handling practices.
- Maintain clear architectural documentation, including system designs, decision records, and operational guidance.
- Collaborate with cross-functional and global teams to align on architecture, standards, and delivery priorities.
Skills & Competencies
- Data Architecture & System Design – Strong experience designing scalable, distributed data systems, including data models, storage, and processing layers.
- SQL & Data Processing – Deep understanding of SQL and data querying, with ability to design efficient data structures and transformations.
- Data Integration & Pipelines (ETL/ELT) – Expertise in designing and optimising data pipelines (e.g. SSIS or equivalent tools and frameworks).
- Programming (e.g. Python) – Experience using Python or similar languages for data processing, automation, or pipeline development.
- Cloud & Platform Technologies – Familiarity with modern data platforms and cloud-based architectures (desirable).
- Performance & Scalability Optimisation – Ability to design and tune systems to meet performance, reliability, and scalability requirements.
- Security & Compliance – Strong understanding of secure system design, data protection, and regulatory requirements.
- DevOps & CI/CD – Experience implementing automated build, test, and deployment pipelines to support reliable delivery.
- Technical Leadership – Provides architectural guidance, reviews work, and supports teams in delivering high-quality solutions.
- Cross-Team Influence – Works across teams and regions to align on standards, resolve dependencies, and drive consistency.
Required Experience & Qualifications
- Proven experience in a data architecture, software engineering, or technical leadership role (typically 7+ years).
- Strong experience designing and delivering scalable data solutions in production environments.
- Expertise in data modelling, system design, and integration patterns.
- Strong experience with SQL and data processing at scale.
- Experience working with data pipeline and ETL tools (e.g. SSIS or equivalent).
- Experience with programming languages (e.g. Python) for data processing or automation.
- Experience defining or contributing to technical standards and architecture frameworks.
- Proven ability to lead technical design and guide delivery across teams.
- Strong communication skills, including translating technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders
Interested?
If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.

JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Description
In our world, “high ticket” is anything with a price point of about $10k or above. We firmly believe that some of the most talented sales professionals in the world are underpaid because they’re in the wrong vehicle selling the wrong product. We take pride in seeking out top talent, developing them further, and enabling them to reach new levels of earning potential through high ticket sales with Curvion Blue. With our world class marketing systems we are constantly bringing new leads into our ecosystem, however our biggest bottleneck to scaling is generating more sales appointments from all of these leads that have already shown interest in our products, which is where you come in! When it comes to outbound dialing, there are two main buckets: cold calling, and warm dialing, which comes down to one main distinction: Warm dialing consists of only calling leads that have specifically opted in to our marketing campaigns and have expressed interest in learning more about our offers. We are looking for motivated sales development representatives or “setters” that are willing to make a ton of warm dials to consistently generate qualified sales appointments and new pipeline that leads to more revenue for Curvion Blue.
Base Pay with Competitive Commission Structure & Earning Potential! Selling Life Changing Products!
Endless Warm Leads to Dial from Word Class Marketing!
Fast Sales Career Advancement
A Snapshot of Curvion Blue:
Curvion Blue is a fast paced, high performance sales agency that provides what is referred to as “done for you sales” services to our clients. Think of a lead generation based marketing agency…. But focused on sales. Put simply, our clients outsource their sales department to us and we sell their services/packages to help them scale faster than ever before while changing as many people’s lives as possible. The main verticals we service are in the online, digital marketing based community with companies that have educational programs that teach high paying skill sets which is referred to as “alternative education.” We sell a range of transformative programs and packages including everything from business consulting programs, to programs that teach people how to invest in real estate, learn mergers and acquisitions and many many more. The world is changing and so is the education space with college application and admission rates down significantly. Bespoke alternative education is a multi billion dollar a year industry and growing, and you can be a part of the gold rush. We believe people’s dream lives are just on the other side of receiving the right information- we’re responsible for getting that to them.

Although this role requires lots of outbound dialing (to warm leads that have opted in to learn more about our programs), there are also inbound calls that will need to be screened & qualified while amplifying interest in our offers. - Base to compensate for your time, commissions to compensate for your results

- Sales career advancement opportunities to be trained and promoted into a closer

- Offers that change our customers lives!!

- Arrange and coordinate meetings between prospective customers and closers.

- Consistently increase product knowledge by consuming the content in the sales training center.
- Participate in daily sales syncs via zoom to discuss sales initiatives, study sales call game tape, and strategize around the pipeline.
- Engage in question led discovery dialogue to identify challenges, pain points, and gaps that create the need, desire, & urgency for Curvion Blue's offers.
- Build relationships with leads, using a consultative sales approach to understand their goals, objectives, and dominant buying motives.
- Utilize Curvion Blue's sales material to ensure leads consume content prior to showing up to the call with a closer
- Achieve or exceed sales appointment quotas and targets, consistently meeting or exceeding sales performance expectations.
- Adhere to CRM best practices to track and manage sales activities, including lead management, follow-up, and accurate forecasting.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless and successful sales process.
- Display Curvion Blue's core values at all times to contribute to a high performance culture.
Requirements:
- 6 months of previous experience as an SDR or appointment setter in a high ticket sales or consultative sales process
- Effective communication and presentation skills
- Self-starter with a strong drive for success
- Ability to work independently and manage time effectively
- Excellent people skills with the ability to create rapport
- Experience and working knowledge of CRM systems
You SHOULD apply if:
- KNOW you were born to be a top producer/top earner
- You have experience in phone/zoom sales
- You’re a competitive individual that understands sales is a numbers game
- You want to advance your sales career but don’t have tons of experience as a closer yet
- You’re hungry with tenacity and not afraid of high output dialing
- Bring energy and enthusiasm to every room you’re in
- You’re a strategic individual and thoroughly enjoy the sales process
- You’re extremely coachable and disciplined
- You can learn and adapt quickly in a fast paced sales environment
You should NOT apply if:
- Aren’t all of the things listed above
- Can’t commit to learning our systems, processes, and offer
- Don’t work well in a structured team setting with other top performers
- Don’t have amazing communication skills
- Are a one trick pony and not a dynamic individual
- Get stressed out in fast paced operations
- NEED results overnight
- You don’t have sales experience
Job Type: Full-time
Pay: $55,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year OTE

- Bonus opportunities
- Uncapped commission

- Monday to Friday

jobs.ashbyhq.com/curvionblue/79746b4e-50.description_excerpt:
TALENT ACQUISITION SPECIALIST SNAPSHOT
Curvion Blue is looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who knows how to find, assess, and attract high-performing sales talent.
This isn't a traditional HR recruiting role where you're posting jobs, waiting for applications, and hoping the right person wanders into the funnel.
You're going to be responsible for building and managing talent pipelines for sales roles across our business, with a heavy focus on identifying A-Players who can perform in high-ticket sales environments.
The ideal candidate has experience in Talent Acquisition or recruiting and understands how to source, qualify, interview, and move candidates through a high-volume hiring process.
Bonus points if you've actually sold before. Extra bonus points if you've sold high-ticket.
We want someone who understands salespeople because they've been one, worked closely with them, or recruited them extensively.
POSITION OVERVIEW
As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will own recruiting across Curvion Blue's sales organization and help us continuously build a bench of exceptional talent.
You'll work closely with leadership to understand what "great" looks like for each role, then take that profile into the market and find the people who match it.
This is a hands-on recruiting role for someone who enjoys sourcing, talking to candidates, assessing talent, and moving quickly.
You will be responsible for the full recruiting lifecycle, including sourcing, candidate outreach, screening, interview coordination, candidate evaluation, pipeline management, and offer management.
More importantly, you'll become an expert in identifying the difference between someone who sounds like a great salesperson and someone who can actually perform.
YOUR CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
Talent Sourcing
- Build proactive talent pipelines for closers, setters, sales leaders, and other revenue-generating roles.
- Source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, communities, databases, and creative outbound strategies.
- Develop targeted sourcing strategies based on role requirements and candidate profiles.
- Continuously build talent pools rather than starting from zero every time a role opens.
Candidate Qualification
- Conduct recruiter screens to evaluate experience, communication, motivation, sales ability, and overall fit.
- Identify candidates with demonstrated performance rather than relying solely on resume keywords.
- Assess candidates against defined scorecards and role-specific success profiles.
- Understand sales metrics, quotas, KPIs, close rates, lead flow, revenue, and other performance indicators.
- Identify red flags and know when to move a candidate forward versus cut them from the process.
Sales Talent Acquisition
- Become deeply familiar with high-ticket sales roles and the characteristics of top-performing setters, closers, sales directors, and sales leaders.
- Understand the difference between legitimate sales experience and resume fluff.
- Build relationships with high-performing sales professionals and maintain a warm talent network.
- Help Curvion Blue become known as a destination for high-performing sales talent.
Candidate Experience
- Own candidate communication throughout the recruiting process.
- Keep candidates engaged, informed, and moving through each stage.
- Represent Curvion Blue professionally and enthusiastically.
- Create a candidate experience that reflects the level of talent we want to attract.
Recruiting Operations
- Maintain accurate candidate data and pipeline stages in our ATS.
- Track recruiting metrics including pipeline volume, conversion rates, time-to-fill, source performance, and quality of hire.
- Coordinate interviews, skills assessments, roleplays, and other evaluation stages.
- Partner with hiring managers to continuously improve the recruiting process.
- Identify bottlenecks and recommend ways to improve recruiting efficiency.
Hiring & Onboarding Partnership
- Support offer creation and candidate closing.
- Help ensure strong candidates remain engaged through acceptance and start date.
- Partner with the team to identify early indicators of successful hires.
- Track quality of hire and use performance data to improve future recruiting decisions.
YOU SHOULD APPLY IF
- You have 1+ years of Talent Acquisition, recruiting, or full-cycle recruiting experience.
- You have experience recruiting salespeople, preferably revenue-generating roles.
- You know how to source candidates rather than relying exclusively on inbound applicants.
- You're comfortable conducting candidate screens and making recommendations to hiring managers.
- You can quickly identify whether someone's experience actually matches what they're claiming.
- You are highly comfortable talking to salespeople.
- You understand performance-driven environments and aren't intimidated by metrics.
- You can manage multiple open roles without losing track of candidates or details.
- You're organized, responsive, and operationally strong.
- You're comfortable working in an environment where priorities can move quickly.
- You can communicate professionally with candidates at every level.
- You're proactive. If you see a recruiting problem, your instinct is to solve it rather than wait for someone to tell you what to do.
BIG BONUS POINTS
- You have past sales experience.
- You have high-ticket sales experience.
- You've been a setter, closer, AE, sales manager, or sales leader.
- You've recruited high-ticket closers or setters before.
- You've worked in coaching, consulting, SaaS, agency, or other performance-driven sales environments.
- You understand sales compensation structures and can speak intelligently about earning potential with candidates.
- You have an established network of sales talent.
- You've recruited for remote sales organizations.
YOU SHOULD NOT APPLY IF
- You only want to work inbound applications.
- You don't enjoy outbound sourcing.
- You need every step of your day mapped out for you.
- You don't like metrics or performance accountability.
- You're uncomfortable making judgment calls on candidates.
- You struggle to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
- You view recruiting as simply scheduling interviews and forwarding resumes.
- You don't enjoy talking to people.
- You're looking for a slow-moving corporate environment with six approval layers before anything gets done.
- You have never recruited before and are looking for your first opportunity in Talent Acquisition.
LONG-TERM
You become one of the people Curvion Blue relies on to answer:
"We need five great salespeople. Where are they?"
And your answer is:
"Already working on it."
THE PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR
We're not looking for someone who simply wants to "work in HR."
We're looking for a talent hunter.
Someone who enjoys the chase.
Someone who can look at a LinkedIn profile and immediately start thinking:
"This person might be good. Let me find out."

About CyberCube: https://www.cybcube.com/careers
CyberCube delivers the world's leading analytics to quantify digital risk, helping the largest global carriers, reinsurers and brokers understand, price and manage cyber risk in financial terms.
- AI at our foundation, cyber risk at our core. We don't just use AI, we shape it.
- Built on AI from day one. Artificial intelligence has been part of our strategy since the beginning, blended with deep cybersecurity and insurance expertise and backed by rigorous testing.
- Trusted by more than 100 clients, including 75% of the top 40 European and US cyber insurance carriers and 70% of the top ten reinsurance brokers.
- Backed for global growth. In 2025 Spectrum Equity joined some of CyberCube’s financial partners as a new cornerstone investor, accelerating our global growth and fueling innovation across our end-to-end cyber risk analytics for the insurance industry.
- A truly global team across San Francisco, New York, London, and Tallinn.
- A culture of collaboration, openness, intellectual rigor, and ownership for excellence.
- People at the forefront. We encourage CyberCubers to challenge themselves, push boundaries, and do the best work of their careers.
The Role
CyberCube is hiring a first-line sales leader to own our largest revenue segment: the (re)insurance sales and account management team across UK/Europe and North America.
Context
CyberCube is the market-leading cyber risk analytics platform for the insurance industry, serving large global carriers, reinsurers and brokers. The (re)insurance segment is our largest and most established revenue base, spanning new business and renewals across the UK/Europe and North America.
The team, the territory, and the pipeline are in place. This is a senior leadership role, not a build from scratch role. The postholder leads the team, owns the number, and is personally credible in front of a CRO or Chief Underwriting Officer.
What You Will Do
- Lead the (re)insurance sales and account management team across UK/Europe and North America and deliver the segment number, with a forecast we can rely on quarter to quarter.
- Hire, coach, and performance manage the team. Retain and stretch top performers.
- Run the team off numbers. Pipeline coverage, conversion, activity, cycle time. Hold a forecast, evidence it, and be held to it, with weekly inspection and CRM discipline.
- Lead the renewal and expansion motion.
- Shorten the time from qualified opportunity to signature.
- Named account coverage and territory design fit for purpose across UK/Europe and North America.
- Coach in the deal rather than from the sidelines. In the room with the team on the meetings that matter.
- Hold the room with senior insurance buyers (CUO, CRO, Chief Actuary, Head of Cyber, Head of Exposure Management) and earn a second meeting on their agenda, not ours.
- Set the tempo for the team. Travel and be visibly in market rather than managing from a desk.
What We Look For
- Proven first-line sales leadership. Has managed a team of quota-carrying sellers and ideally account managers, and hit team targets over multiple cycles.
- Has sold complex software, data or analytics into large enterprise buyers, and has led a team doing the same. Long cycles, multiple stakeholders, technical evaluation, six- and seven-figure ACVs.
- Enterprise deal experience. Multi-stakeholder, procurement and legal heavy, six to twelve month cycles, subscription or licence commercial models.
- Metrics-oriented. Knows their pipeline coverage, conversion and cycle times without looking them up, and coaches the team against those measures.
- Executive credible. Can walk into a CRO or Chief Underwriting Officer and be taken seriously on the first meeting. Articulate on the commercial argument, unfazed by seniority, trusted to represent CyberCube without supervision.
- Operates with urgency, treats a slow decision as a cost, and lifts the energy of the team.
- A demanding, high-accountability leader who sets a high bar. Direct with feedback, quick to address underperformance, and respected for it.
- Commercially creative on structure and pricing, disciplined on process and reporting.
- Low ego, high candour. Comfortable disagreeing with the executive team and being disagreed with.
- Based in London or New York, with regular international client travel.
Strong Plus
- Has sold into the insurance or reinsurance industry. Carriers, reinsurers, brokers, MGAs or the Lloyd's market. A major differentiator, but not a requirement.
- Experience across both new business and renewals/expansion, including usage-based or consumption pricing conversations.

ABOUT EUPHORIC
Euphoric builds AI-first employee benefits administration software for the world's largest and most prestigious employers. We spun out of Peppy Health — a fast-growing, Series B digital health company serving major global employers — in May 2025 to tackle what we believe is the biggest untouched opportunity in enterprise software.
Global employers spend $3–5 trillion on benefits every year. It's their second-largest cost after payroll — yet the entire category is still running on legacy systems and outdated assumptions. AI-first startups have almost completely overlooked it, and incumbents, constrained by decades-old tech stacks, simply can't move fast enough.
This isn't just a gigantic market, it's genuine tech for good.
Smarter administration, deeper insight into what employees actually need, and clearer communication have the power to directly improve the everyday lives, wellbeing, and financial security of millions of people worldwide.
We're a sharp, high-velocity team obsessed with building category-defining technology and partnering with exceptional people who want their work to truly matter.
We closed significant seed rounds in October 2025 & May 2026 and are building from a position of strength with a long cash runway. We've already secured contracts with several of the world's largest enterprises and are now preparing for rapid expansion as we scale the platform globally.
The Role
We're looking for a Forward-Deployed AI Product Associate to bring their ambition, technical curiosity, and product instinct to our high-powered team - helping us build the world's first lovable, AI-native benefits platform.
You'll have real ownership, big targets, and a chance to shape both the product and the company from the ground up. We care less about traditional career paths and more about raw talent, bias for action, and the energy you bring to hard problems.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
No two days are the same, but as a Forward-Deployed AI Product Associate you can expect to:
- Sit at the intersection of engineering, product, and client delivery - owning the end-to-end implementation of our platform for enterprise clients, from onboarding through to live deployment — including visiting clients on-site, with the opportunity for global travel as we scale internationally.
- Go deep on document analysis, extraction, and data input — foundational work for our platform's AI learning that demands intellectual rigour on the front lines.
- Design and refine AI evaluation frameworks, engineer prompts across our product suite, and track product analytics on live production data.
- Build internal agentic AI workflows that automate lengthy or manual processes.
- Get hands-on with cutting-edge tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and custom MCP integrations, with the freedom to explore new AI tooling that drives product innovation. As these tools evolve, the line between engineering, product, and design will blur — we want you to be at the frontier of that shift.
- Gather first-hand insight from both benefits administrators and employees at global enterprises, and feed that directly back into the product to shape what we build next.
- Work closely with our Chief Product Officer, Co-founder, AI Product Lead, engineers, and Product Associates at every stage of development — bridging the gap between what customers need and what gets built.
🛠️ SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
- Academic Excellence: You're a top graduate from a prestigious university, with an exceptional academic record that reflects your intellectual rigour and curiosity.
- AI Passion and Knowledge: You have a genuine, intense interest in AI. You’ll be asked to share your latest AI projects and explain how you stay on the cutting edge, as this is vitally important to the role.
- Early Career Experience: You have at least 12 months of professional experience, but are looking to progress to a role with more autonomy and ability to create impact. Prior entrepreneurial experience is highly valued.
- Continuous Learner: You have a voracious appetite for knowledge.
WHAT WE LOOK FOR:
We’re a great bunch but we have some Euphoric cultural non-negotiables. To do well here you will:
- Thrive in fast-paced, feedback-rich environments.
- Take your work seriously, but not yourself.
- Be proactive, playful, and deeply curious.
- Want to build something that matters.
- Be willing to “do what it takes.”
WHAT YOU’LL GET:
- Salary between £50k-£70k
- Meaningful early-stage equity
- Hybrid or in-person setup out of our office in Central London - the choice is entirely yours.
- Apple MacBook and unlimited access to AI tooling of your choice.
- Private healthcare via Vitality.
- 5% employer pension contribution
- 25 days holiday per year, plus bank holidays.
- Exceptional career growth

ABOUT EUPHORIC
Euphoric builds AI-first employee benefits administration software for the world's largest and most prestigious employers. We spun out of Peppy Health — a fast-growing, Series B digital health company serving major global employers — in May 2025 to tackle what we believe is the biggest untouched opportunity in enterprise software.
Global employers spend $3–5 trillion on benefits every year. It's their second-largest cost after payroll — yet the entire category is still running on legacy systems and outdated assumptions. AI-first startups have almost completely overlooked it, and incumbents, constrained by decades-old tech stacks, simply can't move fast enough.
This isn't just a gigantic market, it's genuine tech for good.
Smarter administration, deeper insight into what employees actually need, and clearer communication have the power to directly improve the everyday lives, wellbeing, and financial security of millions of people worldwide.
We're a sharp, high-velocity team obsessed with building category-defining technology and partnering with exceptional people who want their work to truly matter.
We closed significant seed rounds in October 2025 & May 2026 and are building from a position of strength with a long cash runway. We've already secured contracts with several of the world's largest enterprises and are now preparing for rapid expansion as we scale the platform globally.
The Role
We're looking for a Forward Deployed AI Product Manager to bring their ambition, technical curiosity, and product instinct to our high-powered team - helping us build the world's first lovable, AI-native benefits platform.
You'll have real ownership, big targets, and a chance to shape both the product and the company from the ground up. We care less about traditional career paths and more about raw talent, bias for action, and the energy you bring to hard problems.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
No two days are the same, but as a Forward Deployed AI Product Manager you can expect to:
- Sit at the intersection of engineering, product, and client delivery - owning the end-to-end implementation of our platform for our most complex and strategic enterprise accounts, from onboarding through to live deployment — including visiting clients on-site, with the opportunity for global travel as we scale internationally.
- Lead enterprise engagements independently. This involves configuring GAP and Navigator products for deployment, building implementation plans and pitch decks, running UAT, and handling support queries.
- Own and lead product development projects end to end alongside engineering and design from client requirement to shipped product and be accountable for the outcomes.
- Design and refine AI evaluation frameworks, engineer prompts across our product suite, and track product analytics on live production data.
- Build internal agentic AI workflows that automate lengthy or manual processes — org-wide Claude, skills, and custom Slack workflows — and set the direction on internal tooling as its complexity grows.
- Get hands-on with cutting-edge tools like Claude Code, Cowork, Cursor, and custom MCP integrations, with the freedom to explore new AI tooling that drives product innovation — setting the standard for AI tooling across the team. As these tools evolve, the line between engineering, product, and design will blur — we want you to be at the frontier of that shift.
- Gather first-hand insight from both benefits administrators and employees at global enterprises, and feed that directly back into the product to shape what we build next.
- Work closely with our Chief Product Officer, Co-founder, AI Product Lead, engineers, and Product Associates at every stage of development — bridging the gap between what customers need and what gets built.
SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
- Academic Excellence: You have an exceptional academic track record from a top Russell Group university with strong A-levels. A STEM degree is desirable but not essential.
- AI Passion and Fluency: You have a genuine, intense interest in AI and are fluent in AI tooling (Claude Code/Cowork, Cursor, Codex etc) - setting the standard for others. You’ll be asked to share your latest AI projects and explain how you stay on the cutting edge, as this is vitally important to the role. GitHub and CI/CD competence is a nice-to-have.
- Experience: You have 2+ years of experience in a product, technical, or technology role, ideally with client-facing experience in a technical capacity. Prior entrepreneurial experience is highly valued.
- Track Record of High Performance: You can show evidence of reaching the top of something demanding — elite or competitive sport, music, gaming, unusually fast promotion, or national or international academic awards.
- Continuous Learner: You have a voracious appetite for knowledge.
WHAT WE LOOK FOR:
We’re a great bunch but we have some Euphoric cultural non-negotiables. To do well here you will:
- Thrive in fast-paced, feedback-rich environments.
- Take your work seriously, but not yourself.
- Be proactive, playful, and deeply curious.
- Want to build something that matters.
- Be willing to “do what it takes.”
WHAT YOU’LL GET:
- Salary between £70k-£90k
- Meaningful early-stage equity
- Hybrid or in-person setup out of our office in Central London - the choice is entirely yours.
- Apple MacBook and unlimited access to AI tooling of your choice.
- Private healthcare via Vitality.
- 3% matched pension contribution.
- 25 days holiday per year, plus bank holidays.
- Regular R&D team off-sites - recent trips include Gdansk, Porto, Madrid, and Lisbon.

ABOUT GAP & NAVIGATOR
GAP and Navigator are the two products that power Euphoric, and they’re two halves of one experience. GAP is where benefits teams at global companies run their benefits: the single source of truth for every benefit, in every country. Navigator is where their employees actually discover and use those benefits, branded for each client.
The platform has scale and momentum. Real clients, real revenue, and plenty still to do on both sides. You’ll inherit decisions and legacy while pushing both products forward at pace.
ABOUT THE ROLE
You’ll be Euphoric’s sole product designer initially, covering both products. There’s no separate “GAP designer” or “Navigator designer”. Administrators live in GAP, employees live in Navigator, the data flows between them, and you need to think in both directions at once.
You’ll own the experience vision across both products, frame the hardest problems, and ship opinionated design from discovery to production. You’ll partner with product, engineering, and leadership as peers, and still be in Figma/vibing yourself most days.
You need to be exceptional at both halves of product design. Visual craft (typography, colour, layout, hierarchy, motion) at the level of a strong brand or art director. Product design fundamentals (flows, IA, interaction, systems thinking) at the level of a lead designer at a top tier product company. One without the other doesn’t work.
The profile that thrives here: agency, studio, or exceptional product background. Somewhere craft, pace, and breadth all had to coexist. You will need to be extremely comfortable managing ambiguity, a lack of formal structure and a flat hierarchy. You’ll encounter many people with strong opinions, but you will always be the ultimate owner of product design.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
- Own design across GAP and Navigator, from discovery through to delivery.
- Set an exceptionally high bar on visual craft. Typography, colour, layout, hierarchy, motion.
- Set the same bar on product design fundamentals. Flows, IA, interaction, systems thinking.
- Design for both audiences. Every decision needs to work for the benefits teams running GAP and the employees living in Navigator at the same time.
- Shape strategy with product and engineering. Roadmap, opportunities, problems worth solving.
- Run discovery. Journeys, hypotheses, research.
- Prototype heavily, including with AI tools. You’ll set the example for how the rest of the team works in time.
- Evolve Euphoric’s design system, principles, and ways of working as the products grow.
- Communicate decisions clearly. Bring stakeholders with you on rationale and evidence.
SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
- Experience working in B2B Enterprise products. You have a proven track record of designing and scaling complex, data-heavy B2B Enterprise platforms. You excel at managing intricate product areas like client configuration and dynamic tables, balancing business requirements with user-centric design to deliver high-impact solutions.
- Exceptional at both halves of product design. Visual craft (typography, colour, layout, hierarchy, motion) and product fundamentals (flows, IA, interaction, systems thinking). You notice the 4px misalignment, and you also know why the user dropped off at step 3.
- You’ve designed for products where multiple audiences matter equally. You think naturally about balancing them, not just optimising for one.
- 8+ years in product design with a portfolio of shipped work in complex, cross-functional environments. Your portfolio should look as good as it works.
- Comfortable with complexity. You navigate complex systems and high-growth environments without getting bogged down, knowing how to prioritize impact while building for the future.
- Self-sufficient by default. You can take a vague brief and a Slack thread and turn it into a shipped experience without needing the path cleared.
- Built for remote. We’re a fully remote company. You work in the open, over-communicate by instinct, and don’t need a studio around you to keep your bar high.
- Comfortable building with AI yourself. Prototyping is a core part of how you work.
- Curious about where AI is going. You think about new patterns, not retrofitted versions of old ones.
- Strong product thinking. You connect design decisions to user needs, business outcomes, and commercial reality.
- Comfortable making decisions when the data is incomplete.
- Able to move between strategic conversations with leadership and detailed production work with engineers, often in the same day.
- Strong communicator. You earn influence through evidence and outcomes.
- Thrive in a demanding, fast-paced environment. You are super-flexible and can adapt quickly to changing priorities, maintaining high standards under pressure.
Euphoric is a demanding, fast-paced environment. You'll need to be super-flexible and able to pivot quickly as priorities shift, maintaining high standards even when things are moving fast.
If this sounds like the kind of challenge you've been waiting for, let's talk.

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.
Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.
A feel for our culture:
To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.
That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.
We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.
But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.
Does this sound like you?
Flagstone is the UK's leading cash platform with £19bn in Assets under Administration and a mandate to reach £50bn by 2028. Our relationship with one of the UK's largest national wealth networks is the largest and most strategically significant partnership in the business, and this role leads the team responsible for making the most of it.
The Relationship Team Leader manages a team of four field-based Account Relationship Managers, each covering a defined territory within the network's Partner base. But this is not a purely managerial role. They are expected to be a player-manager actively contributing to Partner engagement and referral growth in their own right, while simultaneously elevating the performance of the team around them. The balance between personal contribution and team leadership is a defining feature of the role, and we are looking for someone who is genuinely energised by both.
The network spans over 5,000 Partners across four regions, of which around half have referred clients to Flagstone in the last twelve months. The opportunity within the existing partner base is significant - this role is not about finding new partners, but about deepening engagement, increasing referral frequency, and ensuring that Flagstone is firmly embedded in the way Partners think about their clients' cash. At the same time, this position plays an important role in the commercial relationship with the network more broadly, acting as the senior day-to-day point of contact and escalation for the partnership.
What You'll Be Doing
Team Leadership & Performance
- Lead, develop and motivate a team of four field-based ARMs, setting clear expectations, providing regular coaching and creating the conditions for each individual to perform at their best
- Own the overall performance of the ARM team, monitoring regional referral volumes, Partner engagement levels and conversion activity, and intervening proactively when performance needs to improve
- Run a consistent team rhythm: regular one-to-ones, joint field visits, call reviews and team performance sessions that keep the team focused, accountable and continuously improving
- Support the recruitment, onboarding and development of ARMs, building a team with the capability, knowledge and culture to sustain high performance as the partnership grows
- Act as the first point of escalation for the ARM team when they encounter complex Partner situations, difficult conversations or issues that need senior involvement
Personal Partner Engagement
- Maintain your own portfolio of Partners including the most senior and strategically important relationships within the network, spending meaningful time in the field and contributing directly to referral growth
- Personally lead engagement with regional management teams across the network, building relationships at a level above individual Partner that enables the team to operate with greater reach and credibility
- Model the standard of Partner engagement you expect from your ARMs, in how you present the Flagstone proposition, how you handle objections, and how you build trust with Partners over time
- Step in on high-value or sensitive Partner situations where your seniority and experience can make a material difference to the outcome
Proposition Training & Partner Development
- Ensure the ARM team is consistently delivering high-quality, accurate and compelling presentations of the Flagstone proposition across their respective territories
- Lead training sessions for Partners yourself where the audience or occasion warrants senior representation e.g. regional events, group practice meetings, or the onboarding of newly active practices
- Keep both the team and the Partner network up to date with product developments and platform enhancements, ensuring Partners always have the information they need to refer with confidence
- Work with the Head of Sales Operations and the network's head office to develop and deliver co-created engagement plans that embed Flagstone within their adviser framework
Commercial Oversight & Reporting
- Maintain a clear and current view of the channel's commercial performance, referral volumes, funded accounts, AuA contribution and regional variances, and report with confidence to the Head of Sales Operations
- Identify where performance is ahead of or behind expectations, diagnose the reasons, and bring a clear point of view on what action is needed
- Feed insight from the Partner network back into the business, surfacing themes around Partner sentiment, platform friction, competitive activity and product gaps that should inform internal decisions
What You'll Bring
Player-Manager Experience
- A proven track record of leading a field-based sales or relationship management team, combined with a continued personal contribution to commercial outcomes
- The ability to hold both responsibilities well simultaneously: your team's performance improves under your leadership, and your own Partner relationships are stronger for your seniority and experience
- Experience coaching and developing individuals in a field environment (e.g. joint visits, call reviews, targeted feedback) with a genuine investment in the growth of the people around you
Network & Financial Services Knowledge
- A strong understanding of how a large adviser Partner network operates e.g. the restricted adviser structure, the role of regional management, and the dynamics of a corporate distribution partnership at this scale
- Broader financial services knowledge that allows you to engage credibly with Partners about their clients' financial planning needs and the role that cash management plays within them
- An understanding of what it takes to build trust and drive behaviour change within a large, structured adviser network, where engagement is won relationship by relationship, not through a single lever

- Defending analytical methodology under scrutiny, clearly articulating why a model or approach was chosen over alternatives and what could undermine it
- Exercising independent judgement on when an insight is significant enough to escalate and when it can wait, taking accountability for the downstream business impact of analytical outputs, not just their technical correctness
- Owning the most complex and high impact analytical work, including methodology selection, assumptions, and interpretation.
- Ensuring all outputs are trusted, contextualised, reproducible, and aligned with governance expectations before informing decisions.

- Significant experience in data analytics, including ownership of high stakes analysis and operation as a hybrid IC / manager.
- Demonstrated ability to manage C Suite level stakeholders, with the gravitas and credibility to influence at the most senior levels and the confidence to challenge when the data demands it
- Proven track record of landing self serve adoption where you've led a team through this shift before. You can point to measurable outcomes e.g. falling ad hoc volume, teams confidently self-serving, sustained change.
- Experience rebalancing accountability in matrixed environments. You've worked in cross functional organisations where product/tribe leadership needed to own their data insights. You know how to escalate, how to hold boundaries, and how to make the shift stick.
- Experience in building partnerships across functions, not just within your team or your immediate leadership chain, but with tribe leads, product managers, and operational teams. You've driven adoption of your team's work.
- Strong hands on technical capability, including SQL, Power BI, and Python or similar. You build capability by doing, not just directing.
- Communication and conviction, with the ability to operate credibly with senior stakeholders and hold the line on quality and ways of working when it matters.

Join Dash0 and help us define the future of observability. We are OpenTelemetry-native, building a delightful, simple, and AI-centric platform that eliminates vendor lock-in and meaningless toil. Shape a product developers love, with transparent pricing and built-in cost control.
The Opportunity
This is not a relationship maintenance role — it's a strategy and building role. You'll own the two channels providing the most leverage for Dash0's next phase of growth: hyperscaler marketplaces (AWS, GCP, Azure) and the cloud-native consultancy ecosystem that influences every enterprise buying decision.
Your mission is to build the motion from near-scratch: partner program design, commercial frameworks, co-sell enablement, and field activation. You'll simultaneously work live deals through hyperscaler channels where the opportunity is immediate. Based in Amsterdam or London (remote).
What You'll Do
- Own the relationships with AWS, GCP, and Azure — drive Dash0 onto marketplace listings, activate co-sell motions, and turn field relationships with Cloud Solution Architects into a repeatable source of qualified pipeline.
- Design and execute a partner model for cloud-native SIs and consultancies — the firms that spec observability stacks for enterprise clients. Define the incentive structure and co-delivery model.
- Drive revenue through partners — you'll be measured by ARR contribution: net-new logos sourced through partners and accelerated deals via SI influence.
- Feed partner and SI intelligence back into product, pricing, and positioning. Proactively address competitive movements.
- Build and document relationships with hyperscaler solution architects in target geographies (US East Coast, UK/Netherlands/DACH) to generate qualified introductions.
What You Bring
- 5+ years in partnerships, alliances, or business development at a developer tools, observability, or cloud-native infrastructure company.
- Established relationships with field teams at one or more of the major hyperscalers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
- Demonstrated experience building or scaling a hyperscaler co-sell motion — from listing to active deal flow.
- Experience designing partner programs for SIs or consultancies (tiers, incentives, enablement) at a technical product company.
- A track record of partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue.
- A builder mentality — you're energized by the ambiguity of standing up something new and prefer creating the playbook to following one.
Nice to Have
- Background in observability, APM, or DevSecOps.
- Experience with the OpenTelemetry or Prometheus ecosystems.
- Existing CNCF community relationships.
- International experience spanning US and Europe.
Why Dash0
This is a unique opportunity to help build a generational company. Dash0 is backed by top-tier investors including Balderton Capital, Accel, and Cherry Ventures, and led by a founding team with decades of experience in observability. We're in the middle of a massive growth phase after our Series B, and we're just getting started.
If you're looking for a place where a great product meets great people, where momentum is real, and your impact is visible from day one — this is it.
What we offer:
- Competitive salary & meaningful equity participation; you'll own part of what you're building
- Flexible, remote-first work environment with offices in New York, Amsterdam, and Munich
- €60/month Lifestyle allowance
- Location-specific benefits
- Collaborative, fast-moving team culture with a builder mindset
- Clear path for career growth and development
- Direct access to founders and leadership

Hi! This is the Flipper team.
We are the creators of Flipper Zero https://flipper.net — a portable device for tech enthusiasts and engineers. It's a gadget with an awesome community that brings together millions of people around the world.
We're building a new product — Flipper One https://blog.flipper.net/flipper-one-we-need-your-help/. It's a full-featured ARM-based computer running Linux in a compact form factor, powered by the Rockchip RK3576 SoC.
We're looking for a Linux Test Engineer to ensure the quality of Flipper One https://blog.flipper.net/flipper-one-we-need-your-help/ by combining automated and hands-on hardware testing. You'll work closely with the firmware team to build reliable test automation while validating the product on real devices in our London office.
Responsibilities:
- Validate firmware and software functionality on real hardware, identifying defects and ensuring reliable product behavior
- Investigate Linux system behavior, collect logs, analyze failures, and help engineers reproduce and resolve issues
- Design, develop, and maintain test suites for Flipper One using Python-based testing frameworks
Requirements:
- Deep practical experience with Linux: shell, systemd/services, logs, permissions, networking, processes, cron, SSH, package managers
- Ability to write Bash scripts and use standard Linux tools: grep, awk, sed, curl, journalctl, netstat/ss, top/htop, ps, lsof, tcpdump or similar
- Understanding of networking stack at TCP/IP level: Ethernet, IP, TCP/UDP, routing, sockets, ports, DNS, DHCP, ARP, MTU, packet loss, retransmissions, latency, timeouts, and connection states
- Ability to work from our London office, especially during the initial stage of the project
Nice-to-haves:
- Experience with IoT, embedded, networking, telecom, infrastructure, cloud, or device-related systems
- Experience with tools such as ModemManager, NetworkManager, mmcli, nmcli, QMI/MBIM, or AT commands
What we offer:
- Workplace in our own stand-alone office located in Design District, London, near North Greenwich Station (Jubilee line).
- You will be provided with all the necessary equipment for a comfortable working environment.
- Benefits such as VHI, corporate sports, foreign language courses, and therapy sessions.
- A five-day workweek with a flexible start of the working day.

Senior Software Engineer
Scope https://www.getscope.ai/ automates the data collection that’s slowing down the physical world.
Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.
Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.
We’re building the best AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we’re building the world’s largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.
It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started, with ambitions. We have grown revenue 5x in the last year and on track to reach 10M ARR in 2026. We work with 6 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.
We’ve assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Goldman Sachs, Flexport and Amazon.
Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures https://www.indexventures.com/, the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date.
About the role:
You’ll join a talented, flat structured engineering team where we are looking for forward deployed or product focused engineers where you will be at the front line of our key accounts. You will be running the rollout, building tools tailored for the client and own problems end to end.
You will not be siloed so will work across the product, business, clients and won’t be handed tickets and asked to stay in your lane. You’ll talk to users, decide what matters, design the solution, ship it, and see whether it worked.
We work in person five days a week from our sunny office in Farringdon. We believe being together helps us move faster and solve problems more effectively and it's also more fun!
We’re looking for people who want to help invent what inspection software should look like in a post AI world.
What you’ll do:
- Build the systems that takes voice notes, photos, videos and proactively finishes reports
- Engineer how we feed context to AI models: how to store, fetch and select standards, reports, media, user intention
- Evolve our workflow builder into self evolving software
- Design the architecture behind the product: how unstructured data flows through the system, how AI is integrated, how offline and online behaviour stay seamless, and how we keep the product simple as it becomes more powerful.
Who you are:
- We believe great teams are made up of highly agentic managers of one. People who care more about shipping results than collecting badges.
- You should apply if you’re deeply technical and enjoy building applications
- You have strong technical skills, ideally mobile applications or client focused.
- You have 5+ years of experience and have built up enough scar tissue to know which technical decisions matter.
- Expo / React Native experience a big plus
Interview process:
* An initial call.
* A collaborative technical exercise with an engineer.
* An Interview with a cofounder - Jonny (CEO) or Jakob (CTO).
* Onsite Systems Design and Product Interview - Meeting more people on the team and getting a feel of what it would be like to work here.
* Offer!
What we offer:
Our benefits are designed to reflect our values. We offer comprehensive employee benefits, which includes the following:
- £120k - £150k base + significant equity so you have a stake in what you are building
- We provide full visa sponsorship that has allowed us to have unrestricted access to global talent and build an international, diverse team
- Tools to do your job including brand new MacBook laptop + Scope merch
- Generous above-market annual leave allowance
- Bupa private medical (0 excess, pre-existing conditions covered) + Bupa dental
- Employee Pension through NEST
- Flexible Parental Leave (including Adoption Leave)
- Healthy meal prep delivered Lunch + Dinners as well as fully stocked fridge and snacks, drinks
- Team lunches on Fridays
- Regular events including off-sites
- Learning and Development: Access to online resources and courses as well as internal Lunch and Learn seminars that allow collaboration and continuous development
At Scope, we believe diverse perspectives build stronger products and teams. Even if your background doesn't perfectly align with every single bullet point here, if you have the drive and the commercial instincts to excel in this role and be a part of a transformational start up, we strongly encourage you to apply.

Background working at an early-stage startup where you built things from scratch.
