About the AI Security Institute

The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.

We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.

Team Description   

Risks from misaligned AI systems are growing increasingly important as AI systems become more capable, autonomous, and integrated into society. Understanding these risks and stress-testing mitigations is crucial to ensuring advanced AI systems are developed and deployed safely and beneficially in the future. 
 
The Alignment Red Team is a specialised subteam within AISI's wider Red Team focused on detecting and evaluating misalignment in frontier AI systems. We perform novel research to develop techniques for finding misalignment, and pre- and post-deployment evaluations of frontier AI systems to understand loss-of-control risks associated with models, such as deceptive alignment, research sabotage, and reward-seeking. We share our findings with frontier AI companies and the UK and allied governments, to inform their respective deployments, research, and policy-making. We also work directly with safety teams at frontier labs, sharing our evaluation findings to help improve their model alignment training and monitoring methodology. 

We have conducted pre-deployment testing with multiple frontier AI companies for propensities related to research sabotage, cheating and unsanctioned cyber-attacks. We previously found that Claude models would sometimes refuse to help with benign AI safety research, an issue which Anthropic then evaluated for and fixed in their next model release. 

About the Role 

We're seeking Research Engineers and Research Scientists to join our Alignment Red Team. We are open to hires at junior, senior, staff and principal research scientist/engineer levels. 

What You'll Be Doing 

  • Researching methods to automatically search for misalignment in frontier models, including misalignment related to loss-of-control risks such as research sabotage and reward-seeking. 
  • Building and running alignment evaluations relevant for loss-of-control risks that current benchmarks don’t capture.

The ability to effectively evaluate and monitor AI systems will grow in importance as models become more capable, autonomous, and integrated into society. If models can detect and game evaluations, obscure their reasoning, or behave differently under observation, the safety claims that governments and developers rely on become unreliable.Understanding and addressing these risks is essential to ensuring that oversight of advanced AI systems keeps pace with their capabilities.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to own the integration of Mithra OS onto customer vehicles.  Mithra is our ARX Software Stack that transforms legacy fleets with AI-driven autonomy and standardized software, ensuring seamless integration and unmatched adaptability for complex missions. You will initially act as the technical owner and primary integration engineer, personally carrying out feasibility studies, system integration, testing, troubleshooting, and field deployment. As the function grows, you will build and lead a team while remaining closely involved in the most challenging technical work.

This is not a coordination-only or purely people-management role. In the early phase, you will be expected to do the integration work directly, make technical decisions, investigate problems at system level, and deliver working vehicle integrations with limited support. Over time, you will scale your impact by building a strong team, establishing repeatable processes, and creating reusable technical foundations for future customer platforms.

What You'll Own and Deliver

  • Personally lead and execute vehicle integrations of Mithra OS onto customer platforms, taking hands-on responsibility for the technical work across mechanical, electrical, and software interfaces.
  • Own the integration from initial assessment through field deployment, including vehicle and system analysis, interface definition, architecture, configuration, implementation, troubleshooting, verification, and acceptance.
  • Conduct and document technical feasibility studies, gathering the necessary evidence, identifying technical risks and dependencies, and making clear, data-driven recommendations on whether and how an integration should proceed.
  • Design, implement, and debug vehicle integration solutions across hardware and software domains. This includes working directly with vehicle systems, onboard computers, sensors, actuators, networks, power systems, and relevant mechanical interfaces.
  • Develop and execute rigorous integration and test plans, progressing from bench testing and hardware-in-the-loop activities through vehicle-level testing and live field trials. You will personally participate in testing, fault investigation, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Build reusable engineering capabilities, including integration tools, software libraries, test utilities, configuration assets, interface specifications, and technical documentation that make future vehicle integrations faster, safer, and more reliable.
  • Establish practical integration processes and engineering standards covering requirements, interface control, configuration management, verification evidence, change control, issue resolution, and technical decision-making.
  • Ensure that every integration is safe, robust, serviceable, and mission-ready, identifying and addressing weaknesses before deployment and maintaining a high standard of engineering quality throughout the lifecycle.
  • Work directly with vehicle OEMs, suppliers, and specialist contractors to clarify interfaces, resolve technical issues, review proposed solutions, and ensure that external contributions meet the required technical and safety standards.
  • Build and grow the vehicle integration team over time. Initially, you will operate as the primary hands-on integration engineer and technical owner. As the team expands, you will recruit, mentor, and develop engineers, while continuing to remain technically engaged in the most complex integration challenges.
  • Translate field and customer requirements into executable engineering work, balancing technical performance, safety, schedule, maintainability, cost, and integration risk.
 

What You Bring

  • A proven track record of leading, managing, and mentoring engineering teams in a robotics, automotive, or complex systems environment.
  • Significant technical experience in vehicle systems integration, with a deep understanding of the challenges across software, electrical, and mechanical domains.
  • Significant experience in drive by wire, vehicle motion control and interfaces, autonomy, platform and electrical architecture alongside network and connectivity.
  • Experience hiring, developing, and retaining engineering talent, with a passion for building high-performing, collaborative teams.
  • Exceptional engineering judgment and the ability to make critical decisions on technical strategy, architecture, and risk management.
  • The ability to inspire and guide a cross-disciplinary team, fostering a clear sense of purpose and a high standard of execution.
  • Strong strategic and communication skills, with experience managing relationships with external partners like OEMs and suppliers.
  • A deep, hands-on technical background that provides you with the credibility to guide senior engineers through their toughest challenges.

Please note: You do not need to meet every single requirement to apply. We welcome motivated candidates who are eager to grow into the role and develop their expertise further.

 

What We Offer

Join a mission-driven European defense tech company at a pivotal stage of growth, where you can help shape meaningful technology, take ownership early, and grow with the business!

  • Competitive compensation package including a bonus opportunity
  • 27 days of annual leave to start, increasing with tenure up to 30 days

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at ARX Robotics, you are the crucial link between our advanced Mithra OS and our customers' real-world operational challenges. Mithra is our ARX Software Stack that transforms legacy fleets with AI-driven autonomy and standardized software, ensuring seamless integration and unmatched adaptability for complex missions. You will step directly into complex environments, translate unique user needs into robust technical solutions, and ensure our autonomous systems deliver decisive value in the field.

This is a hands-on role for a systems thinker who thrives on integrating cutting-edge software into mission-critical applications. You will act as the technical expert on the ground, the trusted partner to our customers, and their voice within our engineering teams, directly shaping the future of autonomous ground systems.

What You’ll Build

  • Directly shape customer success by integrating our Mithra OS into their unique operational systems.
  • Develop and deploy custom software extensions, adapters, and data flows using our modern APIs and SDKs.
  • Bridge the gap between high-level customer ambitions and our core technology, translating complex requirements into reliable, field-ready integrations.

Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

We are looking for a Head of Data Platform to lead Alpaca’s growing Platform Engineering team. You will own the data strategy, the team’s execution, and the department’s roadmap.

The Data department serves every function at Alpaca: it powers partner invoicing and revenue attribution, provides the analytical foundation for sales, product, and compliance, and operates the data platform that processes hundreds of millions of events daily. You will manage three team leads, balancing operational delivery (invoicing, embedded analytics, regulatory reporting) with strategic bets (self-service warehouse, AI-powered analytics, enterprise search).

This is a player-coach role. You will set direction for the team while staying close enough to the technical details to make architecture decisions, unblock your leads, and represent data’s capabilities to the executive team.

 

Things You Get To Do:

  • Lead and develop Platform Engineering & ETL
  • Manage leads, set priorities, and ensure delivery.
  • Own the Data Lakehouse architecture: Trino, Iceberg/GCS, Airflow, Airbyte, Redpanda CDC, dbt.
  • Make build-vs-buy decisions on tooling.
  • Drive partner invoicing accuracy and evolution: ensure invoicing logic is versioned, reproducible, and scales with new pricing mechanisms and product launches.
  • Deliver embedded analytics: expose warehouse data to partners via BrokerDash, SSR pipelines, and API-based reporting. Own row-level security and entitlements.
  • Support product launches with data change management: coordinate data impact analysis for new products (fixed income, global stocks, perps, 24/5 trading) across downstream datasets, dashboards, and reverse ETL.
  • Accelerate self-service: move the organization toward self-serve analytics via semantic layers, data catalogues, and conversational BI so the data team can shift from ad-hoc queries to strategic projects.

Your Role: 

As a Product Manager - Accounts, you will be responsible for the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Alpaca's core account management and identity verification systems. You will be the voice of our partners, working to create a flexible and compliant global account infrastructure. This role is critical to enabling financial institutions around the world to seamlessly and securely onboard and manage their end-users. You will work closely with engineering, legal, compliance, and business development teams to navigate the complexities of different jurisdictions and deliver a world-class account experience.

Things You Get To Do:

  • Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Alpaca's account opening and identity verification services
  • Manage the lifecycle of various account structures, including fully disclosed, omnibus, and omnibus with sub-accounting, to meet the diverse needs of our global B2B clients.
  • Develop and enhance features such as the ability to open accounts for entities, create sub-accounts for distinct trading strategies, and manage multiple account types (e.g., self-directed, robo, retirement)

  • Collaborate with legal, compliance, and regional business teams to navigate the complexities of different jurisdictions, ensuring our account systems meet local licensing, data management, and financial requirements
  • Author detailed product requirement documents (PRDs) and user stories to ensure clarity and alignment across all teams
  • Work with go-to-market teams to enable adoption of new account features and onboarding flows
  • Define and analyze key metrics such as onboarding success rates, account funding times, and KYC pass-through rates to measure success and identify areas for improvement

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

  • At least 5 years of product management experience, with a focus on B2B, fintech, or complex platform products
  • Experience with products related to user onboarding, identity verification (KYC/AML), or account management systems
  • A strong understanding of the operational and regulatory complexities in financial services, especially concerning client onboarding and account lifecycle management
  • Proven ability to understand complex technical and business requirements and work effectively with engineering, legal, and compliance teams
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven track record of leading cross-functional teams and influencing stakeholders
  • Data-driven mindset with experience using analytics tools to track product performance and make informed decisions
  • A genuine passion for financial markets and a strong desire to build products that empower developers and democratize access to financial services

  • Direct experience working in the fintech or brokerage industry
  • Experience working in a globally distributed, remote-first company
  • Familiarity with different brokerage account structures (e.g., omnibus, fully disclosed)

jobs.ashbyhq.com/pennylane/0c36dac8-2482.description_excerpt:
MÖCHTEST DU DAS LEBEN VON MILLIONEN UNTERNEHMER IN EUROPA VERÄNDERN?
Du möchtest echten Impact haben und die Zukunft von Finanzen und Buchhaltung in Europa mitgestalten? Du fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohl, das auf Vertrauen, Eigenverantwortung und Geschwindigkeit setzt? Und unsere Design-Prinzipien entsprechen deiner Vorstellung von großartigen Nutzererlebnissen?
Dann könnte Pennylane genau der richtige Ort für dich sein – und du genau die richtige Person für diese Rolle.
UNSERE VISION
Wir bauen das beliebteste Financial Operating System für kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen in Europa.
Unser Ziel ist es, Unternehmer von zeitaufwendigen Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu entlasten und ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu den wichtigsten Finanzinformationen zu geben, damit sie bessere Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen treffen können.
Gleichzeitig unterstützen wir Steuerkanzleien dabei, weniger Zeit für repetitive Aufgaben aufzuwenden und sich stärker auf die Beratung und Betreuung ihrer Mandant zu konzentrieren.
Bereits heute nutzen mehr als 1.000.000 kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen sowie über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien Pennylane in Frankreich.
ÜBER UNS
Pennylane gehört zu den am schnellsten wachsenden FinTechs in Frankreich – und bald auch in Deutschland.
In nur fünf Jahren haben wir:
- uns als innovative Accounting- und Finanzplattform für Unternehmen und Steuerkanzleien etabliert,
- insgesamt 150 Millionen Euro Kapital eingesammelt – unter anderem von Sequoia, dem renommierten Silicon-Valley-Investor hinter Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe und PayPal,
- unser Team von 7 Gründer auf über 1.100 Pennylaners ausgebaut,
- eine internationale Unternehmenskultur mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten geschaffen,
- eine starke Remote-First-Kultur etabliert, in der bereits rund 30 % unserer Mitarbeitenden von überall in Europa arbeiten,
- das Vertrauen tausender Kund und Steuerkanzleien gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.
Heute gelten wir mit einer Glassdoor-Bewertung von 4,6/5 als einer der attraktivsten Arbeitgeber Europas.
PENNYLANE DEUTSCHLAND
Innerhalb von nur 1,5 Jahren ist unser Deutschland-Team von einer einzelnen Squad auf über 40 Mitarbeitende in den Bereichen Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success und Marketing gewachsen.
Unser Ziel ist es, Pennylane als festen Bestandteil des deutschen Marktes zu etablieren. Gemeinsam mit innovativen Steuerberater und Unternehmen entwickeln wir unser Produkt für die Anforderungen des deutschen Marktes weiter und verändern nachhaltig die Art und Weise, wie Buchhaltung und Finanzen in Deutschland funktionieren.
Als eigenständiger Markt profitieren wir von der Unterstützung unserer französischen Teams und genießen gleichzeitig große Freiheiten bei der Gestaltung unserer Ziele, Strukturen, Prozesse und Produkte.
DESIGN BEI PENNYLANE
Design steht im Zentrum unserer Mission. Unser Anspruch ist es, Nutzer ein nahtloses, zugängliches und begeisterndes Produkterlebnis zu bieten.
Unser Design-Team besteht aus über 40 Product Designer, die in interdisziplinären Squads eng mit Product und Engineering zusammenarbeiten.
Autonomie, Vertrauen und Transparenz bilden das Fundament unserer Unternehmenskultur und prägen den Arbeitsalltag unserer Designer.
Bei Pennylane beschränkt sich Design nicht auf die Gestaltung von Interfaces. Designer begleiten den gesamten Prozess – von der Definition des Problems über Research und Testing bis hin zur Umsetzung der Lösung.
DEINE ROLLE
Wir suchen eine Product Designer mit fundierter Erfahrung im B2B-Produktdesign, um die Weiterentwicklung unseres Produkts in Deutschland aktiv mitzugestalten.
Wenn du gerne reale Nutzerprobleme löst, in einem kollaborativen Umfeld arbeitest und ein echtes Interesse daran hast, Nutzerverhalten und Geschäftsziele zu verstehen, wirst du bei Pennylane viele Gleichgesinnte finden.
DAS BRINGST DU MIT
- Du verstehst sowohl Nutzerbedürfnisse als auch Business-Anforderungen und kannst Erkenntnisse aus User Research, Marktanalysen und Daten in pragmatische Lösungen übersetzen.
- Du hast Erfahrung mit komplexen digitalen Produkten und Systemen, beispielsweise mit mehreren Modulen, umfangreichen Funktionen oder komplexen Datenstrukturen.
- Du arbeitest eng mit Entwickler, Product Manager und weiteren Stakeholdern wie Sales oder Support zusammen und kannst technische Rahmenbedingungen sowie Business-Ziele in deine Arbeit integrieren.
- Du kommunizierst klar, hinterfragst bestehende Annahmen konstruktiv und kannst deine Lösungsansätze überzeugend vertreten.
- Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch. User Interviews werden regelmäßig auf Deutsch durchgeführt.
WAS DICH BEI PENNYLANE ERWARTET
INNERHALB DES ERSTEN MONATS
- Du lernst unser Unternehmen, unsere Teams und unsere Vision während des Onboardings kennen.
- Du erhältst einen tiefen Einblick in unser Produkt sowie die Welt der Buchhaltung und Finanzen.
- Du machst dich mit unserer Product- und Design-Organisation, unseren Methoden und unserer Kultur vertraut.
- Du lernst die Menschen kennen, mit denen du täglich zusammenarbeiten wirst – sowohl innerhalb des Deutschland-Teams als auch im internationalen Umfeld.
INNERHALB DER ERSTEN DREI MONATE
- Du führst Discovery-Workshops und User Research durch und analysierst Daten, Nutzerfeedback und Business-Anforderungen.
- Gemeinsam mit deinem Product Manager verantwortest du die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung deines Produktbereichs.
- Du entwickelst Lösungen in der passenden Detailtiefe – von ersten Konzepten bis hin zu High-Fidelity-Prototypen.
- Du bringst deine Erfahrung aktiv ins Team ein, gibst Feedback an Kolleg und arbeitest an bereichsübergreifenden Themen mit.
INNERHALB DER ERSTEN SECHS MONATE
- Du unterstützt aktiv beim Ausbau unseres Teams und wirkst im Recruiting-Prozess mit.
- Du beobachtest aktuelle UX- und UI-Trends und bringst Best Practices aus der internationalen Tech-Welt ein.
UND DARÜBER HINAUS
Sowohl unser Design-Team als auch unsere Aktivitäten in Deutschland werden weiter wachsen.
Das bedeutet für dich:
- Möglichkeiten, neue Designer einzustellen, zu coachen und perspektivisch zu führen.
- Mehr Verantwortung für strategische Projekte.
- Die Chance, Prozesse, Tools und Best Practices aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln.
DAS BIETEN WIR DIR
- Arbeite aus unserem Büro im Herzen Berlins, aus unserem Standort in Hamburg, aus unseren Büros in Paris oder aus jedem WeWork-Standort in Europa.
- Bei einem Full-Remote-Vertrag erhältst du ein Budget für dein Home Office sowie einen monatlichen Zuschuss für Coworking-Spaces.
- Zusätzlich zu 25 Urlaubstagen erhältst du jährlich zwischen 8 und 13 weitere freie Tage.
- Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch zu verbessern oder eine neue Sprache zu lernen.
- Modernste Apple-Hardware für deinen Arbeitsalltag.

VP/Director, FP&A 

Exclaimer is a ~100m ARR software business owned by Insight Partners. With our high velocity / low ACV, our business combines standard SaaS characteristics with a D2C dynamic. We are on path of becoming a rule of 60 company and will work closely with Insight Partners over the next years to facilitate a highly successful exit.  

Due to the D2C like characteristics of the business, FP&A will play a key role on the path to our exit and become a key supporter of our GTM and general strategic expansion as well as any M&A plans.  

Reports to: CFO  

Role Mission & Strategic Context 

We are seeking an analytically elite, commercially astute, and hands-on Director of FP&A to build and lead our next-generation financial planning, forecasting, and strategic data intelligence framework. 

Unlike traditional enterprise software companies with long, predictable, single-stream sales cycles, Exclaimer’s engine is defined by: 

  • High Sales Velocity: Hundreds of monthly transactions, automated conversion funnels, and rapid-cycle deals.

Multi-Motion GTM Financial Architecture & Capacity Planning 

  • Driver-Based Modeling: Architect dynamic financial models reflecting the distinct economics, conversion velocities, and churn profiles of each GTM motion: 
  • PLG / Self-Serve: Micro-transactions, digital acquisition channels, trial-to-paid velocity, automated credit card billing, and instantaneous cohort churn.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/fosphamarketing.description_excerpt:
Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on.

Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, and Lululemon use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform — and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.

 

The Role

As an Associate Account Manager you will play a critical role in ensuring Fospha’s customers see measurable value and business impact from our marketing measurement platform. Working within our Customer team, you’ll directly own relationships across a portfolio of mid-size customers, driving retention, adoption, and commercial readiness while helping shape the next generation of customer success at Fospha.

You will:

  • Drive renewals across your portfolio by understanding client objectives, monitoring account health, and ensuring value is demonstrated ahead of each renewal cycle.
  • Collaborate closely with the Head of Customer Accounts on your higher impact accounts, building the commercial skillset to secure long term and successful partnerships with Fospha customers
  • Turn data into impact stories. Helping different customer personas see how Fospha drives efficiency, growth, and smarter marketing decisions, through clear ROI and performance storytelling tailored to what they care about, from the CFO to the Marketing team to in house Data teams.
  • Identify signals of growth or risk early, working with the day to day customer teams to flag adoption challenges or expansion opportunities, and contribute to the proactive building of a tailored learning agenda with each of our customers.
  • Contribute to proactive strategic account plans, helping shape the roadmap for your accounts, ensuring every action ties back to measurable outcomes and maps out your stakeholder and activation plan across the account to get ahead of renewal conversations
  • Represent the voice of the customer internally, surfacing product feedback, feature requests, and insight that helps Fospha continuously improve our platform and delivery.

 

What are we looking for?

  • 2–3 years of experience in Sales, Account Management, or client-facing SaaS roles, ideally within D2C marketing, analytics, or eCommerce.
  • Strong relationship builder who enjoys helping customers achieve tangible results.
  • Comfortable with data, you can interpret dashboards, spot trends, and articulate the “so what” for the customer.
  • Confident communicator across email, video, and live meetings; able to build trust quickly with multiple stakeholders.
  • Organized and proactive. You take ownership of follow-ups, get creative with planning, and ensuring nothing slips through the cracks.
  • Eager to drive the commercial side of SaaS, renewals, upsells, and business case storytelling.
  • Naturally curious and analytical, with a genuine interest in marketing performance and measurement.
  • (Bonus) Experience with eCommerce data, attribution, marketing platforms, marketing measurement or D2C ad platforms is a plus.

 

What we can offer you

  • A workplace pension, through Royal London, with Fospha matching your contributions up to 3%
  • A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up - whatever suits you!
  • Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps
  • 25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday! and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)
  • Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary, from day one
  • Cycle to Work scheme, plus discounts on everyday spending through our benefits portal — Apple, Tesco, IKEA, M&S, Deliveroo, cinema tickets and more
  • Quarterly one-to-one sessions with a financial adviser, plus access to payroll-deducted loans through Salary Finance
  • Paid volunteering days each year
  • Regular socials, free weekly snacks, and Lunch & Learn events at our Scale Space office, plus access to the wider Blenheim Chalcot community
  • Opportunities to travel — including to our India and North America offices

 

Our Values & Principles

You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:

  • Seek inclusion & diversity: We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard
  • Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together: We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact
  • Grow: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure
  • Customer at the heart: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems
  • Candour with caring: We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude

Above all, our people show a willingness to work together and get their hands dirty to deliver product success, which means our customers are successful!

The Customer Intelligence team are responsible for ensuring our customers take action on Fospha data: turning data into clear recommendations, guiding marketers through budgeting decisions and helping client teams become experts in the Fospha platform.

This is the entry point into the function, and it is a hands-on one. You'll work across live customer accounts from the point that they go live with Fospha, becoming the trusted expert in the domain, our customers and the decisions they are making across their marketing mix. It's a role for someone who wants to learn how to turn data into customer action, in a business where these actions are meaningful and exciting.

  • Level: Graduate - Entry Level
  • Location: London, White City

  • You'll be responsible for the customer outcomes your team owns — driving action on insight, trust in the model, and confidence in data quality — contributing to customer retention alongside the Account Manager
  • You'll build deep expertise in your specialism and use it to solve real customer problems, turning data into clear recommendations, building trust in our methodology, and keeping data accurate and flowing
  • You'll be confident and effective in customer-facing moments relevant to your team, building credibility with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • You'll be collaborative, working closely with Account Managers and other specialist teams, feeding customer insight back to Product, and keeping everyone aligned with regular progress updates

In addition to your core responsibilities, we expect you to be excited by the opportunity Gen AI brings and find new ways of working utilising our Gen AI hub to increase our efficiency

 

The Centre of Excellence

  • The Centre of Excellence is Fospha's early-careers programme that develops ambitious, high-performing talent through focused training, hands-on experience and cross-functional exposure. Starting in Customer Intelligence, you'll gain foundational experience while being prepared for future opportunities across the organisation. The programme operates on the following principles:
  • Individual Responsibility from the Get-go: You will quickly be responsible for the success of your work, able to make an individual impact early in your career
  • Work alongside SLT at Leading Businesses: You will be engaging with Senior Leadership and C-Level executives at the leading retail brands, getting exposure to how the top companies operate
  • Become a Customer Facing Expert: You will be working directly with customers, often meeting them in person and developing your ability to create strong interpersonal relationships
  • Cross-Functional Exposure: we offer unique opportunities to learn from and collaborate with every department in the business — many daily
  • Comprehensive Training: In addition to the extensive on-the-job learning opportunities, you'll receive a broad and blended in-person training curriculum covering essential topics such as Business Storytelling, Account Management, Market Research & Product and Financial Management
  • Real Mentorship: Regular one-to-ones, feedback, and career conversations with people invested in your progression, not just your output
  • Career Development: High performers have clear opportunities to quickly advance their careers at Fospha — whether progressing within our Customer Teams toward strategic and/or management roles or moving into other departments that align with your skills and interests
  • Modern Tools: Hands-on exposure to Gen AI tooling through our Gen AI hub, so you're building modern, AI-fluent ways of working rather than legacy processes

Morgan, Wells Fargo and IQT, the not-for-profit strategic investor that accelerates the introduction of groundbreaking technologies to enhance the national security of America and its allies.

About the Role

HERE is recruiting for an experienced, high octane, tenacious Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our steadily growing sales team! In this role, you will be responsible for driving our lead generation efforts across enterprise organisations. The person in this seat will be focused on actively researching and developing new business opportunities and establishing a positive rapport with our clients. Our ideal candidate will be driven, organized, personable and creative, with an innate ability to think outside the box. The ability to leverage AI tooling to drive your own productivity and results is a must. Being comfortable with cold call outreach will be crucial to success in this role and is something that you should feel comfortable doing on a daily basis. Experience working with Financial Services or Technology is preferred.

In the first 90 days, you can expect to:

  • Spend extensive time with all areas of the business to master your knowledge of HERE’s technology value proposition, client base and target ICP
  • Get a good understanding of how to use our sales resources, including Amplemarket, Salesforce, Gong, Sales Navigator & Google AI tools
  • Build out your value proposition cheat sheet for each ideal ICP
  • Extensively review HERE product material as well as proven successful outreach methods and content to build product knowledge
  • Begin booking both inbound & outbound meetings for our Sales Directors in New York, London & Hong Kong (and start earning commission!)

  • Working your own pipeline and showing your ability to book  meetings with senior decision making personas within your key target accounts 
  • Perfecting your sales acumen and etiquette
  • Continuing to build on your understanding of your target market & target ICP 
  • Establish and build relationships with your prospects 
  • Demonstrate your ability to effectively communicate various HERE value propositions to the appropriate personas 

By your 1 year anniversary, you will have accomplished: 

  • Hitting your monthly targets consistently 
  • An in-depth understanding of HERE’s product & positioning, demonstrated on the phone to clients 
  • Becoming a meaningful contributor to the overall success of the sales team, culture and wider business
  • Mastery of your outreach cadence
  • Efficiently managing your own successful pipeline

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum 3 years sales development experience within financial services or enterprise SaaS environment and proven track record of successful lead conversion
  • A competitive, results-driven individual contributor who enjoys being part of a collaborative team 
  • Experience working in an SDR role for a SaaS, AI or Technology company with Enterprise products required
  • A history working with leads across industries with a strong preference of Financial Services experience
  • A resilient personality with the ability to be self driven and remain adaptable to changes in the market while remaining goal oriented
  • Experience driving lead generation through frequent, direct cold-calling efforts.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both oral and written, coupled with the ability to confidently collaborate with senior and executive level individuals (internal and external facing)
  • Excellent organisational skills, with a diligent work ethic, with a very strong attention to detail in all areas of work
  • Must have macro mindset and be adaptable to change for success in this role

What We’re Offering

  • Thoughtfully- Planned Paid Parental Leave
  • Financial Well-Being Plans (Pension) (Life Insurance)

  • Professional Development Courses
  • Employee Resource Groups

Additional Perks -

  • Vitality Plus Benefits & Discounts
  • In-Office Coffee, Tea, Snacks, and Beer on Tap
  • Casual dress code
  • Team Lunches

At HERE, we pride ourselves on fostering a friendly, collaborative, and supportive culture that truly respects the diversity of thought. From virtual socials and in-person events, to informal meetings and employee resource groups, we make it easy to engage and connect. Our environment promotes a productive, enjoyable learning experience - aligned together, working to create compelling solutions for our clients. Everything works right HERE.

About Energy Exemplar

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation. 

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

  • SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.
  • Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.
  • IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners
  • Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category
  • Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change
  • Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.

How We Work

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

About the Role

As a member of the EMEA Customer Success team, the Customer Success Manager will be responsible for managing and growing customer engagements across the region. This role will focus on building and maintaining long-term strategic partnerships with utilities, regulators, government bodies, and energy companies, ensuring Energy Exemplar’s solutions deliver measurable value.

The successful candidate will oversee a high-value customer portfolio with a clear mandate to drive customer retention, revenue growth, and advocacy. You will act as the trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, proactively identifying opportunities for expansion through upsell and cross-sell initiatives, while ensuring adoption and satisfaction remain at best-in-class levels.

This role also requires strong external engagement, representing Energy Exemplar as a thought leader at industry events, government forums, and conferences across EMEA. To succeed, you will combine a strong commercial mindset with deep knowledge of the regional energy landscape and an ability to translate complex customer challenges into actionable solutions.

Primary Responsibilities

Strategic Account Ownership

At HR Wallingford, we design smart, resilient solutions across the natural and built environments to help everyone live and work more sustainably with water. By harnessing research, data insights and the power of our collective expertise, we help the world to better understand the changing influence and impact of water.

We have an exciting opening for drainage modeller to help us deliver on our expanding portfolio of UK and international research and consultancy projects.

Current projects within the Catchments and Drainage team include:

  • Modelling the impacts of retrofitting Sustainable Drainage Systems (SuDS) in cities in Europe and the Caribbean as part of climate resilient planning strategies;
  • Evaluating impacts of Combined Sewer Overflow (CSO) spills and urban runoff discharges;
  • Governance of water company modelling and asset delivery strategies;
  • Modelling and master planning drainage asset portfolios;
  • Developing climate-adjusted rainfall time series and risk-based approaches to drainage design for flood and spill risk mitigation;
  • Creating tools for the planning, evaluation and design of SuDS;
  • Creating digital AI modelling solutions and applications;
  • Developing industry good practice guidance.

 

The team sits within the wider Flood and Water Management Group. Across this Group, we have a wide variety of experts including in water resources, flood risk systems analyses, flood forecasting, international climate adaptation and resilience, statistical modelling, data visualisation and management, and the use of earth observation data.  Our work cuts across regulatory, government and private sector consultancy and research sectors – both in the UK and internationally, and we are continuously generating new knowledge, skills and tools through our ongoing programme of internally-funded research. Within your role, you would be interacting and developing solutions with staff in all of these fields, in order to win and deliver projects and support clients across the Group. 

The Group are recognised for our innovation.  We won the ‘Digital Excellence’ category at the Environment Agency’s Flood and Coast Excellence Awards 2024 with our Resilience and Innovation Northants (RAIN) platform for Northamptonshire Council (Home Page - RAIN). Our Intelligent Dam Safety Monitoring (DAMSAT) project won two awards at the New Civil Engineer Techfest Awards and  our Dengue forecasting MOdel Satellite-based System (D-MOSS) has won 9 different industry awards. We have recently been successful in securing Ofwat Innovation Funding for a national SuDS platform (with Southern Water) and for developing a Rainwater Management Platform (with Wessex Water).  We were also one of the ten finalists for the Manchester Prize for which we were funded to develop an AI sewer spill water quality impact tool.

About the role

We are looking for an enthusiastic and highly motivated individual with existing demonstrable drainage modelling expertise and skills in data analysis who can help us with the development of new ideas and solutions, alongside providing robust established support to our clients.

About you

You will be a recent graduate, or soon to graduate, with an interest in surface water and/or wastewater drainage modelling. Knowledge of InfoWorks ICM, GIS, coding, hydraulic modelling or data analysis gained through your degree, university projects, placements or internships would be advantageous. You will be interested in solving complex, data-intensive problems and have an understanding of the challenges and solutions associated with urban runoff. Importantly, you will be a collaborative team player with a willingness to learn and develop your technical skills.

You will have, or be expected to achieve, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline. You will also have studied mathematics to A level (or equivalent) and be comfortable working with numerical and analytical data.

As our portfolio expands, we’re excited to welcome Principal Designer - CDM who share our passion for collaboration, innovation, and creating a sustainable future.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and proactive SR188 Principal Designer Representative (PDR) to support the delivery of a diverse portfolio of National Grid projects across both Front-End Engineering Design (FEED) and construction stages.

Acting on behalf of the Principal Designer under National Grid’s SR188 framework, you will play a key role in ensuring compliance with CDM Regulations 2015, driving high standards of health, safety, and risk management throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the Principal Designer Representative (PD R) in accordance with National Grid’s SR188 requirements.
  • Support and advise clients, designers, and project teams on CDM compliance, including roles, duties, and documentation.
  • Coordinate and manage design risk management processes, ensuring hazards are identified, eliminated, or reduced through design.
  • Facilitate and lead design risk workshops, HAZID/HAZOP sessions, and design reviews.
  • Ensure production and maintenance of key CDM deliverables, including:
    • Design Risk Registers
    • Pre-Construction Information (PCI)
    • Health and Safety Files
  • Provide CDM and safety input, influencing safe-by-design principles early in the project lifecycle.
  • Support project teams through the design and construction phase, ensuring effective communication of residual risks to contractors.
  • Engage with stakeholders including National Grid, contractors, and multidisciplinary design teams.
  • Monitor and report on CDM compliance and performance, identifying areas for improvement.
  • Promote a strong health, safety, and wellbeing culture across all projects.

Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience in a Principal Designer or CDM Advisor role, ideally within the utilities or infrastructure sectors.
  • Strong working knowledge of CDM Regulations 2015 and their practical application.
  • Experience working on National Grid projects and familiarity with SR188 requirements is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrable experience across both FEED/design and construction phases.
  • Ability to lead design risk management activities and influence multidisciplinary teams.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Personal Attributes

  • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong leadership and facilitation skills.
  • High attention to detail with a commitment to safety excellence.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.

  • Exposure to a broad range of FEED and construction stage activities.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Professional development and career progression opportunities.

About Invisible

Invisible Technologies makes AI work. Our end-to-end AI platform structures messy data, automates digital workflows, deploys agentic solutions, measures outcomes, and integrates human expertise where it matters most.

Our platform cleans, labels, and structures company data so it is ready for AI. It adapts models to each business and adds human expertise when needed, the same approach we have used to improve models for more than 80% of the world’s top AI companies, including Microsoft, AWS, and Cohere.

Our successes span industries, from supply chain automation for Swiss Gear to AI-enabled naval simulations with SAIC, and validating NBA draft picks for the Charlotte Hornets.

Profitable for more than half a decade, Invisible reached $134M in revenue and ranked as the number two fastest growing AI company on the 2024 Inc. 5000. In September 2025, we raised $100M in growth capital to accelerate our mission of making AI actually work in the enterprise and to advance our platform technology.

About The Role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll own a domain of the Invisible platform — such as identity, compute, delivery, or agent infrastructure — and set the direction for how it works. You'll define the patterns that engineering teams across the company adopt, and be accountable for their reliability, security, and cost.

This is a role where judgement matters more than throughput. Deciding which problems are worth solving, recognising when the unremarkable solution is the correct one, and knowing when to decline a bespoke request from a client engagement are the day-to-day of the job.

We are looking for engineers with a first-principles understanding of platform practice, not just fluency in it. Code review, staged rollouts, change management, and least privilege were all designed around human engineers working at human speed. Those assumptions no longer hold cleanly. A meaningful part of this role is determining what still applies, what needs reworking, and what has to be built from scratch.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a platform domain end to end, including architecture, roadmap, reliability, security posture, and cost
  • Lead design and trade-off discussions across performance, scalability, cost, security, and reliability, and document the decisions
  • Build multi-tenant infrastructure that client engagements can self-serve onto without the Platform team becoming a delivery bottleneck
  • Advance our agent-native engineering model — safe execution environments, credential and secret handling, internal tooling and MCP servers, and evaluation of where agents genuinely improve outcomes
  • Set standards for how the engineering organisation works with coding agents, including review practice, context engineering, and what should and shouldn't be automated
  • Partner with client-facing engineering teams to understand their infrastructure requirements and translate them into reusable platform capability
  • Mentor engineers on the team, review their designs, and raise the technical bar without absorbing their work
  • Own on-call and post-incident review practice

What We Need

  • Kubernetes & Cloud: Proven experience designing and operating production Kubernetes at multi-team scale, on GCP, Azure, or AWS
  • Infrastructure as Code: Deep experience with Terraform, Helm, and GitOps delivery, including a clear view of how these degrade when implemented poorly
  • Platform Security: Strong grounding in identity and SSO, workload identity, secrets management, and network policy. You can reason about a threat model directly rather than through a compliance checklist
  • Programming: Strong Python. You build tooling, not only configuration
  • AI Coding Agents: Exceptional practical command of agentic coding tools, and a track record of making other engineers more effective with them. You've built the harnesses, guardrails, and internal tooling, and you have a considered view of where agents deliver value and where they quietly cost more than they save
  • Engineering Judgement: A first-principles grasp of why platform practices exist. You can identify which survive contact with agentic engineering, which need reworking, and which were only ever ceremony
  • Communication: Excellent written communication. You can take an ambiguous problem and produce a document that makes the decision clear to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike
  • A track record of shipping infrastructure that other engineers depend on, and the willingness to challenge an approach when the room has already agreed on it
  • We weight demonstrated capability over years of experience or formal qualifications

What’s In It For You

Invisible is committed to fair and competitive pay, ensuring that compensation reflects both market conditions and the value each team member brings. Our salary structure accounts for regional differences in cost of living while maintaining internal equity.

You can find more information about our geographic pay tiers here. During the interview process, your Invisible Talent Acquisition Partner will confirm which tier applies to your location. For candidates outside the U.S., compensation is adjusted to reflect local market conditions and cost of living.

*Bonuses and equity are included in all full-time offers. Final compensation is determined by a combination of factors, including location, job-related experience, skills, knowledge, internal pay equity, and overall market conditions. Because of this, every offer is unique. Additional details on total compensation and benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

What It's Like to Work at Invisible:

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are always seeking talented and motivated Enterprise Business Development Representatives to join our Client Sales team in London.

Please Note: By submitting your application to our talent pool, you are expressing interest in a future career with our company and will be considered for new positions as they become available.

This role is perfect for a highly motivated hunter who thrives on outbound prospecting, uncovering new business opportunities, and setting the stage for successful sales conversations. If you're passionate about sales and eager to grow into an Account Executive (AE) role, this is your opportunity to develop the foundational skills needed to excel in B2B sales. This role would be targeting the Irish market, you would be the first BDR to be focussed solely on this market.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Identify and engage complex Enterprise prospects based in Ireland from a defined Book of Business (BoB) via email, phone, LinkedIn, Video, etc.
  • Strategic outbound prospecting (listening to podcasts, reading the news, reviewing 10ks, etc).
  • Uncovering complex enterprise opportunities (multiple stakeholders, various buying committees).
  • Setting the stage for successful high-value sales conversations (building ROI, challenger mindset).
  • Close collaboration with AEs for smooth handoff of qualified leads.
  • Build strong relationships through consultative selling, nurturing long sales cycles, and establishing yourself as a thought leader.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
  • Develop industry expertise to act as a trusted consultant on HR, wellness, and people trends across different sectors and geographies.
  • Possess strong business acumen and the ability to effectively communicate with senior-level stakeholders.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • 1-3 years of professional experience (not necessarily in sales)
  • Previous experience within the Irish Market is a plus
  • Familiar with or certified in: Salesforce, Salesloft, Outreach, Gong, Sales Navigator, LinkedIn 
  • Tenacious and goal-driven, you bring a proactive mindset and a passion for driving success.
  • Adaptable: You enjoy learning and embrace change, and are eager to evolve in a dynamic work environment

    About Neptune North

    Neptune North is a high-performing technical consultancy. We build data, AI and software solutions for clients in defence, financial services and private capital, working on demanding problems in challenging environments.

    We were founded in 2024 as a joint venture between Oliver Wyman and Rokos Capital Management. We’re headquartered in the centre of Newcastle upon Tyne, with a growing international footprint, and we’re recruiting exceptional engineers across every level.

    The role

    We’re looking for Applied AI Engineers to put AI to work inside real defence applications and workflows. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will have impact across a wide variety of projects. Potential projects might include fully engineered solutions, Proof of Concepts (POCs), and applied research to support future defence-relevant capabilities.

    Responsibilities

    • Integrate AI components into applications and workflows, from POCs to fully engineered solutions
    • Evaluate model performance, identify failure modes, and design mitigations
    • Test and debug non-deterministic systems, building the tooling and evidence needed to trust them
    • Provide technical expertise when it is required within the organisation and in client engagements
    • Demonstrate flexibility in taking on work aligned to evolving company priorities
    • Play an active role in sharing expertise to raise and re-use capability

    What makes a great candidate

    You don't need to meet every requirement to apply. If this role excites you, we'd like to hear from you.

     

    Applied AI Engineer:

    • Experience integrating AI components into applications and workflows, such as building Retrieval Augmented Generation systems
    • Experience designing prompts and managing context for LLM applications
    • A working understanding of LLM principles and transformer architectures, backed by core machine learning concepts and statistical methods
    • Practical experience evaluating LLMs and mitigating their weaknesses
    • Experience running AI applications in production, including monitoring and optimisation
    • Experience fine tuning or adapting models for specific scenarios, such as for a specialist application or deployment to low power hardware
    • Experience building agentic systems, where models plan and act across several steps
    • Judgement about the risks and limitations of AI, including knowing when a statistical model or deterministic logic is the better choice

    General:

    • Strong programming skills, typically in Python, with the flexibility to pick up other modern languages
    • A solid grounding in software engineering best practices and a commitment to maintain high engineering standards in all your work
    • Excellent verbal and written communication, including the ability to explain technical aspects to non-technical colleagues
    • Ability to work effectively with ambiguity, while maintaining a disciplined, outcome-focused approach
    • Experience working as part of a team, with enthusiasm for sharing knowledge and collaborating
    • Strong academic foundations, typically a first-class from a leading university in Computer Science, Mathematics, AI, or a data related discipline
    • Experience in defence or national security is a strong plus

    What you can achieve

    • Contribute to AI solutions that strengthen UK defence and national security
    • Build a strong foundation in POC and production AI systems and engineering best practices that will shape your career
    • Develop your skills across the full AI engineering stack and a variety of technologies
    • Learn from experienced AI and software engineers who are invested in your growth
    • Contribute to meaningful technical decisions as part of a collaborative, low-ego engineering team

    Why join us

    • Work on a wide variety of interesting problems alongside high-calibre colleagues. Our culture is collaborative and supportive. Neptune North is a place where people help each other grow and feel a real sense of belonging
    • 25 days’ holiday allowance plus bank holidays
    • Matching pension contributions up to 6%
    • Private health insurance through Bupa
    • Discretionary bonus

    Travel

    Neptune North works with clients across the UK’s defence sector. Many engagements involve regular travel and time on client site. This could mean two to three days per week over an entire assignment, or shorter periods of full-time on-site working anywhere in the UK, at sites including Cheltenham, Bristol, Glasgow, Portsmouth or other defence hubs. We support travelling staff with full expenses and hotel arrangements, and we discuss client placements with you in advance. We are looking for engineers who see this variety as part of the appeal of consultancy work rather than a downside.

    Interview process

    Our interview process is rigorous because the standard internally is high. For this role, it has three stages:

    • Written questions, which you complete at a time that suits you
    • A first interview covering your CV, experience and career aspirations
    • A technical interview with members of our engineering team

    Equity, diversity and inclusion

    At Neptune North we are committed to a work environment that embraces diversity, equity and inclusion. We believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences help us attract, develop and retain the best talent. We do not discriminate based on gender, age, race or ethnicity, identification as an LGBTQIA+ individual, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by relevant local law.

Our Mission

At Ophelos, we believe in a different way to deal with debt. One that puts empathy and understanding front and centre, approaching our customers as individuals — no matter what they’re going through.

For too long, people in debt have borne the brunt of poor industry practices. Intimidating tactics, time-consuming customer service and a one-size-fits-all approach that overlooks the reasons anyone can fall into debt in the first place. Meanwhile, businesses suffer too. Poor customer experience translates to poor customer satisfaction, high churn rates, bad brand reputation and ultimately missed opportunities.

That’s why we’re taking a radically different approach. Pioneering an industry-first AI-native collections platform, we build products that help individuals clear their debts in a way that suits them, whilst providing businesses with an improved customer experience and game-changing insights into their customer base.

Since our launch in 2021, we’ve worked with some of the UK’s leading companies, including Octopus, Scottish Power and Philips — helping millions of people move toward a more stable, debt-free future. In 2023, we were acquired by Intrum, Europe’s biggest credit management service and have begun the next phase in our growth — expansion into 17 European markets over the next two years.

Customer Success Manager

Intrum, our parent company and one of Europe's largest credit management businesses, manages debt on behalf of a wide range of merchant clients — retailers, telcos, financial institutions, and more — across multiple European markets. Your job is to onboard those clients onto the Ophelos platform: understanding their data, their business logic, their customer portfolios, and their contractual and regulatory context, and making sure Ophelos works correctly for each of them.

Every client is different. They come with different data formats and quality standards, different definitions of what a debt case looks like, different regulatory obligations depending on their sector and market, and different expectations of how their customers should be treated. Your job is to absorb all of that, map it clearly, and translate it into a solution that works — at scale, across many clients, across multiple countries.

This role sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and product partnership. You'll spend as much time in discovery conversations and design workshops as you will in configuration files and integration specs. You'll need to be equally credible with a compliance lead in Paris, a data engineer in Lisbon, and a product manager in London.

What You'll Do

Onboard merchant clients onto Ophelos Each client Intrum brings to Ophelos has its own data structures, business rules, and portfolio characteristics. You'll lead the technical onboarding — understanding their data, designing the ingestion and mapping layer, and ensuring Ophelos represents their cases accurately and operates correctly on their behalf.

Navigate localisation and regulatory complexity Operating across European markets means dealing with materially different regulatory frameworks, debt collection norms, and consumer protection requirements — which vary by country, and sometimes by client sector. You'll develop deep fluency in what those differences mean technically, and design the configuration and solution patterns that allow Ophelos to serve each context correctly.

Design solutions, not just integrations You'll translate complex, sometimes ambiguous client requirements into clean solution designs — mapping existing data structures, business logic, and operational processes to Ophelos's platform. This isn't just about getting data from A to B; it's about understanding the business intent behind every field and flow, and making sure nothing gets lost in translation.

Own the data ingestion layer A significant part of this role involves designing and owning how each client's data arrives into Ophelos — in the right shape, with the right validation, from the right sources. You'll work across varying data formats, system conventions, and quality standards, and build patterns that make future onboarding progressively more efficient.

Close the feedback loop You're Ophelos's eyes and ears in the field. When you encounter a recurring client need, a gap in our product, a bug that only surfaces in a specific market context, or a feature that would unlock onboarding for a whole segment of clients — you bring that back clearly and systematically. You'll log issues, articulate feature requests with context and business case, and act as a structured conduit between the real world and Ophelos's product and engineering teams.

Build the onboarding playbook Document what you learn. Build reusable patterns, data mapping frameworks, and localisation guides that make each subsequent client onboarding faster and more predictable than the last.

Use LLM tooling as a force multiplier Like all Ophelos engineers, you'll work in an AI-first way — using Claude Code, Codex, and OpenSpec to accelerate integration work, draft specs, and explore solutions faster than traditional approaches allow.


The Ophelos Platform

You'll need to develop deep familiarity with our stack — not necessarily to build core features, but to understand its capabilities, constraints, and integration surface thoroughly:

  • Languages: TypeScript, Python, Ruby
  • Backend frameworks: FastAPI, Ruby on Rails
  • Data: PostgreSQL (via PlanetScale), Databricks
  • Workflow orchestration: Temporal
  • Financial ledger: TigerBeetle
  • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Observability: Datadog
  • LLM tooling: Claude Code, OpenSpec, Codex


About You

You're a systems thinker with technical depth and strong commercial instincts. You've probably worked in fintech, financial services, or enterprise SaaS — in a role that required you to get inside a client's world, understand it thoroughly, and design solutions that actually fit.

You might come from a solutions…

For too long, people in debt have borne the brunt of poor industry practices. Intimidating tactics, time-consuming customer service and a one-size-fits-all approach that overlooks the reasons anyone can fall into debt in the first place. Meanwhile, businesses suffer too. Poor customer experience translates to poor customer satisfaction, high churn rates, bad brand reputation and ultimately missed opportunities.

That’s why we’re taking a radically different approach. Pioneering an industry-first AI-native collections platform, we build products that help individuals clear their debts in a way that suits them, whilst providing businesses with an improved customer experience and game-changing insights into their customer base.

Scale and mature the function: Move from initial proof-of-concept over the first six months into scaling the function over the next year, bringing new products and propositions to market and eventually collaborating with direct reports, contractors, and agencies.

Leverage AI tooling for accelerated growth: Work in an AI-first environment with the freedom to explore AI tools and develop your expertise within a flexible, forward-thinking team.

About You

You're a data-driven marketer who cares far more about tangible pipeline conversion and qualified leads than wishy-washy brand metrics. Business Development Representative (London)

Hybrid work schedule — 2 days per week in our London office.

 

About Us

Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end global SaaS gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees while driving measurable ROI.

We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. Whether its engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event & brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery.

We’re growing, and we’re currently looking for a Business Development Representative to join us.

 

About the Role

As a Business Development Representative at Reachdesk, you’ll join our high-performing team in a role that blends research, strategy, and creativity to map complex organizations and engage key decision-makers effectively.

You’ll leverage our own innovative gifting platform as a powerful prospecting tool — giving you a unique advantage that every BDR wants.

This role offers clear, merit-based growth within the Business Development team, where you “promote yourself” automatically by consistently meeting or exceeding targets. Plus, Reachdesk provides multiple pathways across the company for further career advancement. If you’re smart, ambitious, resourceful, and ready to make an impact, this is the opportunity for you.

 

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute outbound lead generation strategies, effectively communicating Reachdesk’s SaaS platform value proposition to target markets.
  • Identify, engage, and qualify leads to create active, sales-ready opportunities within complex B2B organizations.
  • Monitor and analyze buying signals and product usage data to tailor outreach and respond quickly to prospects’ needs.
  • Plan and implement Account-Based Marketing (ABM) campaigns through detailed research, organizational mapping, and personalized content aligned with SaaS buyer journeys.
  • Maintain and update CRM systems (Salesforce and Salesloft) to ensure accurate tracking of pipeline and campaign effectiveness.
  • Execute multi-touch outreach campaigns using email, phone, social, and other channels to nurture leads through the sales funnel.
  • Build and manage a strong sales pipeline, prioritizing high-potential SaaS prospects for the sales team.
  • Represent Reachdesk at SaaS industry events, webinars, and partner gatherings to expand networks and generate new business opportunities.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth lead handoff, alignment on messaging, and customer insights.
  • Continuously analyze outreach results and iterate tactics to improve prospect engagement and conversion rates in a SaaS environment.

 

About You

  • Previous experience as a Business Development Representative (BDR), ideally with a proven track record of prospecting at mid-market or enterprise levels.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills — able to tailor messaging to different audiences, handle objections confidently, and build rapport quickly.
  • A demonstrable interest or track record in creative outreach strategies — such as personalized messaging, multi-channel campaigns, and leveraging social insights — to break through to prospects.
  • Exceptionally quick learner who can translate the company’s continuous innovations and new products into compelling value for prospects and stronger outcomes.
  • Resilient, entrepreneurial, and self-motivated — ready to embrace challenges and push personal limits.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to leverage insights from prospects, market trends, and competitors to directly contribute to the company’s go-to-market strategy and tactics.
  • Strong team player with a positive, collaborative attitude and clear communication across different teams.
  • Proficient in using multiple outreach channels beyond email; experience with dialing platforms like Nooks is a plus.

 

The Benefits

  • Competitive salary with generous stock options
  • Pension with employer contributions (NEST)
  • Affordable Private Medical Insurance, including mental health support and fast access to care
  • Flexible PTO that increases the longer you’re with us, plus extra flexibility for life’s unexpected moments
  • A genuinely collaborative culture with innovative, fun, and ambitious people

 

Reachdesk believes that a diverse team helps us achieve our mission faster, and so we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.
