Product Manager

Location: UK (remote)

Job Description

About Us

Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end global SaaS gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees, while driving measurable ROI.

We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. Whether it’s engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event & brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery.

Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stacks and is powered by our world-class team across New York, London, and Lisbon.

We’re growing, and we’re currently looking for a Product Manager to join us.

 

About the Role

As a Product Manager at Reachdesk, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the Reachdesk Platform. You will be accountable for turning complex customer and business problems into software products that deliver measurable impact.

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you’ll lead product initiatives end-to-end,  from identifying and deeply understanding the right problems to solve, through discovery and delivery, to launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy, proactively building context across customers, the market, internal stakeholders, data, and technology to understand what Reachdesk needs to achieve its goals. You’ll also make sound decisions when the path forward isn’t obvious.

You’ll partner closely with Engineering and Design and work across the wider business to create alignment, communicate decisions clearly, and ensure what we build is successfully launched, adopted, and delivers the outcomes we set out to achieve.

If you enjoy solving difficult problems, taking ownership, and moving comfortably between customer, technical, and business conversations, you’ll thrive in this role.

 

Responsibilities

  • Set product direction and priorities, bringing together company goals, internal stakeholder needs, customer insight, market context, data, and technical considerations to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Define problems and experiences before solutions, creating clear stories, journeys, and shared context so the Design and Engineering teams understand the problem and intended outcomes before determining the solution.
  • Lead product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and solution definition through delivery, rollout, and iteration, partnering with Engineering to manage scope, make pragmatic trade-offs, and deliver valuable solutions at pace.
  • Make sound product decisions and trade-offs, balancing customer and business needs, commercial impact, user experience, and technical considerations while aligning the wider business on compromises, priorities, and expectations.
  • Develop product opportunities with external partners, building relationships with technology partners to uncover mutual opportunities, shape integrations, align roadmaps, and navigate the product and commercial considerations required to bring them to market.
  • Orchestrate successful launches and adoption, working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, Logistics, Finance, Legal, and other teams to ensure the business is ready and customers realise value from what we build.
  • Communicate with clarity throughout, ensuring leadership and teams across Reachdesk understand product decisions, progress, risks, changes, and results.

 

About you

  • You have a strong track record of owning B2B SaaS products end-to-end, from identifying the right problems through delivery, adoption, and measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • You’re a strong problem solver who gets to the root of complex problems, brings structure to ambiguity, and uses evidence and judgement to determine the right path forward.
  • You operate with independence and initiative: you seek out the customers, stakeholders, data, and context you need rather than waiting for direction, while staying anchored to Reachdesk’s goals and priorities.
  • You have strong business and commercial awareness and are curious about how the wider company operates, allowing you to understand competing needs and make pragmatic decisions beyond the boundaries of Product.
  • You’re technically fluent enough to work effectively with Engineering, understand systems, integrations, and constraints, ask the right questions, and contribute meaningfully to solution and scope decisions.
  • You’re an exceptional communicator, able to create clarity, influence decisions, surface difficult trade-offs, and adapt how you communicate across customers, engineers, leadership, and teams throughout the business.
  • You’re comfortable operating externally as well as internally, building productive relationships with technology partners, uncovering shared opportunities, influencing without authority, and navigating product, technical, and commercial conversations.
  • You have a strong sense of product and user experience, caring about the coherence and quality of the complete experience rather than whether individual requirements or features have simply been delivered.

 

The benefits

  • Competitive salary with generous stock options
  • Pension with employer contributions (NEST)
  • Affordable Private Medical Insurance, including mental health support and fast access to care
  • Flexible PTO that increases the longer you’re with us, plus extra flexibility for life’s unexpected moments
  • A genuinely collaborative culture with innovative, fun, and ambitious people

 

Reachdesk believes that a diverse team helps us achieve our mission faster, and so we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Remote (UK-based)

 

About Us

Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end SaaS global gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees: while driving measurable ROI.

We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. Whether you’re engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event & brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery.

Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with your marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stack and is powered by a world-class team with hubs in New York, London, and Lisbon.

We’re growing and looking for a Sourcing Manager to join us.

 

About the Role

The Sourcing Manager is responsible for managing supplier relationships, negotiating rates, and overseeing the purchasing of promotional products and materials. You’ll play a key role in shaping how we source, curate, and deliver branded merchandise at scale for global clients, bringing campaigns to life through high quality, on brand products and building a best in class vendor network as we grow.

We are looking for someone with hands-on experience in promotional merchandise or branded products to take ownership of vendor sourcing, pricing, and fulfilment. This is a high impact role with real ownership, where you will directly influence product quality, supplier strategy, and commercial outcomes. In this role, you will operate in a fast moving, high volume environment, managing multiple sourcing requests at once while balancing speed, cost, and quality.  Working closely with Swag, Production, and Sales, you will own the end to end sourcing process, while building a product catalog and lookbooks that turn ideas into standout client campaigns. 

 

Responsibilities

  • Vendor & Inventory Management
    • Source, evaluate, and select suppliers for promotional products and branded merchandise.
    • Build out our vendor network as the business scales.
    • Build a vendor vetting process that aligns with business values.
    • Negotiate pricing and terms with vendors to achieve cost savings and favorable agreements.
    • Set pricing that balances market competitiveness with strong margin performance for Reachdesk.
    • Apply sustainable and scalable methodologies to pricing swag decoration to maximize Reachdesk’s margins while minimizing the time to quote these services.
    • Ensure all items available to purchase are accurately priced, stocked, and meet the quality standards of our clients.
    • Maintain strong, long-term relationships with key suppliers and oversee quality control.
    • Curate and create commercially compelling product catalogs and lookbooks that enable sales teams to sell across a variety of client use cases.
  • Procurement & Order Management
    • Place orders with partner vendors & track production schedules.
    • Oversee large or complex orders requiring multiple vendors or custom product development.
    • Track individual performance to ensure quarterly targets set by the leadership team are achieved.
    • Collaborate with warehouse and logistics partners to streamline global fulfillment.
    • Manage a high volume of concurrent sourcing requests, balancing speed, cost, and quality across multiple stakeholders.
  • Process & Collaboration
    • Provide guidance and support to production specialists.
    • Lead continuous improvement initiatives in procurement & order management processes.
    • Establish and evolve SOPs, working closely with cross-functional teams to continuously improve workflows and tools.

About Sayari: 

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

About the Role

Sayari’s customers buy answers to hard problems: who really owns a supplier, where a sanctioned network is moving goods, which alerts deserve an analyst’s time. Sayari’s AI platform Superconductor delivers those answers at machine scale. It is built in the field, with analysts and engineers working alongside customers to define what it needs to do.

The Field Intelligence Analyst brings Sayari’s tradecraft to that work. You scope the problem, design the solution, prove its value, and deliver mission impact. You own the analytical relationship for a portfolio of accounts, from first conversation through sustained delivery. What you learn on live engagements flows back into Superconductor and into Sayari’s tradecraft standard.

You work in our Field Intelligence Department, a global team of analysts deployed to support government agencies and Fortune 500 companies. You sit in the same org as Forward Deployed Engineers and the Product team. The field shapes the roadmap, and Product sets it.

 

Why This Role Exists

  • Customers buy answers. Superconductor reasons like an expert analyst at machine scale. The analyst’s job shifts from producing every answer by hand to directing, validating, and extending what Superconductor produces, and teaching customer analysts to do the same. 
  • Context should survive the contract. The analyst who designed the proof-of-value knows why the success criteria are what they are. Keeping that analyst on the account protects delivery quality and surfaces the next problem before the customer names it.
  • Tradecraft is built in the field. Field Intelligence Analysts see what was promised, what was delivered, and what the customer did with it. That full view produces better methodology, better evals, and a better Superconductor than any single-phase role can.

What You Will Do

Own the analytical relationship, end to end

  • Run discovery and proof-of-value engagements anchored on work the customer already pays people to do, such as alert adjudication, due diligence, investigations, and case prioritization. Define success criteria you will personally be accountable for delivering.
  • Stay on the account after close and deliver the work you scoped. This includes multi-hop investigations across ownership, trade, and corporate records, plus analytical briefings and training.
  • Serve as the customer’s single analytical point of contact from first conversation through renewal.

Build with Field Engineering and Product

  • Pair with FDEs on discovery and delivery. You define the analytical requirement, they build it, and you validate it against the mission.
  • When something built for one customer should be rebuilt for many, make the case to Product with evidence: the problem, the workaround, and the customers who share it.
  • Document where the platform falls short of the mission, with raw examples attached.

Deliver analyst-plus-AI, and teach it

  • Direct Superconductor against live mission problems. Validate its reasoning against expert standards, and extend it into new customer workflows.
  • Train and certify customer analysts on Sayari methods and on working with Superconductor. Identify the customer experts who should go further.

Build the tradecraft

  • Capture the judgment calls, non-obvious pivots, and creative approaches from live engagements. Contribute them to the Tradecraft team as expert-annotated reference cases, eval scenarios, and training material.
  • Hold your work to the Field Intelligence standard, and help raise it.

Support Go-To-Market Teams

  • Work with Sales to diagnose customer problems, scope solutions, and deliver mission impact.

 

Who You Are

Required

  • A builder’s temperament and comfort with ambiguity. You do well on small teams with end-to-end ownership and no defined lane, working next to engineers on things that don’t exist yet.
  • Experience conducting complex, multi-source investigations in one or more of these areas: financial crime, sanctions and export controls, supply chain and forced labor risk, transnational criminal organizations, or law enforcement and intelligence investigations. This should include work with corporate records, trade data, and OSINT.
  • Customer-facing range. You have scoped engagements, demonstrated capability to skeptical experts, and delivered under a statement of work. Candidates often come from solutions consulting, services delivery, embedded analytics, or mission-support roles.
  • Hands-on fluency directing and evaluating AI and agentic analytical tools. You can define what “right” looks like precisely enough to test against.
  • Clear communication with analysts, program managers, engineers, and executives.

 

Desired

  • Python or SQL for data manipulation, and familiarity with REST APIs.
  • Experience designing training curricula or certifying analysts.
  • For government portfolios: an active Government security clearance and same citizenship as your country of residence.

 

 
Sayari is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply. We believe diversity and inclusion mean our team members should reflect the diversity of the United States. No employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, religion, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability status, veteran status, genetics, or political affiliation. We strongly encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

This is not a traditional engineering role. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you are at the critical intersection of our code, our clients, and their most critical missions. You own the "last mile" of our product's impact , ensuring our technology fundamentally transforms how our users confront challenges such as financial crime, supply chain disruption, and threats to national security.

You are equal parts engineer, strategist, and operator. One day you might be architecting a data pipeline within a client's cloud environment ; the next, you'll be writing production Python to integrate our API into a proprietary analytics platform ; and by the end of the week, you could be briefing a C-level executive, intelligence analyst, or mission director on the outcomes your work has enabled.

You thrive on ambiguity, operate with extreme ownership, and are relentless in your pursuit of delivering real-world value. You will act as a vital conduit between the front lines and our core engineering teams, turning your bespoke solutions into scalable, platform-wide features of Sayari’s product suite.

  • Embed and Build: Deploy directly into our clients' technical ecosystems and work with key stakeholders to understand their unique workflows, technical environments, and mission challenges. Design, build, and ship production-grade code. You will write robust Python applications, advanced SQL, and leverage our APIs to solve bespoke challenges at the edge.
  • Own the Outcome: Lead the entire technical lifecycle of our most strategic deployments, from initial discovery and architectural design to implementation and operationalization. You are responsible for ensuring our platform delivers tangible, mission-critical value.

Architect and implement scalable data models and workflows, ranging from building robust data pipelines into client persistence layers (Snowflake, Databricks, etc.) to developing custom Python scripts and prototyping AI/ML models.

  • 5+ years of experience in a client-facing, technical role (Forward Deployed Engineer, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Technical Consulting, etc.).
  • Demonstrated ability to write clean, production-ready code, with strong proficiency in programming languages (preferably Python) and its data manipulation ecosystem (Pandas, etc.).
  • Deep fluency in writing and optimizing complex SQL queries.
  • Hands-on, practical experience consuming, integrating, and reasoning about RESTful APIs.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between code and mission. You can articulate highly technical concepts with clarity and conviction to engineers, analysts, and senior leaders alike.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous, complex scenarios.
  • A relentless drive and intellectual curiosity. You are comfortable parachuting into new environments and learning new technologies on the fly.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field strongly preferred

Desired:

  • Practical experience leveraging AI, including prompting Large Language Models (LLMs) or using their APIs to build analytical solutions.
  • Experience building and deploying solutions on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with the modern data stack (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks) and workflow orchestrators (e.g., Airflow, Prefect).
  • Knowledge of graph data technologies (Neo4j, TigerGraph) and their corresponding query languages.
  • Exposure to machine learning applications, particularly in NLP or entity resolution.
  • Experience in, or a demonstrated passion for, high-stakes domains such as AML/Financial Crime, Supply Chain Risk, or National Security.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%

 

The target base salary for this position is £100,000 to £110,000 plus commission and equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, candidate experience and expertise, internal peer equity, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Elevate your career by joining Stackline as we continue to blaze the trail in driving success across e-commerce! 

At Stackline, we are seeking an energized and motivated individual to join our dynamic team that operates at the forefront of developing, delivering, and optimizing programmatic display campaigns for some of the most prominent brands in the world.

As an Account Manager - Programmatic Retail Media Strategy, you'll be synthesizing vast amounts data and transforming them into easily understandable insights for both internal and external audiences! You will build and nurture meaningful and long-lasting relationships across all organizational levels within your portfolio of brands as you influence their business decisions through data. 

This is a full-time position with a hybrid in-office policy (4 days/week in office) based in Central London.

 

What You Will Do:

  • Develop, deliver, and optimize programmatic display campaigns on e-commerce platforms, such as Amazon DSP and The Trade Desk.
  • Build tactical media plans that include budget and key performance indicator (KPI) recommendations.
  • Synthesize substantial amounts of data and analyses into easily understandable insights for both internal and external audiences.
  • Build and develop relationships with individuals at prominent consumer brands across all organizational levels and departments.
  • Lead regular client calls to address project work, discuss business trends and performance, and plan future engagements.
  • Support the management of client accounts, with the goal of independently overseeing key clients and accounts.
  • Identify and implement on opportunities to scale and/or automate existing service offerings.
  • Own relationships across various-sized brands, leveraging Stackline’s data to provide top-quality insights to key clients.
  • Generate reports analyzing media performance and incorporating tie-ins to market share trends and competitive analysis.
  • Acquire in-depth knowledge of Stackline’s various software products as a subject matter expert (SME) for clients.

 

Who We Are Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or related field. 
  • 4+ years of relevant account management experience.  
  • 4+ years of experience in display programmatic media or similar digital advertising discipline.

  • Strong sense of curiosity about new topics and challenges.
  • Demonstrated ability to stay organized while prioritizing and managing workflows.  
  • Demonstrated experience drawing insights from data to provide recommendations to clients on e-commerce strategy.

  • Demonstrated understanding of the Amazon Advertising ecosystem or other retail media.

  • Experience working in a startup, retail, digital advertising, or e-commerce environment. 
  • Experience working with SQL or Excel

Super Payments

Super Payments is the only global fintech platform providing 0% processing fees for merchants. Our mission is to use data and AI to make payments free for businesses, so that everyone wins. 

At Super, we are disrupting payments, like Spotify did to music and Robinhood did to trading. We don't make money from transaction fees;  instead, we monetise through value-added services such as lender commissions and FX. Our platform supports multiple payment methods — from traditional cards to direct bank transfers via open banking, as well as Apple Pay, Google Pay, and our own Buy Now Pay Later solution. 

Super has raised $66M from leading investors including Accel, Union Square Ventures and Local Globe (the same investors behind Spotify, Stripe, Monzo) and founded by Samir Desai CBE, co-founder of Funding Circle. 

Already trusted by thousands of businesses and more than 4 million customers, Super is processing at a run rate of £1.5B and growing 4x YOY

Our Values

  • Customer obsessed: We only succeed when our customers do.
  • Move fast: Build, test and improve quickly. Progress matters more than perfection.
  • Own it: Be accountable, solve problems, and make it happen.
  • Be open: Act with honesty and respect. Transparency builds trust.
  • Win together: Collaboration beats ego every time.

Product Manager - Consumer Experience

The Product team sits at the centre of that mission. We move fast, challenge everything, and build experiences that make people wonder why the old way ever existed. We're not here to iterate on the status quo — we're here to blow it up and replace it with something better.

This is a rare opportunity to build with AI-native tools and cutting-edge technology from day one. Our PMs don't just spec features — they shape how millions of people interact with their money. That means thinking bigger, moving faster, and refusing to accept "that's just how it works" as an answer.

We need someone who thrives on ambiguity, picks fights with convention, and brings a relentless hunger to solve problems that actually matter. You'll shape the roadmap  working across Commercial, Operations, Design, Engineering, and Data to ship world-class web and mobile experiences, including the checkout and payment flows that sit at the very core of what we do.

The playbook for the future of payments hasn't been written yet. Come help us write it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Shaping the roadmap — obsessing over the right problems, defining audacious success metrics, and making sure decisions are commercial and made with the customer in mind 
  • Driving impact that's measurable, meaningful, and repeatable based on data, market research, customer insight and conviction 
  • Taking products from zero to one and beyond — ideation, development, launch, growth, and the relentless optimisation that follows
  • Pushing Engineering to move fast and build right — leading on technical approach, requirements, and delivery without ever losing sight of the bigger picture
  • Partnering with Design and UX to create web and mobile experiences that are simple yet transformative
  • Obsessing over checkout and conversion flows — running bold experiments, letting go of what doesn't work, and doubling down on what does
  • Cutting through complexity with stakeholders across Marketing, Legal, Financial Crime, and Strategy — aligning fast and moving faster

Requirements 

We’d love to hear from you if you:

  • 3–5+ years of product management experience working on consumer focused features with a track record of taking features from zero to one 
  • Direct experience working on consumer features, e.g. consumer checkout, apps, consumer fintech,  — you understand how conversion and  drop-off can trade off against each other, and you've moved the needle on them. This is a consumer product role, not a back end payments / infrastructure or B2B platform position. 
  • Experience working with Engineering: you can write a clear spec, argue technical trade-offs, and make the call when there's no clean answer
  • Sharp with data — you define success metrics and are able to analyse all data related to your features 
  • A bias for shipping: an 80%-right version this week beats a 100%-right version next quarter
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, able to bring engineers, designers, and non-technical stakeholders onto the same page
  • Genuine curiosity about your product with real opinions on how to continually improve it
  • You’ve shipped and grown a product used by tens/hundreds of thousands of consumers (E-commerce, retail marketplaces, subscription, fintech gaming, or media)

*The stated experience and background is a guide and does not preclude applications from candidates with more or less experience, provided the requisite skills can be demonstrated.

Our Benefits - here’s a few and more to come ….

  • Tax advantage Share Options
  • Flexible working model
  • Work from home set up
  • Learning & Development opportunities
  • Contributory Pension Scheme
  • Free Team lunch (Tues & Thurs) and social evenings
  • Comprehensive PMI & x4 Life Insurance

Senior Data Engineer

Role Overview

We run an event-driven data platform on AWS and Snowflake. Events flow from our product services through EventBridge, Kinesis Firehose, S3, and are auto-ingested into Snowflake via Snowpipe; batch and third-party data lands through Snowpark-deployed Python procedures. All infrastructure is defined in Terraform/Terragrunt. Python (Poetry, Pydantic, pytest) is our pipeline language; GitHub Actions runs CI/CD. Datadog gives us end-to-end pipeline observability.

Key Responsibilities

Ingestion & Pipeline Engineering

  • Event Pipeline Ownership: Build and evolve the EventBridge → Firehose → S3 → Snowpipe ingestion path, including partitioning and throughput tuning as event volumes grow across streams like fraud, payments and merchant.
  • Batch & Third-Party Integrations: Design and deploy Snowpark-based Python procedures for file-based and third-party data loads, scheduled and monitored as Snowflake Tasks.
  • Schema Evolution: Work with product engineers to manage upstream schema changes and late-arriving data without breaking downstream consumers.

Infrastructure & Reliability

  • Infrastructure as Code: Own and extend Terraform/Terragrunt modules for ingestion infrastructure across multiple environments.
  • Pipeline Observability: Design Datadog monitors and alerting for Firehose, EventBridge, DLQs and Snowpipe; triage and resolve ingestion failures.
  • Security & Compliance: Manage PII handling (hashing, secure deletion), masking, data governance and access in Snowflake. Support audit-ready, reconciled data for Finance and Compliance.

Data Pipelines & Data Quality

  • Dbt: Build privacy-first data pipelines using dbt and Snowflake Dynamic Tables to safely expose sensitive data for downstream analytics and reporting.
  • Data Quality: Build testing and monitoring for ingestion and transformation logic to catch issues before they reach the business or the Analytics Engineering team.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with the wider Engineering team and Analytics Engineering team as a downstream consumer, to ensure pipelines deliver accurate, audit-ready data.

Requirements

We'd love it if you have

  • AWS & Event-Driven Architecture: Hands-on experience with streaming/event ingestion (Kinesis, EventBridge or equivalents), S3 partitioning, and queue/DLQ patterns.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform experience required; Terragrunt a plus. Comfortable owning modules across environments, not just consuming them.
  • Snowflake & Warehouse Engineering: Strong SQL for Snowflake, including Snowpipe, Tasks and Snowpark.
  • Dbt: Proven experience in building well tested SQL and python models in dbt.
  • CI/CD & Data Security: Experience with GitHub Actions (or equivalent), and secrets/key management, PII and sensitive data handling in Snowflake.
  • Python Coding: Python skills for pipeline and infrastructure code (typed models, testing, CI-deployed services),  not just scripting or analysis.

Engineering Ownership

Technical Communication: A pragmatic, systems-level mindset with the ability to explain pipeline failures, infrastructure trade-offs, or data-flow issues clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ownership & Initiative: A strong willingness to work independently, take initiative, and take full ownership of the pipelines and infrastructure you build, from design and implementation through to production reliability.
  • Production Mindset: Proactively monitoring, debugging, and improving pipelines and infrastructure in production, not just building them and moving on.

job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/srm/jobs/493.description_excerpt:
CORPORATE INTELLIGENCE EXPERIENCED CASE MANAGER - FORMER SOVIET UNION, LONDON

S-RM is seeking an experienced Case Manager to join the Former Soviet Union team within our Corporate Intelligence division, based in our London offices.

 

WHO ARE WE

S-RM is a global intelligence and cyber security consultancy. Since 2005, we’ve helped companies, governments and private individuals solve some of their most complex challenges.

We’ve been able to do this because of our outstanding people. We’re committed to developing sharp, curious, enthusiastic people who want to think critically, solve complex problems, and achieve success.

But we also know that work isn’t everything. It’s about the lives and careers it helps us build. We’re immensely proud of this culture and we invest in our people’s wellbeing, learning, and ideas every day. 

We’re excited you’re thinking about joining us.

 

THE ROLE

The successful candidate will play a leading role in the management and delivery of a range of complex corporate intelligence matters relating to the Former Soviet Union region. They will combine strong investigative expertise, project management, and client relationship skills to deliver high-quality project work for our clients.

 

The key areas of responsibility will be:

  • Manage a broad range of complex investigative engagements from initial scoping through to delivery, ensuring projects are complete to a high standard and within agreed timelines.
  • Analyse information from a wide range of sources to produce accurate and well supported findings. 
  • Conduct human source enquiries across the Former Soviet Union, consistently building the team’s regional network.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with our clients, including presenting findings via verbal briefings and presentations to senior stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities for additional project work and contribute to the growth if existing client relationships.
  • Play a key role in developing S-RM’s research capabilities, knowledge base, and professional network across the Former Soviet Union region.
  • Mentor and support analysts, sharing expertise and promoting high-quality investigative standards across the team.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of investigative best practice.

 

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We nurture a culture of equality, diversity and inclusion and we are dedicated to developing a workforce that displays a variety of talents, experiences and perspectives. Candidates with the following qualifications and experience are likely to succeed in our Former Soviet Union team at S-RM.

 

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in the Corporate Intelligence/Strategic Intelligence industry.
  • Proven ability to read and research to a high-standard in Russian is required.
  • Proficiency in further foreign languages is also desirable.
  • Experience leading on complex engagements, including in-depth due diligence assignments, high-stakes investigations, and market entry analyses, with a strong focus on jurisdictions in the Former Soviet Union/Central Eastern Europe.
  • Deep understanding of political, economic, commercial and legal dynamics across the Former Soviet Union region.
  • Excellent open source research skills and confidence in conducting regional human source enquiries.
  • Proven ability to effectively plan, staff, and manage Corporate Intelligence projects of varying complexities within budget and timelines, as well as being accountable for the work of other team members, quality assurance, and client deliverables.
  • Demonstrable experience in client communication and relationship building, including request scoping, project proposals, day-to-day client management.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, including experience providing clear and constructive feedback to team members. 
  • Experience in mentoring and managing junior colleagues, sharing best practice, and upholding quality standards.

All candidates must have permission to work in the UK by the start of their employment. The role will be based in our London office, with a hybrid working arrangement requiring two days per week in the office.

 

OUR BENEFITS

We offer thoughtful, balanced rewards and support to help our people do their best work and live their lives outside it, this includes but is not exhaustive of:

  • 25 days holiday per year increasing to 30 days (+1 day for every year you worked at S-RM, up to a maximum of 5 days) in addition to bank holidays
  • Private medical insurance with Vitality (taxable benefit, tax is taken from monthly pay)  - access to private healthcare, as well as to a great range of various discounts and rewards
  • Virtual GP and Second Medical Opinion services – timely access to medical advice 24/7, 365 days a year, open to you and your family members that live in the same household
  • Various gym discounts for you and your partner , including 50% of with Virgin Active, Pure Gym and Nuffield Health Gyms
  • Dental insurance with BUPA (taxable benefit, tax is taken from monthly pay) 
  • Life insurance – 4x annual salary
  • Pension – up to 7% contribution matched by the company. Contribution is taken from gross pay – tax relief is applied automatically
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Programme) for employees and immediate family, including counselling sessions
  • Free access to the world-famous mindfulness app Headspace 
  • Free mortgage support services
  • Access to online discount hub, saving on shopping, insurance, dining and more 
  • Seasonal flu vaccination
  • Eye tests and glasses reimbursement up to certain cost on an annual basis
  • Formalised Recognition programme 
  • Hybrid working and flexible working hours
  • Fertility treatment leave – 5 days of leave per cycle of treatment per year

After successful probation period:

  • Season ticket loan – deducted from payroll over 12 months
  • Cycle to work scheme – up to £4,000 salary sacrifice deducted over 12 months 

At a later stage:

  • Maternity leave – 26 weeks of full pay followed by 13 weeks of half pay (after 1 year at the company on the “qualifying week” = 15 weeks before a due date)
  • Paternity leave – 6 weeks of full pay (after 1 year at the company on the “qualifying week” = 15 weeks before a due date)

WHO WE ARE

S-RM is a global intelligence and cybersecurity consultancy. Since 2005, we’ve helped some of the most demanding clients in the world solve some of their toughest information security challenges.

We’ve been able to do this because of our outstanding people. We’re committed to developing bright, curious, driven individuals who want to think critically, solve complex problems, and achieve success.

But we also know that work isn’t everything, it’s about the lives and careers it helps us build. We’re immensely proud of this culture and we invest in our people’s wellbeing, learning, and ideas every day.

We’re excited you’re thinking about joining us.

 

WORKING IN CYBER AT S-RM

Our Cyber Security practice is the newest and fastest-growing part of S-RM. The cyber sector is always evolving, and our Advisory, Testing, Incident Response and Forensics practices are in more demand than ever.

We’re building a team to meet this challenge. This means we’re quick to respond, innovate, and improve. We don’t get too hung up on hierarchy or bureaucracy. If your ideas are good enough, we’ll empower you to implement them. If you’re the best person to talk to a customer, you’ll get that opportunity, regardless of the title in your email signature. And when you need a hand, your team will always have your back.

We also don’t believe there’s a typical cyber security professional. We’ve built a team of intelligence analysts, technical specialists, software developers, investigators, risk managers, and more. You’ll always find a range of perspectives and expertise to help you learn and grow.

If that sounds like your kind of team, we’d like to hear from you.

 

THE ROLE

Cyber Risk and Resilience Associates lead cyber consultancy engagements within a fast-growing and highly regarded practice, with the opportunity to take on real responsibility early in their careers. 

You will work closely with clients to understand their challenges, lead project teams and deliver thoughtful, high-quality solutions across a broad range of cyber risk management and resilience activities. As part of a leading cyber security consultancy, you will help clients navigate complex and evolving security risks while building trusted adviser relationships. You will also work with colleagues across international consulting teams, supporting clients in the UK and globally, with exposure to a wide variety of sectors, challenges and senior stakeholders. 

Our Associates are project managers, people managers and consultants. You will join a collaborative and diverse team drawn from a wide range of professional backgrounds, within an organisation known for its pace, openness and genuinely cross-team approach. This role offers the chance to develop quickly through a mix of client delivery, team leadership, commercial exposure and access to internal and external training, while contributing to the growth of established and emerging service areas. 

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

 

Cyber Security Consulting: 

At the core of the Associate role is hands-on cyber security consulting. You will lead delivery across multiple domain areas, including: 

  • Incident Response Preparedness  
  • Cyber incident response strategy, policy, and plan development. 
  • Simulation exercising at leadership and operational levels. 

 

  • Digital Resilience 
  • Business impact analysis, business continuity and disaster recovery planning

Universal Design Studio was founded in 2001 by Edward Barber and Jay Osgerby in Shoreditch, London. The studio is driven by a deeply held belief in the transformative power of well designed, finely crafted spaces with a process rooted in design-led strategy and research. The studio’s work foregrounds the experience of the people that inhabit our spaces, with an emphasis on adaptability and rigour.

Alongside this, the studio has executed culturally significant projects for galleries and cultural institutions across the globe. Clients include Ace Hotel, Fortnum & Mason, At Six Stockholm, The Office Group, Rimowa, the Victoria & Albert Museum, IBM, Google and Frieze Art Fair amongst others.
 
The studio is co-directed by Jason Holley and Paul Gulati.

We are keen to meet freelance architects and interior designers to work with us on our exciting upcoming projects.

Freelance engagement: To work with Universal as a freelance Designer in the UK, we would require you to be employed via an FCSA approved umbrella company: www.fcsa.org.uk/members. 
An umbrella company is a professional employment organisation that engages contractors with a view to carry out multiple assignments at a series of temporary workplaces. job-boards.greenhouse.io/triplewhale/job.description_excerpt:
What Do We Do?

Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern ecommmerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you — pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it bites.

We pull every signal in your business into one place, and put it on the most trusted measurement foundation in the industry. And on top of that, we give you the most actionable AI in commerce — Moby 2 — letting you tap any LLM you want, grounded in the full context of your business. Moby 2 doesn't just surface insights, it executes decisions for you, with automations that make the rest of your stack smarter.

The result: more than 65,000 brands like Kitsch, OUAI, and True Classic turn mountains of complex data into actions that actually grow profit, at a speed and scale that is not humanly possible.

What You're Applying for

We’re looking for an Expansion Account Executive to grow our relationships with existing customers across Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

You’ll identify where customers have a business need we can help solve, build a clear case for further investment and own the commercial process through to close. That means understanding how a customer uses Triple Whale today, what their team is trying to achieve and where broader adoption would make a meaningful difference.

This is an active selling role within an existing customer base. You won’t wait for upgrade requests or rely solely on Customer Success referrals. You’ll build your own pipeline through account research, targeted outreach and strong relationships across each customer’s business.

What You’ll Do 

  • Own expansion revenue across an assigned EMEA portfolio. Manage upsell and cross-sell opportunities from discovery and qualification through proposal, negotiation and close.
  • Build a proactive expansion pipeline. Use customer goals, adoption signals, account changes and conversations with Customer Success to identify and prioritise opportunities.
  • Sell against a specific business problem. Understand the customer’s current workflow, what isn’t working, who is affected and why solving it matters now.
  • Develop relationships beyond the original buyer. Engage founders, ecommerce leaders, marketing teams, finance stakeholders and other decision-makers where relevant.
  • Build credible business cases. Connect the proposed investment to outcomes the customer values, using agreed evidence and clear assumptions rather than broad promises.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success. Coordinate account plans and outreach, distinguish adoption problems from genuine expansion opportunities and avoid conflicting customer conversations.
  • Run relevant demonstrations and evaluations. Work with Solutions and product specialists to show how the proposed solution addresses the customer’s agreed priorities.
  • Manage the commercial process. Confirm budget, decision-makers, procurement requirements and timelines; maintain clear next steps and accurate forecasts.
  • Support a clean transition after the sale. Document the agreed scope, customer expectations and success criteria so implementation and adoption can follow.
  • Improve the EMEA expansion motion. Share recurring customer needs, objections and buying patterns with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and Product

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience in quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales, expansion or commercial account management.
  • A track record of growing existing accounts through proactive selling, not only processing renewals or inbound upgrades.
  • Strong discovery skills: you can move from a feature request to the underlying business problem and qualify whether there is a real opportunity.
  • Confidence managing a full sales cycle, including demonstrations, business cases, negotiation and closing.
  • The ability to build relationships with both day-to-day users and senior budget holders.
  • Sound commercial judgement. You know when to pursue an opportunity, when to involve a specialist and when a customer needs support before another sales conversation.
  • Experience managing a portfolio, prioritising your time and keeping CRM records and forecasts accurate.
  • Nice to have: Experience selling ecommerce, marketing technology, analytics or AI software.
  • Nice to have: Familiarity with the commercial metrics ecommerce teams use, including customer acquisition cost, return on ad spend, lifetime value and profitability.
  • Nice to have: Additional languages relevant to the assigned EMEA territory.

The Brattle Group is looking for a Research Analyst (RA) to work out of our London office.

ABOUT THE BRATTLE GROUP AND ECONOMIC CONSULTING

The Brattle Group is a leading global economic and litigation consulting firm. We provide expert analysis and testimony in legal disputes, regulatory proceedings, and business strategy. Our teams apply economic, financial, and analytical expertise to solve complex problems and provide strategic insights for our clients. At The Brattle Group, we bridge the gap between economic theory and real-world application, helping clients make informed decisions in areas such as corporate finance, energy, competition, and regulatory economics.

WHAT IS ECONOMIC CONSULTING?

Economic consulting involves using economic theories, quantitative methods, and data analysis to address legal and business challenges. Consultants work on high-stakes projects, providing advice to law firms, corporations, and government agencies. Our work influences major decisions and outcomes in legal cases and business strategies worldwide.

RESEARCH ANALYST – INTERNATIONAL ARBITRATION  

We are looking for intellectually curious, collaborative individuals with strong quantitative skills to join our International Arbitration practice in London, starting as soon as possible. As a Research Analyst (RA), you will contribute to complex and challenging projects from the start, working alongside senior consultants, leading industry experts, and global law firms.

Brattle offers a diverse, stimulating, and collegial environment, where you will have opportunities to develop your analytical and technical skills. Your career will begin with structured training in Brattle’s best practices for economic and financial modelling, coding, and analytical problem-solving. You will continue to develop your expertise through hands-on project experience and ongoing professional training.

Typical Responsibilities

  • Analysing complex datasets to identify trends and insights
  • Constructing economic and financial models
  • Researching economic and financial issues relevant to international disputes
  • Understanding the debate around key economic developments
  • Analysing companies and markets
  • Presenting findings in a compelling way

WHY BRATTLE? 

  • Work in a collaborative, intellectually stimulating environment alongside experts in the field.
  • Benefit from ongoing professional development and training opportunities.
  • Be part of a diverse and dynamic team within a globally recognised firm.

RA CAREER DEVELOPMENT

At The Brattle Group, your career growth is a priority. As an RA, you will gain valuable skills in applied economics and finance. You'll discover your strengths and interests, and how to best apply your skills. You will be paired with a peer-level buddy and a manager-level career advisor to help you make the most of your time at Brattle. You will develop practical experience in conducting economic research, writing and revising code, collaborating on analytical projects, and communicating findings clearly and concisely. You will also gain exposure to different industries.

THE CANDIDATE

The ideal candidate will possess:

  • A master’s degree in economics or another quantitative discipline, with strong academic performance.
  • Great teamwork and leadership skills. Our project work is done almost exclusively in teams, so it’s critical that our RAs work well with others. 
  • Intellectual curiosity and creativity. We are looking for candidates who consistently want to learn more and approach problems with creativity.
  • A strong sense of ownership and commitment to producing high-quality work. Successful RAs are committed to delivering their best work product, taking ownership of their work, and engaging in excellent client services.

Additionally, we look for candidates who:

  • Have experience in data analysis
  • Demonstrate creative problem-solving skills and can communicate complex concepts effectively
  • Are fluent in English (proficiency in another European language is a plus)

Please submit the following materials through the link below:

  • Cover letter
  • CV
  • Transcript(s) (unofficial copies accepted)

• Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it
• Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys
• Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing
• Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't
• Design model routing strategies for real-time voice workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades
• Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both
• Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for English-language use cases and UK/Irish-specific regulatory environments (UK GDPR, Data Protection Act 2018, EU AI Act for cross-border workloads)
• Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live
• Own customer outcomes — stay engaged until the solution is live and stable
• Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap based on field insights from the UK and Ireland
• Create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and maintainable solutions for handoff
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues alongside customer teams

What We're Looking For

• CS degree or equivalent experience
• 3+ years building and shipping production software — you've written code that real users depended on, you've been on-call for it, and you've debugged it when things broke. (A consulting background counts if this is also true of you.)
• Proficiency in multiple languages: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go — you're more dangerous in some than others. (Telnyx Edge Compute — functions and stateful actors — is TypeScript, so that one pulls double duty.)
• Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency
• Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story
• You've wired observability and been paged because of it — Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, ELK, or equivalent. You…

About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

 

The Role

We're building local Enterprise Sales Pods across global markets — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in the UK and Ireland. This is not a remote overlay on an existing territory. You will own a named-account list of 30–40 enterprise accounts across the UK and Ireland, and your job is to turn those accounts into production Telnyx customers.

You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated FDE — not a demo resource, but a technical partner who designs architectures, builds POCs, and gets the first workload live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.

This is a founding role. You'll help define how Telnyx sells into enterprise accounts in the UK and Ireland, set the playbook, and build the references that the next wave of hires will follow.

The Pod Model

Enterprise AE — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account.

Forward Deployed Engineer — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.

We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.

What You'll Do

• Own a territory of 30–40 named enterprise accounts across the UK and Ireland, narrowing to ~10 Tier 1 accounts worth $1M+ in annual potential
• Build executive relationships — get in the room with CIOs, CTOs, VP Engineering, and line-of-business owners
• Run the full sales cycle: prospect, qualify, design the commercial architecture with your FDE, negotiate, and close
• Sell production outcomes, not individual products — lead with "let's deploy an AI agent that operates your SOC or NOC workflow," not "which Telnyx products do you want?"
• Agree the commercial destination before any custom work begins — no free discovery or free development
• Maintain disciplined POC management: every POC has a named executive sponsor, written success criteria, production pricing discussed, a decision date, and a signed commercial document. POCs end in production or they end
• Expand the account — one workload becomes three, one $500K customer becomes a $2M customer
• Build local references and case studies across London and Dublin
• Provide accurate pipeline reporting and forecasting — no surprises

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of enterprise sales experience selling into the UK and/or Irish market — CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, telecom, AI/ML, or similarly technical infrastructure
• Proven track record of consistently exceeding quota ($1M+ deals)
• Experience selling to both executive and technical buyers — you can hold your own in the boardroom and in the architecture review
• Hunter mentality — you build your own pipeline and thrive on outbound, in-person selling
• Strong consultative selling skills: can build a clear, compelling ROI story for both technical and business buyers
• Familiarity with sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, etc.)
• Comfortable with modern sales tools (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, etc.)
• Excellent written and verbal communication in English. You listen before you pitch.
• Willingness to be in the field — visiting customers in person is a core part of this role
• Based in London, or willing to relocate — this is a hybrid role with travel across the UK and Ireland

Bonus Points For

• Fortune 500 or large enterprise new business sales experience in the UK or Ireland
• Complex sales cycles including RFPs, POCs, and competitive bake-offs
• C-Level selling experience — you can navigate procurement, security, and legal complexity, including UK enterprises (BT Group, Vodafone UK, Lloyds Banking Group, HSBC, Barclays, Tesco, Unilever, BAE Systems, Rolls-Royce) and Irish enterprises (Eir, Ryanair, Kerry Group, Smurfit Kappa, AIB, CRH)
• Understanding of SIP trunking, phone number provisioning, carrier networks, or AI/ML platforms
• Established relationships in the London enterprise ecosystem — fintech, telecom, media, healthcare, insurance, or SaaS
• Experience with UK public sector and government procurement frameworks (G-Cloud, Crown Commercial Service)
• Irish language skills or existing relationships in the Dublin enterprise ecosystem

WorldQuant develops and deploys systematic financial strategies across a broad range of asset classes and global markets. We seek to produce high-quality predictive signals (alphas) through our proprietary research platform to employ financial strategies focused on market inefficiencies. Our teams work collaboratively to drive the production of alphas and financial strategies – the foundation of a balanced, global investment platform.

WorldQuant is built on a culture that pairs academic sensibility with accountability for results. Employees are encouraged to think openly about problems, balancing intellectualism and practicality. Excellent ideas come from anyone, anywhere. Employees are encouraged to challenge conventional thinking and possess an attitude of continuous improvement.

Our goal is to hire the best and the brightest. We value intellectual horsepower first and foremost, and people who demonstrate an outstanding talent. There is no roadmap to future success, so we need people who can help us build it.

Technologists at WorldQuant research, design, code, test and deploy projects while working collaboratively with researchers and portfolio managers. Our environment is relaxed yet intellectually driven. We seek people who think in code and are motivated by being around like-minded people.

The Role: We are looking for an exceptionally strong software engineer to join our Technology organization at WorldQuant. You will be part of a business-facing team responsible for building and evolving the core systems that power our Quant strategies. This is an AI-forward team: large language models (LLMs) and AI agents are part of our daily workflow — from writing and reviewing code, to automating operational toil, to building internal copilots and agentic tools that the whole team relies on. You won't just use AI to move faster; you'll help shape how it's applied across our engineering practice.

  • Design and build data pipelines and the data layer.
  • Develop and maintain the computational frameworks and infrastructure that run our quantitative strategies at scale.
  • Implement and enhance quant-related software systems for data, research, portfolio construction, and trading.
  • Work closely with Researchers, and Quants as a hands-on engineering partner, helping them turn ideas into robust production solutions.
  • Gain exposure to the full lifecycle of the systematic/quant business, from data ingestion through research, implementation.
  • Build and integrate AI-powered tooling - LLM agents, copilots, and automation - into engineering and research workflows.
  • Use AI coding assistants and agentic developer tools to ship higher-quality software faster.


  
What You’ll Bring:

  • Degree in a technical or quantitative discipline from a top tier institution.
  • 3 to 8 years of working experience in software engineering.
  • Demonstrated ability to program in Python (preferred) or C++ on Linux/Unix platforms, familiarity with scripting languages.
  • Experience with effective code version control, as well as Continuous Integration and Deployment.
  • Exceptional communication skills in both verbal and written form.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and judgment with strong attention to detail.
  • Mature and thoughtful, with the ability to operate in a collaborative, team-oriented culture.
  • Motivated by the transformational effects of technology-at-scale.
  • Experience with AI technologies, such as LLMs and agentic AI, along with their use cases would be beneficial.
  • Experience in finance is a plus but not required.

About Global Commissioning
Global Commissioning are a specialised consultancy delivering world-class Commissioning Agent, Management, MEP Validation, and Specialist Electrical Services to the global data centre industry. We are experts in commissioning and optimising Hyperscale and COLO/IBX data centres, with extensive experience in process facilities, HV commissioning, and mission-critical infrastructure.
Our strength lies in collaboration, we take an integrated approach to project delivery, ensuring safety, efficiency, and performance excellence. With a proven track record in delivering complex, high-stakes projects, we are your trusted partner for data centre commissioning and operational readiness.
We operate with full tax and visa compliance in all regions where we work, ensuring seamless project execution and adherence to local regulations. With offices across EMEA, we are strategically positioned to support your business wherever you need us.
Role Overview
The Lead Commissioning Authority (Lead CxA) oversees and ensures the safe, reliable, and compliant commissioning of mechanical and electrical systems, building control and monitoring systems and critical infrastructure—primarily within mission-critical facilities such as data centres.
This role ensures that all building systems perform according to design intent, owner’s requirements, industry standards, and operational needs.
The Lead CxA leads commissioning delivery across multiple projects, provides technical oversight during all construction phases, and ensures a seamless transition from equipment delivery, through to construction and to live commissioning. Drawing from strong MEP, commissioning, and quality-assurance experience, the Lead CxA acts as a trusted advisor to clients, design teams, and contractors.
Key Responsibilities
Commissioning Leadership & Delivery
Lead and manage commissioning processes from pre-design through post-occupancy, ensuring compliance with Owner’s Project Requirements (OPR), Basis of Design (BOD) and design specifications.
Oversee functional performance testing for all mechanical, electrical, building control and monitoring systems and life safety systems.
Review design documents, submittals, and shop drawings to ensure alignment with commissioning requirements.
Develop commissioning strategies, programs, method statements, test scripts, and final reports.
Conduct site surveys, progress inspections, and quality audits, reporting findings to project stakeholders.
Client & Stakeholder Coordination
Act as the primary commissioning interface for clients, general contractors, and design teams.
Lead commissioning meetings, workshops, and integrated system testing (IST) coordination sessions.
Build strong relationships and ensure clear communication regarding commissioning progress, issues, and risks.
Team Management & Oversight
Provide technical leadership to Commissioning Engineers and Managers and SME’s (Subject Matter Experts).
Mentor and develop junior members of the commissioning team.
Ensure all team members are competent, trained, and aligned with quality and safety standards.
Quality Assurance & Compliance
Ensure commissioning is performed in accordance with statutory, industry, and project-specific standards.
Review installation quality and verify that systems are installed and tested to design intent.
Implement lessons-learned processes and continuous improvement initiatives across projects.
Health & Safety
Drive a strong safety culture and always ensure strict adherence to site health and safety protocols.
Qualifications
Trade apprenticeship or relevant electrical/mechanical engineering qualification.
CSCS / Safe Pass / ECS / SMSTS certification – essential.
BEng (Hons) in Mechanical, Electrical, or Building Services Engineering
Project management qualification (e.g., Prince2) – advantageous.
Skills & Experience
Extensive commissioning experience in mission-critical environments (data centres essential).
Ideally 4-6 years’ technical experience in design, installation, and commissioning of MEP systems.
Strong stakeholder management in term of leading and managing in person meeting with the clients and vendors.
Strong understanding of commissioning processes, integrated system testing, and quality assurance.
Ability to develop high-quality commissioning documentation: plans, scripts, checklists, and reports.
Excellent client-facing skills with the ability to influence and drive decisions.
Proficient with Microsoft Office and commissioning management tools.
Why Join Us?
Be part of a growing consultancy making a global impact in mission-critical industries.
Work closely with senior leaders and gain exposure to high-profile international projects.
A chance to grow your career in a role that mixes creativity, strategy, and delivery

UK / Europe | Technical Delivery
We’re looking for a Protection Validation Engineer (Lead / SME) to act as our technical authority on protection and control systems across high-voltage (HV) and extra high-voltage (EHV) environments.
This is a senior, high-impact role combining technical leadership, independent validation, and hands-on project involvement. You’ll shape validation strategies, challenge designs, and ensure protection systems perform reliably in some of the most critical infrastructure environments in the world.
Expect a balance of strategic oversight and on-site delivery (25–50%), working closely with commissioning teams during key project phases.
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll operate as a trusted expert across multiple projects, responsible for:
Leading protection validation strategy, standards, and best practices
Acting as the technical authority for protection engineering across the business
Reviewing and validating:
Protection & control designs
Single-line diagrams and schematics
Relay settings and coordination studies
Ensuring compliance with client specs, grid requirements, and industry standards
Providing technical oversight across design, FAT/SAT, and commissioning phases
Supporting site activities, including:
Witnessing end-to-end protection testing
Verifying protection scheme functionality
Supporting energisation and switching events
Identifying risks, resolving complex issues, and supporting fault investigations
Advising clients and stakeholders in design reviews and assurance forums
Mentoring engineers and contributing to internal technical capability
What We’re Looking For
Core Experience
Extensive background in HV/EHV protection and control systems
Proven experience in protection validation, design review, and technical assurance
Strong knowledge of:
Overcurrent, distance, and differential protection
Protection coordination and selectivity
Experience with relay configuration, testing, and commissioning oversight
Familiarity with tools such as ETAP, DIgSILENT, or similar
Technical & Professional Background
Electrical qualifications (HNC/HND/BEng or equivalent preferred)
HV authorisations or training (essential)
Chartered Engineer status (or working towards) is advantageous
Ability to interpret complex schematics and technical documentation
Experience in data centres, utilities, or mission-critical environments is a plus
How You Work
You’re a technical leader who can influence and challenge decisions
You balance engineering governance with practical delivery
You’re detail-driven, proactive, and solutions-focused
You communicate confidently with clients, contractors, and teams
You prioritise safety and quality in high-voltage environments
You enjoy mentoring and developing others
Please note this role is a combination of 25-50% UK and European travel and the remainder of the time you will be based at our Newcastle Office.

As our Regional Operations Manager, you’ll be responsible for leading, coordinating, and delivering commissioning and technical operations across multiple projects within their assigned regions in mainland Europe.
You will ensure that all technical, operational, and delivery activities are executed safely, efficiently, consistently, and in line with company standards, contractual requirements, and client expectations.
You will provide technical authority, operational leadership, and oversight of site-based teams, acting as the primary link between regional project delivery and senior management.
It is essential that you have the flexibility to travel into Europe every week or ideally you will be already based in Europe with the flexibility to travel around EU without restrictions.
Key Areas of Responsibility
Technical Leadership
Provide technical leadership, direction, and oversight to all site-based commissioning and operations teams within the region.
Act as the senior technical authority for commissioning activities on assigned projects.
Set and enforce technical standards, methodologies, and best practices across all sites.
Lead by example through active participation in technical discussions, troubleshooting, and decision-making.
Support site teams in resolving complex commissioning, integration, and performance issues.
Project and Operational Management
Work closely with Project Managers and key stakeholders to define project scope, milestones, and deliverables.
Develop, monitor, and maintain regional delivery plans, schedules, and resource forecasts.
Ensure projects are delivered in line with contractual, technical, and commercial requirements.
Oversee progress, risks, and constraints, implementing corrective actions where required.
Ensure consistency of execution and reporting across all projects in the region.
Technical Governance and Quality
Ensure that all commissioning activities comply with company procedures, industry standards, and client requirements.
Review, approve, and contribute to technical documentation, including test procedures, commissioning plans, reports, and handover documentation.
Ensure technical risks are identified, managed, and mitigated.
Support audits, quality reviews, and lessons-learned activities across the region.
Client and Stakeholder Engagement
Act as a senior technical and operational point of contact for clients within the region.
Understand client technical requirements and ensure they are incorporated into project delivery.
Provide clear, accurate, and timely communication on progress, risks, and technical matters.
Manage client expectations and contribute to maintaining high levels of client satisfaction.
Support the resolution of client issues and escalation of major concerns.
Continuous Improvement and Industry Awareness
Stay informed of industry trends, emerging technologies, and commissioning best practices.
Drive improvements in tools, processes, and methodologies across the region.
Support the development and refinement of company technical and operational standards
Health, Safety and Compliance
Ensure that all operations are carried out in compliance with health, safety, environmental, and company policies.
Promote a strong safety culture across all sites.
Ensure that risks are assessed and controlled before and during all site activities.
This outlines the principal responsibilities and accountabilities of the role. It is not intended to be exhaustive, and the post holder may be required to undertake other duties commensurate with the level of responsibility and within their competence to support the wider organisation.
Education
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services, or related engineering discipline.
Postgraduate qualification in Engineering or Project / Operations Management is desirable.
Formal training or certification in data centre or mission-critical commissioning, project management, and health & safety is desirable.
Skills and Experience (Data Centre Commissioning)
Strong technical knowledge of mission-critical data centre systems, including electrical power, mechanical cooling, controls, and integrated systems.
Proven experience leading data centre commissioning activities, including Level 1–5 commissioning and Integrated Systems Testing (IST).
Sound understanding of redundancy, resilience, and maintainability concepts (N, N+1, 2N).
Ability to review, approve, and author commissioning plans, test procedures, and handover documentation.
Experience managing commissioning activities in live or operational data centre environments.
Knowledge of relevant data centre standards and frameworks (e.g. Tier concepts, EN 50600, TIA-942).
Strong leadership and coordination skills across multi-disciplinary teams and multiple sites.
